01 · 基础、性状与遗传参数 / Foundations, traits, and parameters

UNE · 数量遗传学 / UNE: quantitative genetics
数量遗传学课程提供遗传作用、遗传力、相关、选择反应和世代间隔的概念框架。
The quantitative-genetics course provides a framework for genetic components, heritability, correlations, selection response, and generation intervals.


Purdue／NSIF · 猪遗传改良 / Purdue and NSIF: swine improvement

育种与杂交解释育种与杂交的基础。
Breeding and crossbreeding explains foundational improvement concepts.
遗传参数解释遗传力与遗传相关。
Genetic parameters explains heritability and genetic correlation.
多性状选择解释多性状目标与限性性状。
Multi-trait selection discusses multiple objectives and sex-limited traits.

这些资料年代较早，阅读时重点看原理。
These resources are historical, so focus on their principles.


AGBU · 猪 EBV / AGBU: pig EBVs
PIGBLUP EBV 说明介绍猪常见性状、EBV 单位、后代差异及跨场比较条件。
The PIGBLUP EBV explanation covers pig traits, EBV units, progeny differences, and across-herd comparison conditions.

title: 09-5｜选择反应：每代改良与每年改良 / Selection response: per generation versus per year
section: 02 · 补充概念：S 和 R 不一样 / Supporting concepts: S differs from R
text:
02 · 补充概念：S 和 R 不一样 / Supporting concepts: S differs from R
Bruce Walsh 的选择反应课程 PDF 第 2—3 页区分亲代选择差与后代选择反应。
PDF pages 2–3 of Bruce Walsh’s selection-response lecture distinguish parental selection differential from offspring response.

选择差 S是入选亲本均值相对原群体均值的偏离。
The selection differential S is the selected-parent mean minus the original population mean.
选择反应 R是选择造成的下一代群体均值变化。
The selection response R is the next-generation mean change caused by selection.

在简单加性、表型选择等条件下，可使用狭义遗传力的育种者方程。
Under simple additive and phenotypic-selection assumptions, the breeder’s equation uses narrow-sense heritability.
R=h2S
R=h^2S

雌雄两性选择不同时，需要按适用模型合并双方贡献，而不能只代入父本的选择差。
When selection differs between the sexes, combine contributions under the appropriate model rather than inserting only the sire differential.

自拟手算例子 / Original hand-calculation example
假设原群体均值为 800 g/day，入选亲本的适用综合均值为 850 g/day。
Suppose the original mean is 800 g/day and the appropriate combined selected-parent mean is 850 g/day.
选择差是 S=850−800=50S=850-800=50 g/day。
The selection differential is S=850−800=50S=850-800=50 g/day.
若 h2=0.30h^2=0.30，则预期每代反应为 R=0.30×50=15R=0.30\times50=15 g/day。
If h2=0.30h^2=0.30, expected response per generation is R=0.30×50=15R=0.30\times50=15 g/day.
这不是每年 15，也不是每一头后代都增加 15。
This is neither 15 per year nor a guaranteed increase of 15 for every offspring.

section: 03 · 更一般的四个因素 / Four more general factors
text:
03 · 更一般的四个因素 / Four more general factors
在简单单性状近似下，年度反应常写为下面的形式。
Under a simple single-trait approximation, annual response is often written as follows.
ΔGyear≈irσAL
\Delta G_{year}\approx\frac{i\,r\,\sigma_A}{L}


i 是选择强度，描述按某种标准选出的群体有多优秀。
i is selection intensity, describing the standardized superiority of the selected group.
r 是选择标准与真实育种值的相关，不是两个性状的遗传相关。
r is the correlation between the selection criterion and true breeding value, not a genetic correlation between traits.
σA\sigma_A 是加性遗传标准差，不是表型标准差，也不是遗传方差。
σA\sigma_A is additive genetic standard deviation, not phenotypic standard deviation or genetic variance.
L 是世代间隔，即产生替代后代时父母的平均年龄。
L is generation interval, the average parental age at birth of replacement offspring.

选择强度是无量纲量，不是把保留 10% 直接写成 i=0.10i=0.10。
Selection intensity is dimensionless, and retaining 10% does not mean i=0.10i=0.10.
如果性状单位是 g/day，年度反应单位就是 g/day 每年。
If the trait is measured in g/day, annual response is measured in g/day per year.

不要把 r 当成遗传力 / Do not confuse r with heritability
在只用自身表型选择的简单模型中，r=h=h2r=h=\sqrt{h^2}，而不是 r=h2r=h^2。
In the simple own-phenotype selection model, r=h=h2r=h=\sqrt{h^2} rather than r=h2r=h^2.
若改用 EBV 或综合信息，准确度应按实际选择标准与信息结构确定。
With EBVs or combined information, accuracy depends on the actual criterion and information structure.

04 · 两个方案比较：更准不一定更快 / Comparing plans: more accurate may not mean faster
假设两方案的 i=1.2i=1.2、σA=20\sigma_A=20 g/day，但准确度与等待时间不同。
Suppose both plans have i=1.2i=1.2 and σA=20\sigma_A=20 g/day, but differ in accuracy and waiting time.

方案甲：r=0.60r=0.60、L=1.5L=1.5 年，年度进展为 9.6 (g/day)/年。
Plan A: r=0.60r=0.60 and L=1.5L=1.5 years give annual progress of 9.6 (g/day)/year.
方案乙：r=0.80r=0.80、L=2.5L=2.5 年，年度进展为 7.68 (g/day)/年。
Plan B: r=0.80r=0.80 and L=2.5L=2.5 years give annual progress of 7.68 (g/day)/year.

ΔGA=1.2×0.60×201.5=9.6,ΔGB=1.2×0.80×202.5=7.68
\Delta G_A=\frac{1.2\times0.60\times20}{1.5}=9.6,\qquad
\Delta G_B=\frac{1.2\times0.80\times20}{2.5}=7.68

乙每次选择更准，但等待更久，因此本例中的年度进展较少。
B selects more accurately each time but waits longer, so its annual response is lower in this example.
这个比较只说明权衡，不能证明现实中应该一律选最年轻的动物。
This illustrates a trade-off rather than proving that the youngest animals should always be selected.
成熟度、繁殖能力、健康与预测是否适用，仍需满足实际条件。
Maturity, reproductive ability, health, and prediction applicability must still meet practical requirements.



选择准确度、世代间隔和年度遗传进展 / Selection accuracy, generation intervals, and annual genetic gain


图 09-5A　两种方案共用选择强度 1.2 和加性遗传标准差 20 g/day，本例的年进展分别为 9.60 和 7.68 (g/day)/年。
Figure 09-5A　Both plans use a selection intensity of 1.2 and an additive genetic standard deviation of 20 g/day, giving 9.60 and 7.68 (g/day)/year, respectively.
方案乙的准确度更高，较长的世代间隔使本例的年进展低于方案甲。
Plan B has higher accuracy, and its longer generation interval results in a lower annual gain than Plan A in this example.

section: 05 · 父母两条路径怎么合并 / Combining sire and dam paths
text:
05 · 父母两条路径怎么合并 / Combining sire and dam paths
UNE 讲义的双路径形式允许父母拥有不同的选择强度、准确度和世代间隔。
The UNE lecture’s two-path form allows different sire and dam intensities, accuracies, and generation intervals.
在简化两性加性模型下，可写为下面的形式。
In a simplified two-sex additive model, it can be written as follows.
ΔGyear≈(imrm+ifrf)σALm+Lf
\Delta G_{year}\approx
\frac{(i_mr_m+i_fr_f)\sigma_A}{L_m+L_f}

假设父系 im=1.4,rm=0.7,Lm=1i_m=1.4,r_m=0.7,L_m=1，母系 if=0.8,rf=0.5,Lf=2i_f=0.8,r_f=0.5,L_f=2。
Suppose the sire path has im=1.4,rm=0.7,Lm=1i_m=1.4,r_m=0.7,L_m=1, and the dam path has if=0.8,rf=0.5,Lf=2i_f=0.8,r_f=0.5,L_f=2.
当 σA=20\sigma_A=20 g/day 时，结果为 (0.98+0.40)×20/3=9.2(0.98+0.40)\times20/3=9.2 g/day 每年。
With σA=20\sigma_A=20 g/day, the result is (0.98+0.40)×20/3=9.2(0.98+0.40)\times20/3=9.2 g/day per year.
这里的两条路径是教学简化，复杂育种结构可能需要更多路径或模拟。
These two paths are a teaching simplification, and complex breeding structures may require additional paths or simulation.

06 · 预测值如何接受检查 / Checking the prediction
先固定性状定义、评估基准、出生年份与比较范围，再追踪后续实际遗传趋势。
Fix the trait definition, evaluation base, birth years, and comparison scope before tracking subsequent genetic trends.
生产均值还受管理影响，不能单凭生产增长宣称实现了预测遗传进展。

text:
01 · 原文短摘与要点 / Short excerpt and source summary

短摘译意：有相同的表现机会。
Short excerpt: “an equal opportunity to perform”.

这是原文开头解释同期群时的核心措辞。
This is the central wording used in the source’s opening explanation.
原文只把表现机会相近的动物放在同组直接比较，并提醒分组错误会损害评估。
The source directly compares animals with similar opportunities and warns that incorrect grouping harms evaluation.
它既反对把不同待遇混在一起，也指出过小分组会削弱比较信息。
It discourages mixing different treatments and notes that overly small groups weaken comparisons.
所列分组依据包括场、出生年份、性别、出生类型、母龄、品种、测量日期、日龄与管理信息。
Listed criteria include herd, birth year, sex, birth type, dam age, breed, measurement date, age, and management information.
具体组合随性状与评估设计变化，不能当作所有动物评估的统一编码表。
The combination varies with traits and evaluation design, rather than defining a universal coding scheme.

02 · 补充阅读：管理历史不能丢 / Supporting reading: retain management history
BREEDPLAN 记录手册的 PDF 第 44—46 页区分出生前与出生后的管理影响。
PDF pages 44–46 of the BREEDPLAN recording manual distinguish pre-birth and post-birth management influences.
它还说明，曾经分开管理的动物即使后来混群，早期差异仍可能影响后续分组。
It also explains that earlier separate management can affect later grouping even after animals are reunited.
因此“今天同栏”不等于“从出生起经历相同”。
Being housed together today does not establish identical histories since birth.
这条肉牛系统规则用于提醒保留历史，种猪如何建模仍需按具体测定方案决定。
This cattle-system rule motivates retaining history, while pig modeling still depends on its testing protocol.

text:
03 · 教学例子：相同记录，不同背景 / Teaching example: identical records, different backgrounds
以下四头猪的数据完全是假设，单位均为 g/day。
The following four-pig dataset is wholly hypothetical, with all values in g/day.

管理组 A 的两头猪分别为 800、900，均值为 850。
Management group A contains records 800 and 900, with mean 850.
管理组 B 的两头猪分别为 900、1,000，均值为 950。
Management group B contains records 900 and 1,000, with mean 950.

两头记录为 900 的猪，原始表现相同，但组内偏差分别为 +50 与 −50。
The two pigs recorded at 900 have identical raw performance but within-group deviations of +50 and −50.
这说明比较背景会影响解释，却还不能证明 A 组那头猪的真实育种值更高。
This shows why comparison context matters without proving that the A-group pig has higher true breeding value.
两个组可能同时存在环境差异和遗传均值差异。
The groups may differ in both environment and mean genetic merit.
Purdue 遗传价值估计资料特别区分组内偏差与跨组遗传比较。
The Purdue genetic-merit resource distinguishes within-group deviations from across-group genetic comparisons.
不能把“减去组均值”直接改名为正式 EBV。
Subtracting a group mean does not create an official EBV.

section: 04 · 把管理记录拆成事件 / Represent management as events
text:
04 · 把管理记录拆成事件 / Represent management as events
下面是本教程提出的记录结构，不是 BREEDPLAN 官方文件格式。
The structure below is an original recording proposal, not an official BREEDPLAN format.
animal_id, event_start, event_end, management_code, reason
P001, 2026-08-01, 2026-08-20, FEED_A, standard_feed
P002, 2026-08-01, 2026-08-20, FEED_B, different_feed
P002, 2026-08-21, 2026-08-25, HEALTH_X, treatment_event
日期、编号和事件都是假设，只用于说明应保留时间范围与原因。
Dates, IDs, and events are hypothetical and illustrate retaining time intervals and reasons.
最终同期群由性状定义、测定窗口、必要校正和真实管理经历共同决定。
Final contemporary groups depend on trait definitions, testing windows, required adjustments, and actual management histories.
不能看到父系或 EBV 后，再为了改变排名修改组别。
Do not redefine groups after seeing sire identity or EBVs merely to change rankings.

需要特别分清的两种错误 / Two different errors

漏分组把显著不同待遇当成相同机会。
Under-grouping treats substantially different management as equal opportunity.
过分组把真正可比的动物拆得太碎。
Over-grouping fragments animals that are genuinely comparable.

改进目标是保留真实比较，而不是一味增加或减少组数。
The goal is genuine comparison, not simply maximizing or minimizing group counts.

section: 05 · 猪场如何借鉴 / Applying the principle to pigs
text:
05 · 猪场如何借鉴 / Applying the principle to pigs
Purdue 记录规范把身份、测量质量与控制非遗传差异作为记录基础。
Purdue’s recording guidance treats identity, measurement quality, and control of non-genetic differences as recording foundations.
实际应先问数据是否同口径，再问模型能否合理解释年龄、性别、胎次或管理差异。
First check consistent definitions, then whether the model reasonably addresses age, sex, parity, or management differences.
这些因素可以采用分组、协变量或其他效应处理，并非每个字段都要机械拼成一个组号。
These factors may enter grouping, covariates, or other effects rather than being mechanically concatenated into one group ID.

同一个栏号需要连同管理历史看 / Read a Pen ID Alongside Management History
两头猪今天同场同栏，其中一头过去转过场并补过饲，我会先保留这些事件，再按性状和测定方案判断哪些要用于分组。
If two pigs share a pen today and one previously moved farms and received extra feed, I retain those events and then use the trait and testing protocol to decide what matters for grouping.

section: 01 · 原文短摘与要点 / Short excerpt and source summary
text:
01 · 原文短摘与要点 / Short excerpt and source summary

短摘译意：目标与选择依据不是同一回事。
Short excerpt: “the objective and criterion are not the same.”

摘录位于原文 Background 部分，以下为概括而非逐字翻译。
The excerpt is from Background, and the following is a summary rather than a full translation.

育种目标描述最终要改良什么，选择依据描述用什么信息选动物。
The objective states what to improve, while the criterion states what information selects animals.
轮回选择按代轮换重点性状。
Tandem selection rotates the focal trait across generations.
独立淘汰门槛要求每个指定性状过关。
Independent culling levels require passing every specified trait threshold.
指数选择把多性状信息汇成一个综合排序。
Index selection combines multi-trait information into an overall ranking.

原文提醒，单项改良最快不一定意味着综合目标改良最多。
The source cautions that the fastest single-trait improvement need not maximize the overall objective.

section: 02 · 教学解释：为什么不能只看一个指标 / Teaching explanation: beyond one metric
text:
02 · 教学解释：为什么不能只看一个指标 / Teaching explanation: beyond one metric
下面用自拟候选集比较三种规则，避免把抽象方法混在一起。
The original candidate set below compares three rules without conflating the methods.
所有 EBV 假设来自同一可比评估，三项依次为 ADG、背膘 BF 与产活仔数 NBA。
All EBVs are assumed comparable, listed as ADG, backfat BF, and number born alive NBA.

甲：+40 g/day、+0.8 mm、+0.1 头/窝。
A: +40 g/day, +0.8 mm, and +0.1 piglets/litter.
乙：+30 g/day、+0.2 mm、+0.4 头/窝。
B: +30 g/day, +0.2 mm, and +0.4 piglets/litter.
丙：+20 g/day、−0.3 mm、+0.6 头/窝。
C: +20 g/day, −0.3 mm, and +0.6 piglets/litter.


规则一：本代只看增重 / Rule 1: select only on gain this generation
甲的增重 EBV 最高，所以这个规则选择甲。
A has the highest growth EBV, so this rule selects A.
这条规则没有直接使用背膘和繁殖信息，不等于证明它们不重要。
The rule ignores backfat and reproduction directly, without establishing that they are unimportant.


规则二：每项都要过线 / Rule 2: require every threshold
假设门槛为 ADG ≥ 20、BF ≤ 0.5、NBA ≥ 0.3，单位沿用上文。
Suppose thresholds are ADG ≥ 20, BF ≤ 0.5, and NBA ≥ 0.3, using the units above.
乙和丙通过，甲因背膘与繁殖指标未达标而被排除。
B and C pass, while A fails the backfat and reproduction thresholds.
这一步只定义合格集合，尚未决定在乙、丙之间留谁。
This defines the eligible set without yet choosing between B and C.


规则三：按综合指数排序 / Rule 3: rank by an index
假设教学指数如下，其单位仅为自定义指数分，不代表实际利润。
The hypothetical teaching index below uses arbitrary index points, not actual profit.
J=0.03EBVADG−1.2EBVBF+2EBVNBA
J=0.03\,EBV_{ADG}-1.2\,EBV_{BF}+2\,EBV_{NBA}


甲得 1.2−0.96+0.2=0.441.2-0.96+0.2=0.44 分。
A scores 1.2−0.96+0.2=0.441.2-0.96+0.2=0.44 points.
乙得 0.9−0.24+0.8=1.460.9-0.24+0.8=1.46 分。
B scores 0.9−0.24+0.8=1.460.9-0.24+0.8=1.46 points.
丙得 0.6+0.36+1.2=2.160.6+0.36+1.2=2.16 分。
C scores 0.6+0.36+1.2=2.160.6+0.36+1.2=2.16 points.

丙在这组权重下排名最高，但更换目标或权重可能改变结论。
C ranks highest under these weights, but another objective or weighting can change the result.



同一组候选的三种选择结果 / Three selection outcomes for the same candidate group


图 09-1A　同一组自拟候选中，本代只看增重时选甲，逐项设门槛时乙和丙进入合格名单，按当前教学指数排序时丙、乙、甲依次得 2.16、1.46、0.44 分。
Figure 09-1A　For the same hypothetical candidates, selection on gain alone picks A, independent culling levels admit B and C, and the teaching index ranks C, B, and A at 2.16, 1.46, and 0.44 points.
三栏是分别应用于同一候选集的三种规则，门槛规则在本例只给出合格名单。
The panels apply three separate rules to the same candidates, and the threshold rule produces an eligible set in this example.

03 · 补充原理：相关与信息来源 / Supporting principles: correlations and information
Purdue 遗传参数资料解释，遗传相关决定一个性状变化时另一个性状可能怎样变化。
Purdue’s genetic-parameter resource explains that genetic correlations influence correlated changes in other traits.
相关的正负号描述方向，是否有利还要看目标方向。
The sign describes direction, while desirability depends on the objective.
遗传价值估计资料说明，亲属和相关性状的信息可以参与遗传预测。
The genetic-merit resource explains how relatives and correlated traits contribute information to genetic prediction.
因此不能把自己未直接测到某性状，等同于该性状没有可用信息。
Not measuring a trait on a candidate does not imply that no information about it is available.

section: 04 · 用筛选程序理解 / A filtering analogy
text:
04 · 用筛选程序理解 / A filtering analogy
可以把独立门槛看作 eligible = rule1 AND rule2 AND rule3。
Think of independent thresholds as eligible = rule1 AND rule2 AND rule3.
指数则像对候选集执行 ORDER BY score，前者定义资格，后者定义排序。
An index resembles ORDER BY score, with eligibility and ranking serving different purposes.
若两项门槛通过率都为 50%，只有在独立等条件成立时，联合通过率才是 25%。
Two 50% pass rates produce a 25% joint pass rate only under conditions such as independence.
一般应使用条件概率，而不是机械连乘两个边际通过率。
In general, use conditional probabilities rather than blindly multiplying marginal pass rates.
P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B∣A)
P(A\cap B)=P(A)\,P(B\mid A)

这个程序类比说明规则结构，不表示动物之间或性状之间真的独立。
This programming analogy explains rule structure without assuming independent animals or traits.

I specify which animals provide known information, which are targets, and which are held out for validation, then ask what setting a prediction score represents.

section: 01 · 来源要点 / Source points
text:
01 · 来源要点 / Source points
原文反复强调“reference population”，以及基因组信息不能替代表型记录。
The source repeatedly emphasizes the “reference population” and that genomic information does not replace performance recording.
文章用青年牛和全同胞举例，说明基因型可在自身记录有限时增加信息，但收益依赖参考群体与性状。
The article uses young cattle and full siblings to illustrate information gains with limited own records, subject to the reference population and trait.
其参考群体规模示例来自当时肉牛条件，本篇不把它变成种猪必须达到的固定样本门槛。
Its reference-size examples reflect historical beef conditions and are not treated as a fixed required sample threshold for pigs.

section: 02 · 三个角色 / Three roles
text:
02 · 三个角色 / Three roles

参考群体为模型提供基因型与可用表型之间的联系，通常还需要系谱与管理信息。
The reference population provides connections between genotypes and usable phenotypes, usually alongside pedigree and management information.
候选群体是需要预测和选择的动物，其中一些尚无自身性状记录。
The candidate population contains animals requiring prediction and selection, some without own trait records.
验证群体用于检查预测能否应用到指定对象，不能同时随意作为已经看过答案的训练集。
The validation population checks prediction for the intended target and must not casually be treated as training data whose answers were already seen.

这些角色取决于时间和分析设计，同一动物的记录不能在同一评估中既当隐藏答案又泄漏进训练。
These roles depend on timing and design, and an animal’s withheld answer must not leak into training within the same evaluation.

section: 03 · 为什么全同胞可以被区分 / Why full siblings can be distinguished
text:
03 · 为什么全同胞可以被区分 / Why full siblings can be distinguished
假设两头同胞 S1、S2 的父母 EBV 为 +40、+20，则无其他区分信息时亲本均值都是 +30。
Suppose full siblings S1 and S2 have parental EBVs +40 and +20, giving both parent averages +30 without other distinguishing information.
分型显示二者继承组合不同，若参考群体提供相关证据，更新后的预测可以不同。
Genotyping can reveal different inherited combinations, allowing different updated predictions when reference data provide relevant evidence.
例如自拟更新结果为 +34 与 +27，仅表示模型加入信息后作出区分，不能说芯片直接测出了真实 BV。
Hypothetical updated predictions of +34 and +27 show model-based differentiation, not direct chip measurement of true BV.
没有适用参考信息时，检测到 SNP 差异本身不告诉你哪个差异对目标性状更有利。
Without applicable reference information, detecting SNP differences alone does not establish which differences favor the target trait.

section: 04 · 影响效果的五个条件 / Five conditions affecting performance
text:
04 · 影响效果的五个条件 / Five conditions affecting performance

记录质量决定表型标签是否可用，错误猪号会把基因型和错误表现连接。
Record quality determines phenotype usability, with wrong IDs connecting genotypes to the wrong outcomes.
参考代表性决定目标品种、血缘和环境是否得到覆盖。
Reference representativeness determines coverage of target breeds, relationships, and environments.
样本量与有效信息同时重要，许多重复或高度冗余记录不等于同量独立证据。
Sample size and effective information both matter, as many duplicated or redundant records do not equal the same amount of independent evidence.
性状定义必须一致，别把日增重、达重日龄或料重比混成同一标签。
Trait definition must be consistent rather than mixing daily gain, days to weight, and FCR into one label.
持续更新把新世代的真实记录带回参考群体，避免只依赖越来越远的旧数据。
Continual updating adds new-generation records rather than relying only on increasingly distant historical data.

title: 08-3｜参考群体与基因组选择 / Reference populations and genomic selection
section: 05 · 为什么随机拆分有时过于乐观 / Why random splits can be optimistic
text:
05 · 为什么随机拆分有时过于乐观 / Why random splits can be optimistic
若训练集与验证集含许多近亲，随机拆分可能反映对近亲的预测能力，却不代表对陌生品种或未来条件的能力。
With many close relatives across training and validation, random splitting may measure prediction of relatives without establishing transfer to unrelated breeds or future conditions.
这不表示所有亲属拆分都错误，而是验证对象必须与真正使用场景一致。
This does not make every relatives-based split wrong, but validation targets must match intended use.
一种自拟时间验证是只用截止日已知记录预测下一批青年猪，等未来表现出现后再评分。
One original time-validation design predicts the next young cohort using only information available at cutoff and scores predictions after later outcomes arrive.
候选的未来表型、由未来表型更新的亲属 EBV 和使用全数据计算的筛选变量都可能泄漏答案。
Future candidate phenotypes, relatives’ EBVs updated with future phenotypes, and selection variables computed from all data can leak answers.

section: 06 · 验证相关不是自动等于 ACC / Validation correlation is not automatically ACC
text:
06 · 验证相关不是自动等于 ACC / Validation correlation is not automatically ACC
假设三头动物的预测为 [10,20,30][10,20,30]，未来校正表现为 [14,16,24][14,16,24]。
Suppose three animals have predictions [10,20,30][10,20,30] and later adjusted performances [14,16,24][14,16,24].
两列均值分别为 20、18，交叉离差和为 100，平方和为 200、56。
Their means are 20 and 18, cross-deviation sum is 100, and squared sums are 200 and 56.
r=100/200×56≈0.9449
r=100/\sqrt{200\times56}\approx0.9449

这个很小的教学样本只演示运算，算出的是与未来表型的相关，不是与不可直接观测真实 BV 的相关。
This tiny sample only demonstrates arithmetic, calculating correlation with future phenotype rather than unobservable true BV.
还应看样本规模、误差范围、均值偏差、预测尺度和目标群体，不能凭一个高相关宣布评估准确。
Sample size, uncertainty, mean bias, prediction scale, and target population also matter, so one high correlation cannot certify accurate evaluation.

text:
07 · 用验证数据衡量升级收益 / Measure the Benefit with Validation Data
要判断更密的芯片是否提高了预测，我会在目标群体上比较旧方案和新方案，用同一套验证设计。
To see whether a denser chip improves prediction, I compare the old and new approaches on the target population with the same validation design.
样本身份、参考群体、表型质量和群体适用性都可能限制收益，这些条件要一起核对。
Sample identity, reference data, phenotype quality, and population relevance can limit the benefit and should all be checked.

title: 08-1｜单步关系矩阵 H / The single-step relationship matrix H
section: 01 · 已读替代来源的要点 / Points from the retrieved alternative
text:
01 · 已读替代来源的要点 / Points from the retrieved alternative
作者教程使用“single-step genomic BLUP”，把系谱、表型和部分动物基因型放入同一模型。
The author tutorial uses “single-step genomic BLUP” to combine pedigrees, phenotypes, and genotypes for some animals in one model.
它说明 H 的逆如何由 A、G 和已分型子集构成，下面用原创矩阵逐项解释。
It explains the construction of the inverse of H from A, G, and the genotyped subset, unpacked below with original matrices.

title: 08-1｜单步关系矩阵 H / The single-step relationship matrix H
section: 02 · 先统一动物顺序 / Align animal ordering first
text:
02 · 先统一动物顺序 / Align animal ordering first
令第 1 组为未分型动物，第 2 组为已分型动物，把 A 按这两组拆成四块。
Let Group 1 contain non-genotyped animals and Group 2 genotyped animals, partitioning A into four blocks.
A=[A11A12A21A22]
A=\begin{bmatrix}A_{11}&A_{12}\\A_{21}&A_{22}\end{bmatrix}

A22A_{22} 只包含已分型动物，但它来自完整系谱关系，而不只是已分型动物之间能看到的父母表。
A22A_{22} contains only genotyped animals but derives from the full pedigree relationships rather than only parentage visible within the genotyped subset.
G 也必须采用第 2 组的同一动物顺序，否则数值正确但身份错位仍会出错。
G must use exactly the same animal order as Group 2, or correct numbers attached to wrong identities still produce errors.

title: 08-1｜单步关系矩阵 H / The single-step relationship matrix H
section: 03 · H 逆的公式 / The inverse-H equation
text:
03 · H 逆的公式 / The inverse-H equation
H−1=A−1+[000G−1−A22−1]
H^{-1}=A^{-1}+\begin{bmatrix}
0&0\\0&G^{-1}-A_{22}^{-1}
\end{bmatrix}

这个结构保留全群系谱框架，再在分型子集加入基因组与原系谱信息之间的修正。
This structure retains the whole-population pedigree framework and adds a correction between genomic and pedigree information in the genotyped subset.
减去 A22−1A_{22}^{-1} 是为了在这一协方差构造中替换相应信息，而不是把同一系谱关系再完整加一遍。
Subtracting A22−1A_{22}^{-1} replaces the corresponding information in this covariance construction rather than adding the same pedigree relationships again.
公式中的逆是矩阵逆，不能把每个元素分别取倒数。
The inverses are matrix inverses, not reciprocals of individual entries.



单步关系矩阵逆中的已分型修正块 / Genotyped correction block in the inverse single-step relationship matrix


图 08-1A　在 H−1=A−1+ΔH^{-1}=A^{-1}+\Delta 中，修正矩阵 Δ\Delta 的三个块为零，右下角已分型动物块为 G−1−(A22)−1G^{-1}-(A_{22})^{-1}。
Figure 08-1A　In H−1=A−1+ΔH^{-1}=A^{-1}+\Delta, three blocks of Δ\Delta are zero and the lower-right block for genotyped animals is G−1−(A22)−1G^{-1}-(A_{22})^{-1}.
计算这个块时，GG 和 A22A_{22} 的动物顺序必须一致，并分别做矩阵求逆。
To compute this block, put GG and A22A_{22} in the same animal order and invert each as a matrix.

title: 08-1｜单步关系矩阵 H / The single-step relationship matrix H
section: 04 · 一个三动物数值例子 / A three-animal numerical example
text:
04 · 一个三动物数值例子 / A three-animal numerical example
沿用父母 S、D 与子代 C 的 A，但假设只有 D、C 分型，顺序为 S｜D、C。
Use the A matrix for parents S and D and offspring C, assuming only D and C are genotyped, ordered S | D, C.
A=[100.5010.50.50.51],A−1=[1.50.5−10.51.5−1−1−12]
A=\begin{bmatrix}1&0&0.5\\0&1&0.5\\0.5&0.5&1\end{bmatrix},
\quad A^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}1.5&0.5&-1\\0.5&1.5&-1\\-1&-1&2\end{bmatrix}

从 A 抽取 D、C 的行列，再求逆得到下式。
Selecting the D and C rows and columns of A and then inverting gives the following.
A22=[10.50.51],A22−1=[4/3−2/3−2/34/3]
A_{22}=\begin{bmatrix}1&0.5\\0.5&1\end{bmatrix},
\quad A_{22}^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}4/3&-2/3\\-2/3&4/3\end{bmatrix}

这与 A−1A^{-1} 的右下块 [1.5−1−12]\begin{bmatrix}1.5&-1\\-1&2\end{bmatrix} 不同，说明“先取子矩阵再求逆”不等于“先求逆再取子矩阵”。
This differs from the lower-right block [1.5−1−12]\begin{bmatrix}1.5&-1\\-1&2\end{bmatrix} of A−1A^{-1}, showing that subsetting before inversion differs from subsetting after inversion.
再人为给出一个用于演算的兼容尺度正定 G，不把它当作真实 SNP 估计。
Now specify a positive-definite G on a compatible illustrative scale for calculation rather than claiming an actual SNP estimate.
G=[10.20.21],G−1=[25/24−5/24−5/2425/24]
G=\begin{bmatrix}1&0.2\\0.2&1\end{bmatrix},
\quad G^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}25/24&-5/24\\-5/24&25/24\end{bmatrix}

G−1−A22−1=124[−71111−7]
G^{-1}-A_{22}^{-1}=\frac1{24}\begin{bmatrix}-7&11\\11&-7\end{bmatrix}

将修正加入 D、C 的位置，得到完整三动物矩阵。
Adding the correction in the D and C positions gives the full three-animal matrix.
H−1=[3/21/2−11/229/24−13/24−1−13/2441/24]
H^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}
3/2&1/2&-1\\
1/2&29/24&-13/24\\
-1&-13/24&41/24
\end{bmatrix}

修正矩阵的对角元为负不表示负遗传方差，因为它是两个逆矩阵之差，并不是独立的协方差矩阵。
Negative diagonal entries in the correction do not imply negative genetic variance because this is a difference of inverses, not a standalone covariance matrix.

section: 05 · 实际 G 为什么需要标定与稳定化 / Why G needs tuning and stabilization
text:
05 · 实际 G 为什么需要标定与稳定化 / Why G needs tuning and stabilization
G 依赖标记编码、等位基因频率与参考群体，A 则依赖系谱基础假设，两者尺度不能只凭名字默认一致。
G depends on marker coding, allele frequencies, and reference population, while A depends on pedigree-base assumptions, so matching scales cannot be assumed from their names.
标定或调和调整参考水平与尺度，稳定化帮助处理矩阵近奇异等数值问题。
Tuning adjusts reference level and scale, while stabilization helps address numerical problems such as near-singular matrices.
奇异表示矩阵不存在通常意义的逆，小型示例或高度重复的基因型都可能暴露这种问题。
Singular means a matrix lacks an ordinary inverse, which can occur in tiny examples or highly redundant genotypes.
具体调和、混合和权重必须依据软件版本与评估设计，不把本篇 G 直接当作生产设置。
Actual tuning, blending, and weighting depend on software version and evaluation design, and this example G is not a production setting.

section: 06 · 在模型里核对 H 和共同信息 / Check H and Shared Information in the Model
text:
06 · 在模型里核对 H 和共同信息 / Check H and Shared Information in the Model
看到同一头猪同时有系谱和基因组 EBV，我会查是否使用了含 H 的联合模型，以及共享信息在里面怎样处理。
When a pig has both pedigree and genomic EBVs, I check whether a joint model using H was fitted and how it handled shared information.
两套独立 EBV 的平均只是一种结果汇总，单步法的关键在联合模型里的关系协方差构造。
Averaging two separate EBVs summarizes the outputs, while single-step evaluation relies on how relationship covariance is built in the joint model.

只测了背膘时，我会追踪背膘记录怎样经由协方差影响增重的育种值预测，并用两项都有记录的例子对照。
When only backfat is measured, I trace how the record can inform daily-gain breeding value through covariance, then compare it with the case where both traits are recorded.
原始来源是 BREEDPLAN：Multi-Trait Analysis，原对象为肉牛，本篇用原创二性状模型说明通用原理。
The original source is BREEDPLAN: Multi-Trait Analysis, concerning beef cattle, while this note uses an original two-trait model for general principles.

Sources were checked on 2026-10-18, source points are summarized, and teaching data and calculations are original.

section: 01 · 来源要点 / Source points
text:
01 · 来源要点 / Source points
原页强调相关性状可参与 EBV 预测，并讨论联合分析对管理历史和筛选信息的利用。
The page emphasizes using related traits in EBV prediction and discusses joint analysis of management history and selection information.
多性状评估还会增加计算复杂度，模型正确性不能只由“联合分析”这个名称保证。
Multi-trait evaluation also increases computational complexity, and its name alone does not guarantee model correctness.

section: 02 · 两种矩阵不要混淆 / Keep the two matrix types separate
text:
02 · 两种矩阵不要混淆 / Keep the two matrix types separate
动物关系矩阵 A 的行列是动物，而这里的遗传协方差矩阵 ΣA\Sigma_A 的行列是性状。
Rows and columns of relationship matrix A are animals, while those of genetic covariance matrix ΣA\Sigma_A here are traits.
假设性状 1 为日增重、性状 2 为背膘，两者加性遗传方差为 100、4，遗传协方差为 −10。
Suppose Trait 1 is daily gain and Trait 2 backfat, with additive genetic variances 100 and 4 and covariance −10.
ΣA=[100−10−104],rA=−10/100×4=−0.5
\Sigma_A=\begin{bmatrix}100&-10\\-10&4\end{bmatrix},
\quad r_A=-10/\sqrt{100\times4}=-0.5

再假设残差方差为 100、6，残差协方差为 0，且遗传与残差独立。
Also assume residual variances 100 and 6, zero residual covariance, and independence between genetics and residuals.
Σe=[100006],V=ΣA+Σe=[200−10−1010]
\Sigma_e=\begin{bmatrix}100&0\\0&6\end{bmatrix},
\quad V=\Sigma_A+\Sigma_e=\begin{bmatrix}200&-10\\-10&10\end{bmatrix}

title: 07-5｜多性状评估与信息借用 / Multi-trait evaluation and information borrowing
section: 03 · 只测背膘，预测增重遗传值 / Predict gain genetics using only backfat
text:
03 · 只测背膘，预测增重遗传值 / Predict gain genetics using only backfat
假设固定均值和方差已知，一头动物只测得背膘高于基准 2 mm。
Assume known fixed means and variances and one animal measured only for backfat, two mm above its base.
增重加性作用与背膘记录的协方差为 −10，背膘记录方差为 10。
Gain’s additive effect has covariance −10 with the backfat record, whose variance is 10.
Â1=Cov⁡(A1,P2)Var⁡(P2)(P2−μ2)=−1010×2=−2g/day
\widehat A_1=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(A_1,P_2)}{\operatorname{Var}(P_2)}(P_2-\mu_2)
=\frac{-10}{10}\times2=-2\ \mathrm{g/day}

这是一项依赖已知协方差的间接预测，不表示背膘本身就是增重育种值。
This is an indirect prediction relying on known covariance, not a claim that backfat itself is gain breeding value.

section: 04 · 两项记录同时存在时 / When both records exist
text:
04 · 两项记录同时存在时 / When both records exist
若同一动物还测得增重高于基准 20 g/day，则偏差向量为 d=[20,2]′d=[20,2]'。
If the same animal also has gain 20 g/day above base, its deviation vector is d=[20,2]′d=[20,2]'.
目标育种值与两项记录的协方差向量为 c=[100,−10]c=[100,-10]，联合预测为 cV−1dcV^{-1}d。
Covariance between the target breeding value and both records is c=[100,−10]c=[100,-10], giving joint prediction cV−1dcV^{-1}d.
对 2×22\times2 矩阵，逆可通过对角相乘之差作分母、交换对角并改变非对角符号计算。
For a 2×22\times2 matrix, its inverse uses the diagonal-product difference as denominator, swaps diagonal entries, and reverses off-diagonal signs.
V−1=1200×10−(−10)2[101010200]=11900[101010200]
V^{-1}=\frac{1}{200\times10-(-10)^2}
\begin{bmatrix}10&10\\10&200\end{bmatrix}
=\frac1{1900}\begin{bmatrix}10&10\\10&200\end{bmatrix}

cV−1=[9/19,−10/19],Â1=(9/19)20−(10/19)2=160/19≈8.4211
cV^{-1}=[9/19,-10/19],\quad
\widehat A_1=(9/19)20-(10/19)2=160/19\approx8.4211

只用增重自身记录时预测为 (100/200)20=10(100/200)20=10，加入背膘后变为约 8.42，体现新证据的更新而非两个 EBV 的平均。
Own gain alone predicts (100/200)20=10(100/200)20=10, while adding backfat changes it to about 8.42, an evidence update rather than an average of two EBVs.

section: 05 · 信息增加与预测值升降不同 / More information need not increase the EBV
text:
05 · 信息增加与预测值升降不同 / More information need not increase the EBV
在这个正确且方差已知的模型中，单记录 PEV 为 100−1002/200=50100-100^2/200=50。
In this correct known-variance model, the single-record PEV is 100−1002/200=50100-100^2/200=50.
两项联合的 PEV 为 100−cV−1c′=900/19≈47.3684100-cV^{-1}c'=900/19\approx47.3684，不确定性减少，但 EBV 数值下降。
Joint PEV is 100−cV−1c′=900/19≈47.3684100-cV^{-1}c'=900/19\approx47.3684, so uncertainty decreases while the EBV decreases.
信息更充分不等于遗传水平必然更高，而是预测更能反映数据提供的方向。
Better information does not necessarily raise predicted genetic merit but allows the prediction to reflect the evidence.

title: 07-5｜多性状评估与信息借用 / Multi-trait evaluation and information borrowing
section: 06 · 缺失值和选择过程 / Missingness and selection
text:
06 · 缺失值和选择过程 / Missingness and selection
没测背膘不能填成背膘偏差 0，因为未观察不等于恰好达到基准。
Unmeasured backfat cannot be filled with deviation zero because unobserved does not mean exactly at the base.
若只有高增重猪才继续测背膘，测定选择机制应尽可能进入联合信息，而不能假定记录随机缺失。
If only high-gain pigs receive backfat measurements, the selection process should be represented in the joint information rather than assuming random missingness.
联合模型有助于利用相关信息，但不能自动修复未记录的筛选原因或错误身份。
Joint models help use correlated information but do not automatically repair unrecorded selection reasons or incorrect identities.

section: 07 · 评估与综合指数不是一件事 / Evaluation is not an economic index
text:
07 · 评估与综合指数不是一件事 / Evaluation is not an economic index
多性状评估先预测各性状遗传值，综合指数再按育种目标组合这些预测。
Multi-trait evaluation predicts genetic merit for each trait, while a selection index combines predictions according to the breeding objective.
遗传协方差用于描述生物学信息联系，经济权重用于描述目标价值，不能互相替代。
Genetic covariance describes biological information links, while economic weights express objective value, and they are not interchangeable.

section: 02 · 列清数据与假设 / State data and assumptions
text:
02 · 列清数据与假设 / State data and assumptions
两头教学动物的记录为 y=[810,814]′y=[810,814]' g/day，每头一条记录，彼此无关且不近交。
Two hypothetical animals have records y=[810,814]′y=[810,814]' g/day, one per animal, and are unrelated and non-inbred.
未知固定均值记为 bb，两个加性作用记为 a1,a2a_1,a_2，模型为 yi=b+ai+eiy_i=b+a_i+e_i。
Let bb be the unknown fixed mean and a1,a2a_1,a_2 the additive effects, with model yi=b+ai+eiy_i=b+a_i+e_i.
假设遗传与残差彼此独立，各自方差均已知为 1 (g/day)2(g/day)^2，不用于代表真实猪群参数。
Assume independent genetic and residual components, each with known variance 1 (g/day)2(g/day)^2, without representing real-herd parameters.
X=[11],Z=[1001],A=I2,λ=σe2/σA2=1
X=\begin{bmatrix}1\\1\end{bmatrix},\quad
Z=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix},\quad
A=I_2,\quad \lambda=\sigma_e^2/\sigma_A^2=1

XX 的两个 1 让两条记录共享同一个均值，ZZ 则把各条记录连接到各自动物。
The two ones in XX give both records one shared mean, while ZZ connects each record to its animal.

section: 04 · 不用软件也能解 / Solve without specialist software
text:
04 · 不用软件也能解 / Solve without specialist software
第二、三行分别给出 â1=(810−b̂)/2\hat a_1=(810-\hat b)/2、â2=(814−b̂)/2\hat a_2=(814-\hat b)/2。
Rows two and three give â1=(810−b̂)/2\hat a_1=(810-\hat b)/2 and â2=(814−b̂)/2\hat a_2=(814-\hat b)/2.
代入第一行后得到 b̂=812\hat b=812，再回代得到 â1=−1\hat a_1=-1、â2=1\hat a_2=1 g/day。
Substitution into row one gives b̂=812\hat b=812, then back-substitution gives â1=−1\hat a_1=-1 and â2=1\hat a_2=1 g/day.
原始相对均值偏差为 −2、+2，但 EBV 为 −1、+1，展示方差结构带来的收缩。
Raw deviations from the mean are −2 and +2, while EBVs are −1 and +1, illustrating covariance-driven shrinkage.

title: 07-2｜混合模型方程逐步推导 / Mixed model equations step by step
section: 05 · 用正则化直觉再理解 / A regularization interpretation
text:
05 · 用正则化直觉再理解 / A regularization interpretation
本例等价于最小化残差平方与遗传效应平方惩罚之和，惩罚系数由方差比决定。
This example equivalently minimizes squared residuals plus a squared genetic-effect penalty whose weight comes from the variance ratio.
Q=(810−b−a1)2+(814−b−a2)2+λ(a12+a22)
Q=(810-b-a_1)^2+(814-b-a_2)^2+\lambda(a_1^2+a_2^2)

对每个未知量分别求变化率并令其为 0，会得到上面的三行方程。
Setting the rate of change with respect to each unknown to zero gives the three equations above.
若真实模型的方差比改为 λ=4\lambda=4，这个对称例子的均值仍为 812，但 EBV 变为 −2/5,+2/5-2/5,+2/5。
If the model variance ratio changes to λ=4\lambda=4, this symmetric example still has mean 812, while EBVs become −2/5,+2/5-2/5,+2/5.
这不允许为了期望排名任意选择惩罚，方差比必须来自适用模型与数据依据。
This does not permit choosing a penalty to obtain desired rankings, because the variance ratio must be justified by the model and data.

section: 06 · 从系数矩阵检查 PEV / Check PEV from the coefficient matrix
text:
06 · 从系数矩阵检查 PEV / Check PEV from the coefficient matrix
本例矩阵的逆如下，右下 2×22\times2 块乘残差方差 1，才得到动物预测误差协方差。
The inverse below yields animal prediction error covariance by multiplying its lower-right 2×22\times2 block by residual variance 1.
C−1=[1−0.5−0.5−0.50.750.25−0.50.250.75]
C^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}
1&-0.5&-0.5\\
-0.5&0.75&0.25\\
-0.5&0.25&0.75
\end{bmatrix}

两头动物各有 PEV=0.75PEV=0.75、REL=1−0.75/1=0.25REL=1-0.75/1=0.25、ACC=0.5ACC=0.5。
Each animal has PEV=0.75PEV=0.75, REL=1−0.75/1=0.25REL=1-0.75/1=0.25, and ACC=0.5ACC=0.5.
若均值 812 事先完全已知，对应 PEV 是 0.5，说明估计未知均值也会消耗信息。
If the mean 812 were known exactly beforehand, the corresponding PEV would be 0.5, showing the information cost of estimating an unknown mean.

section: 07 · 可运行校验 / Runnable verification
text:
07 · 可运行校验 / Runnable verification
代码只使用标准库和小型消元，不能作为大规模稀疏生产求解器。
The code uses only the standard library and small-scale elimination and is not a large sparse production solver.
def solve(matrix, rhs):
    n = len(rhs)
    rows = [list(map(float, row)) + [float(value)]
            for row, value in zip(matrix, rhs)]
    for j in range(n):
        pivot = max(range(j, n), key=lambda i: abs(rows[i][j]))
        rows[j], rows[pivot] = rows[pivot], rows[j]
        if abs(rows[j][j]) < 1e-12:
            raise ValueError("Singular teaching system")
        scale = rows[j][j]
        rows[j] = [v / scale for v in rows[j]]
        for i in range(n):
            if i != j:
                factor = rows[i][j]
                rows[i] = [a - factor*b for a, b in zip(rows[i], rows[j])]
    return [row[-1] for row in rows]

C = [[2, 1, 1], [1, 2, 0], [1, 0, 2]]
b, a1, a2 = solve(C, [1624, 810, 814])
print(f"mean={b:.2f}; EBV1={a1:.2f}; EBV2={a2:.2f}")
基础 R 可用 solve(C, rhs) 直接解同一组方程，第一行输出与 Python 一致。
Base R uses solve(C, rhs) to solve the same system directly, and its first output line matches Python.
再用 solve(C) 取逆矩阵的右下两行两列，按前一节的残差方差和加性方差复核两头动物的 PEV、REL 与 ACC。
Then solve(C) supplies the lower-right two-by-two block of the inverse, and the residual and additive variances from the previous section give PEV, REL, and ACC for both animals.
C <- matrix(c(
  2, 1, 1,
  1, 2, 0,
  1, 0, 2
), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
rhs <- c(1624, 810, 814)

solution <- solve(C, rhs)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(drop(C %*% solution), rhs)))
cat(sprintf(
  "mean=%.2f; EBV1=%.2f; EBV2=%.2f\n",
  solution[1], solution[2], solution[3]
))

residual_var <- 1
additive_var <- 1
animal_rows <- 2:3
pev_matrix <- solve(C)[animal_rows, animal_rows] * residual_var
pev <- diag(pev_matrix)
rel <- 1 - pev / additive_var
acc <- sqrt(rel)

stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  pev_matrix, matrix(c(0.75, 0.25, 0.25, 0.75), nrow = 2)
)))
for (i in seq_along(pev)) {
  cat(sprintf("animal=%d; PEV=%.2f; REL=%.2f; ACC=%.2f\n",
              i, pev[i], rel[i], acc[i]))
}

section: 02 · PEV 的单位和方向 / PEV units and direction

02 · PEV 的单位和方向 / PEV units and direction
设真实育种值为 aia_i、预测值为 âi\hat a_i，预测误差写作 εi=âi−ai\varepsilon_i=\hat a_i-a_i。
Let true breeding value be aia_i, prediction be âi\hat a_i, and prediction error be εi=âi−ai\varepsilon_i=\hat a_i-a_i.
预测误差方差 PEV是模型下这项误差的方差，不是 EBV 在动物之间的样本方差。
Prediction error variance (PEV) is the model-based variance of this error, not the sample variance of EBVs among animals.
EBV 以 g/day 计量时，PEV 的单位为 (g/day)2(g/day)^2，PEV\sqrt{PEV} 才回到 g/day。
With EBVs in g/day, PEV has units (g/day)2(g/day)^2, while PEV\sqrt{PEV} returns to g/day.

title: 06-3｜PEV、可靠性与输出字段 / PEV, reliability, and output fields
section: 03 · 从 PEV 算 REL 与 ACC / Calculate REL and ACC from PEV
text:
03 · 从 PEV 算 REL 与 ACC / Calculate REL and ACC from PEV
在适用的标准加性模型中，用动物自身的先验遗传方差 Gii=(1+Fi)σA2G_{ii}=(1+F_i)\sigma_A^2 作分母。
In the applicable standard additive model, use the animal’s prior genetic variance Gii=(1+Fi)σA2G_{ii}=(1+F_i)\sigma_A^2 as denominator.
RELi=1−PEViGii,ACCi=RELi
REL_i=1-\frac{PEV_i}{G_{ii}},\qquad ACC_i=\sqrt{REL_i}

假设 Fi=0.25F_i=0.25、σA2=100\sigma_A^2=100、PEVi=50PEV_i=50，则 Gii=125G_{ii}=125。
If Fi=0.25F_i=0.25, σA2=100\sigma_A^2=100, and PEVi=50PEV_i=50, then Gii=125G_{ii}=125.
RELi=1−50/125=0.60,ACCi=0.60≈0.7746
REL_i=1-50/125=0.60,\qquad ACC_i=\sqrt{0.60}\approx0.7746

错误地忽略 FiF_i 会算成 1−50/100=0.501-50/100=0.50，所以必须核对系统分母定义。
Ignoring FiF_i would incorrectly give 1−50/100=0.501-50/100=0.50, demonstrating why system denominator conventions matter.
不是每个软件都采用完全相同的基准、近似和近交处理，不能只把公式硬套到现成列上。
Software can differ in bases, approximations, and inbreeding treatment, so the formula must not be imposed blindly on an existing column.



由预测误差方差计算可靠性与准确度 / Reliability and accuracy from prediction error variance


图 06-3A　在本例的标准加性模型中，先用 Fi=0.25F_i=0.25 得到个体先验遗传方差 Gii=125(g/day)2G_{ii}=125\,(\mathrm{g/day})^2，再求得可靠性 0.600.60 和准确度约 0.77460.7746。
Figure 06-3A　Under the example’s standard additive model, Fi=0.25F_i=0.25 gives an individual prior genetic variance of Gii=125(g/day)2G_{ii}=125\,(\mathrm{g/day})^2, then a reliability of 0.600.60 and accuracy of about 0.77460.7746.
预测误差方差与遗传方差都用性状单位的平方，可靠性与准确度均无单位。
Prediction error variance and genetic variance both use squared trait units, and reliability and accuracy are unitless.

text:
04 · 为什么不能直接取方程左边的对角数 / Why a coefficient diagonal is not PEV
设单性状方程已乘以残差方差，系数矩阵记为 CC，其右下块含 Z′Z+λA−1Z'Z+\lambda A^{-1}。
Let CC be the coefficient matrix for single-trait equations scaled by residual variance, with bottom-right block Z′Z+λA−1Z'Z+\lambda A^{-1}.
预测误差来自整个系数矩阵的逆的对应随机效应块，不是原系数矩阵的对角线。
Prediction errors come from the corresponding random-effect block of the inverse of the whole coefficient matrix, not the original coefficient diagonal.
PEV=σe2(C−1)aa
PEV=\sigma_e^2(C^{-1})_{aa}

还要保留这里的 σe2\sigma_e^2 尺度因子，而一般加权或多性状方程的尺度应按其定义处理。
The σe2\sigma_e^2 scale factor must be retained here, while weighted or multi-trait equations require their own scaling conventions.

section: 05 · 一列 0.64 的两种解释 / Two interpretations of 0.64
text:
05 · 一列 0.64 的两种解释 / Two interpretations of 0.64
假设某输出写着 animal=P1, ebv=30, acc=0.64，只看这一行无法确定尺度。
Suppose an output says animal=P1, ebv=30, acc=0.64, which alone does not establish its scale.

若元数据确认 acc 存 REL，则准确度为 0.64=0.8\sqrt{0.64}=0.8。
If metadata confirm acc stores REL, accuracy is 0.64=0.8\sqrt{0.64}=0.8.
若元数据确认 acc 存 ACC，则可靠性为 0.642=0.40960.64^2=0.4096。
If metadata confirm acc stores ACC, reliability is 0.642=0.40960.64^2=0.4096.
若显示的是百分数，还要先把 64 转为 0.64，而不能直接平方 64。
If values are percentages, convert 64 to 0.64 before squaring rather than squaring 64 directly.

核对顺序应是软件与版本、运行选项、文件说明、尺度、性状与动物编号，最后才是计算。
Check software and version, run options, file documentation, scale, trait, and animal ID before calculating.

section: 06 · 近似可靠性为何需要说明 / Why approximate reliability needs labeling
text:
06 · 近似可靠性为何需要说明 / Why approximate reliability needs labeling
大规模方程显式求逆代价很高，原页介绍基于有效信息或后代信息的近似方法。
Explicit inversion of large systems is costly, and the source introduces approximations based on effective information or progeny information.
同样叫 REL 的两列可能来自不同近似，不应默认最后几位差异有生物学意义。
Two REL columns can come from different approximations, so differences in their last digits are not automatically biologically meaningful.
出现负值或大于 1 的值时，先检查定义、尺度、近似和数值问题，不能直接截断后称为已验证准确度。
For values below zero or above one, inspect definitions, scales, approximation, and numerical issues rather than clipping them and calling the result validated accuracy.

title: 06-0｜育种值与准确度 / Breeding values and accuracy
section: 01 · BV 和 EBV 是什么 / What BV and EBV mean
text:
01 · BV 和 EBV 是什么 / What BV and EBV mean
育种值 BV是动物对指定性状的加性遗传价值，按参考群体定义。
A breeding value (BV) is additive genetic merit for a specified trait, defined relative to a reference population.
真实 BV 通常不能直接观察。
True BV is usually unobservable.
估计育种值 EBV利用自身、亲属及可能的基因组信息来预测 BV。
An estimated breeding value (EBV) predicts BV using own, relative, and possibly genomic information.
BV 和 EBV 都不是对动物未来实际表现的保证。
Neither BV nor EBV guarantees future actual performance.

用计算机理解 / A computing analogy

表型像受运行环境影响的观测输出。
Phenotype resembles observed output affected by the runtime environment.
BV像希望识别的潜在遗传信号。
BV resembles the latent genetic signal of interest.
EBV像模型对这个信号的估计。
EBV resembles the model’s estimate of that signal.

这个类比只区分观测与潜在量，不意味着 DNA 是确定性程序。
This analogy distinguishes observed and latent quantities without implying that DNA is a deterministic program.

title: 06-0｜育种值与准确度 / Breeding values and accuracy
section: 02 · 先读单位和基准 / Read units and the base first
text:
02 · 先读单位和基准 / Read units and the base first
假设 ADG EBV 为 +30 g/day，它表示相对评估基准的加性遗传优势。
A hypothetical ADG EBV of +30 g/day indicates an additive advantage relative to the evaluation base.
它不表示实际日增重只有 30 g/day。
It does not mean actual daily gain is only 30 g/day.
EBV 为零表示处于该基准，不表示没有遗传价值。
An EBV of zero denotes the reference base, not absence of genetic merit.
在 FCR 或达重日龄等越小越好的性状上，负 EBV 可能有利。
Negative EBVs can be favorable for traits such as FCR or days to target weight.
读一个 EBV，至少确认以下六项。
Confirm at least the following six items when interpreting an EBV.

性状定义决定它在比较什么。
The trait definition establishes what is being compared.
单位决定数值如何解释。
Units establish how to interpret the number.
基准决定零点在哪里。
The base establishes the reference zero.
评估群体决定比较对象。
The evaluation population establishes the comparison group.
版本或日期决定使用哪次评估。
The version or date identifies the evaluation used.
准确度说明估计的不确定程度。
Accuracy describes uncertainty in the estimate.

不同场、品种或系统的 EBV，直接比较需要共同评估或经过验证的可比标定。
Direct comparison across farms, breeds, or systems requires a shared evaluation or validated calibration.
跨场比较还需要足够的遗传联系。
Across-farm comparison also requires sufficient genetic connectedness.

title: 06-0｜育种值与准确度 / Breeding values and accuracy
section: 03 · 后代差异为什么通常除以 2 / Why progeny differences use one-half
text:
03 · 后代差异为什么通常除以 2 / Why progeny differences use one-half
假设同一评估中，两头公猪的 ADG EBV 分别为 +40 和 +10 g/day。
Suppose two boars in the same evaluation have ADG EBVs of +40 and +10 g/day.
如果母猪群遗传水平相当、后代环境相当，后代群体期望差异为 15 g/day。
With genetically equivalent mates and comparable offspring environments, the expected progeny-group difference is 15 g/day.
计算为 (40−10)/2=15(40-10)/2=15，因为父母各贡献一半常染色体遗传信息。
The calculation is (40−10)/2=15(40-10)/2=15, because each parent contributes half the autosomal genetic material.
EPD是预期后代差异，常见口径约为 EBV/2EBV/2。
An expected progeny difference (EPD) is commonly on the EBV/2EBV/2 scale.
如果字段已经是 EPD，核对口径后不要再除以 2。
If a field already reports EPD, check its definition and do not halve it again.
个体后代仍会因孟德尔抽样和环境而偏离群体期望。
Individual offspring still deviate from group expectations through Mendelian sampling and environment.

亲本均值与孟德尔抽样 / Parent average and Mendelian sampling
真实子代育种值等于“父母真实育种值的平均 + 孟德尔抽样偏离”。
An offspring’s true breeding value equals “the mean of the parents’ true breeding values + Mendelian-sampling deviation.”
BVC=12BVS+12BVD+MSC,E(MSC∣parents)=0
BV_C=\tfrac12 BV_S+\tfrac12 BV_D+MS_C,\qquad
E(MS_C\mid\text{parents})=0

假设父母真实 BV 为 +40 和 +20，子代条件期望为 +30，但各个同胞仍可不同。
If the parents’ true BVs are +40 and +20, the conditional offspring expectation is +30, while individual siblings can differ.
这里描述的是加性遗传值，不包含全部环境和杂种优势。
This describes additive genetic merit, not the complete effects of environment and heterosis.
实际不知道真实 BV 时，父母 EBV 的平均可作为子代初步预测。
When true BVs are unknown, the mean of parental EBVs can provide an initial offspring prediction.
自身、同胞、后代或基因组信息可以进一步更新预测。
Own, sibling, progeny, or genomic information can update that prediction.
父母 EBV 仍是估计，需要结合准确度、共同信息和基准理解。
Parental EBVs remain estimates whose accuracies, shared information, and bases must be considered.

title: 06-0｜育种值与准确度 / Breeding values and accuracy
section: 04 · ACC、REL 与 PEV / Accuracy, reliability, and PEV
text:
04 · ACC、REL 与 PEV / Accuracy, reliability, and PEV

准确度 ACC描述预测育种值与真实育种值的相关程度。
Accuracy (ACC) describes the correlation between predicted and true breeding value.
可靠性 REL通常是准确度的平方，即 REL=ACC2REL=ACC^2。
Reliability (REL) is usually squared accuracy, or REL=ACC2REL=ACC^2.
预测误差方差 PEV衡量 BV̂−BV\widehat{BV}-BV 的误差变异。
Prediction error variance (PEV) measures variation in BV̂−BV\widehat{BV}-BV.

假设 ACC = 0.80，则 REL = 0.64。
If ACC = 0.80, then REL = 0.64.
这不是“有 80% 概率该 EBV 完全正确”。
This is not an 80% probability that the EBV is exactly correct.
在方差已知、基准一致的标准模型下，常用 RELi=1−PEVi/[(1+Fi)σA2]REL_i=1-PEV_i/[(1+F_i)\sigma_A^2]。
Under a standard model with known variances and a consistent base, a common expression is RELi=1−PEVi/[(1+Fi)σA2]REL_i=1-PEV_i/[(1+F_i)\sigma_A^2].
实际系统可能采用近似或不同定义，必须核对字段口径。
Actual systems may use approximations or different conventions, so check field definitions.
仅凭一个 EBV 数字，不能反推出 ACC。
An EBV value alone cannot determine ACC.

我读教学报表时会先圈出性状、基准和日期，再把估值与把握程度拆开。
In a teaching report, I mark the trait, base, and date first, then read the estimate and its certainty separately.
例如同次评估中有两行日增重 EBV，先约定单位都是 g/day、基准相同、准确度都采用 ACC 口径。
For two daily-gain EBV rows in the same evaluation, suppose both use g/day, share a base, and report accuracy as ACC.

In this table, A has the higher estimated genetic merit and B has the more certain estimate.
把 ACC 平方就能得到右边的 REL，甲的 0.49 和乙的 0.64 都来自同一份评估。
Squaring ACC gives the REL in the right-hand column, with A’s 0.49 and B’s 0.64 both coming from the same evaluation.

section: 05 · 价值高，不等于把握大 / High merit is not high certainty
text:
05 · 价值高，不等于把握大 / High merit is not high certainty
高 EBV、低 ACC可能有潜力，但未来更新幅度也可能较大。
High EBV with low ACC may be promising but subject to larger future revisions.
较低 EBV、高 ACC说明信息较充分，却不自动代表遗传价值更高。
Lower EBV with high ACC is better supported but not automatically genetically superior.
不要把 ACC 再乘到 EBV 上当作折扣，因为信息不足带来的收缩通常已在评估中体现。
Do not multiply EBV by ACC as a discount, because the evaluation usually already accounts for limited information through shrinkage.
估计不确定性带来的决策风险需要另行考虑。
Decision risk from estimation uncertainty needs separate consideration.

我的核对笔记 / My Verification Notes
换一组容易核对的数，在同一基准下两头公猪的日增重 EBV 为 +50 和 +10 g/day。
For another easy-to-check example, two boars on the same base have daily-gain EBVs of +50 and +10 g/day.
若与遗传水平相当的母猪群配对且后代环境可比，后代群均值的期望差是 (50−10)/2=20(50-10)/2=20 g/day，已用 EPD 尺度报告时只需比较两项 EPD。
With genetically equivalent mates and comparable offspring environments, the expected progeny-group difference is (50−10)/2=20(50-10)/2=20 g/day, and if both are already reported as EPDs, compare those two EPDs directly.
准确度为 0.70 时，可靠性是 0.702=0.490.70^2=0.49，但单看 EBV 为 +20 无法反推出准确度。
An accuracy of 0.70 gives reliability 0.702=0.490.70^2=0.49, and an EBV of +20 alone does not reveal the accuracy.

text:
02 · 三个量分别描述什么 / What do the three quantities describe?

A 元素 AijA_{ij}描述动物 i,ji,j 相对基准的加性遗传协方差比例。
An A entry AijA_{ij} describes the additive genetic covariance between animals i,ji,j relative to the base variance.
共祖系数 ϕij\phi_{ij}是从两头动物各随机取一个常染色体等位基因拷贝，两者同祖同源的概率。
Kinship ϕij\phi_{ij} is the probability that autosomal allele copies sampled one from each animal are identical by descent.
个体近交系数 FkF_k描述同一个体两个对应拷贝同祖同源的概率。
Individual inbreeding FkF_k describes the probability that the corresponding two copies within one animal are identical by descent.

在相同基准和标准系谱定义下，Aij=2ϕijA_{ij}=2\phi_{ij}，而子代 FF 等于父母共祖。
Under the same base and standard pedigree definitions, Aij=2ϕijA_{ij}=2\phi_{ij} and offspring FF equals parental kinship.
FC=ϕS,D=AS,D2,ACC=1+FC
F_C=\phi_{S,D}=\frac{A_{S,D}}{2},\qquad A_{CC}=1+F_C

section: 03 · 先构建一个小 A 矩阵 / Build a small A matrix
text:
03 · 先构建一个小 A 矩阵 / Build a small A matrix
假设基础动物 S、D 互不相关且不近交，C1、C2 都是它们的子代。
Assume founders S and D are unrelated and non-inbred, and C1 and C2 are offspring of both.
对父母先于后代排序的系谱，后代与较早动物 jj 的关系可递推为父母关系的平均。
With parents ordered before offspring, an offspring’s relationship to an earlier animal jj is recursively the average parental relationship.
Aij=12(Asi,j+Adi,j),Aii=1+12Asi,di
A_{ij}=\tfrac12(A_{s_i,j}+A_{d_i,j}),\qquad
A_{ii}=1+\tfrac12 A_{s_i,d_i}

先算 C1 与 S：(ASS+ADS)/2=(1+0)/2=0.5(A_{SS}+A_{DS})/2=(1+0)/2=0.5。
First calculate C1 with S: (ASS+ADS)/2=(1+0)/2=0.5(A_{SS}+A_{DS})/2=(1+0)/2=0.5.
再算 C2 与 C1：(AS,C1+AD,C1)/2=(0.5+0.5)/2=0.5(A_{S,C1}+A_{D,C1})/2=(0.5+0.5)/2=0.5。
Then calculate C2 with C1: (AS,C1+AD,C1)/2=(0.5+0.5)/2=0.5(A_{S,C1}+A_{D,C1})/2=(0.5+0.5)/2=0.5.
A=[100.50.5010.50.50.50.510.50.50.50.51]S,D,C1,C2
A=\begin{bmatrix}
1&0&0.5&0.5\\
0&1&0.5&0.5\\
0.5&0.5&1&0.5\\
0.5&0.5&0.5&1
\end{bmatrix}_{S,D,C1,C2}

矩阵对角线为 1，是因为这四头在当前基础假设下都不近交，不是因为动物与自身“没有近交风险”。
The diagonal is 1 because these four animals are non-inbred under the stated base assumptions, not because self-relatedness means no inbreeding risk.

section: 04 · 由父母关系计算子代 F / Calculate offspring F
text:
04 · 由父母关系计算子代 F / Calculate offspring F
若把全同胞 C1、C2 作为一对假设父母，它们子代的 F=0.5/2=0.25F=0.5/2=0.25。
If full siblings C1 and C2 are hypothetical parents, their offspring has F=0.5/2=0.25F=0.5/2=0.25.
这个子代的对角元为 1+0.25=1.251+0.25=1.25，而不是 0.25。
That offspring’s diagonal entry is 1+0.25=1.251+0.25=1.25, not 0.25.
若父母是无其他背景亲缘的半同胞，A=0.25A=0.25，所以子代 F=0.125F=0.125。
For half-sibling parents without additional background relationships, A=0.25A=0.25 and offspring F=0.125F=0.125.
这两例用于识别系数尺度，不构成推荐这种选配的建议。
These examples identify coefficient scales and do not recommend these matings.

section: 05 · 标准化关系 R 为什么有时不等于 A / Why normalized R can differ from A
text:
05 · 标准化关系 R 为什么有时不等于 A / Why normalized R can differ from A
常见标准化加性关系定义为 Rij=Aij/AiiAjjR_{ij}=A_{ij}/\sqrt{A_{ii}A_{jj}}。
A common normalized additive relationship is Rij=Aij/AiiAjjR_{ij}=A_{ij}/\sqrt{A_{ii}A_{jj}}.
沿上例让 C1、C2 再产生两个全同胞 X、Y，则 X、Y 各有 F=0.25F=0.25，且 AXY=0.75A_{XY}=0.75。
Continuing the example, let C1 and C2 produce full siblings X and Y, each with F=0.25F=0.25 and with AXY=0.75A_{XY}=0.75.
这里 AC1,Y=(1+0.5)/2=0.75A_{C1,Y}=(1+0.5)/2=0.75，另一亲本相同，所以再取父母平均仍为 0.75。
Here AC1,Y=(1+0.5)/2=0.75A_{C1,Y}=(1+0.5)/2=0.75, with the same relationship for the other parent, so averaging the parental values again gives 0.75.
因此 RXY=0.75/1.25=0.6R_{XY}=0.75/1.25=0.6，共祖为 0.75/2=0.3750.75/2=0.375，不能把标准化 R 再除以 2 得到子代近交。
Therefore RXY=0.75/1.25=0.6R_{XY}=0.75/1.25=0.6 and kinship is 0.75/2=0.3750.75/2=0.375, so halving normalized R would not give offspring inbreeding.

text:
06 · F 不是疾病概率 / F is not a disease probability
同祖同源 IBD指来自同一祖先拷贝，区别于仅观察到两个字母相同。
Identity by descent (IBD) means descent from one ancestral copy, unlike merely observing matching allele labels.
F=0.25F=0.25 不是有 25% 概率患病，也不表示 25% 的全部 DNA 序列相同。
F=0.25F=0.25 is neither a 25% disease probability nor a claim that 25% of the entire DNA sequence matches.
近交会增加同祖纯合的机会，可能带来隐性有害变异表达和近交衰退，但具体损失需要群体与性状证据。
Inbreeding increases autozygosity and can expose harmful recessives and cause inbreeding depression, but specific losses require population- and trait-specific evidence.

07 · 报表只写亲缘 0.25 时，先认尺度 / Identify the Scale of a Reported Relationship of 0.25
报表只写「亲缘 0.25」时，我会先查它表示 A 元素、共祖系数、标准化关系还是基因组指标，也会查参考基准。
When a report gives only “relationship 0.25,” I look up whether it is an A entry, kinship, normalized relationship, or a genomic measure, as well as its reference base.

Under the standard pedigree definition used here, I use 0.25/2=0.1250.25/2=0.125 for offspring inbreeding only after confirming the parents’ A entry is 0.25.

01 · 谁和谁是一家 / Defining families

家系是一组具有指定亲缘关系的动物。
A family groups animals by a specified relationship.
系谱记录谁是谁的父母。
A pedigree records parentage.
全同胞同父同母。
Full siblings share both parents.
父系半同胞同父异母。
Paternal half siblings share a sire but have different dams.
母系半同胞同母异父。
Maternal half siblings share a dam but have different sires.
同窝指同一次分娩的仔猪，是出生批次概念。
A litter consists of piglets from one farrowing event and describes a birth group.

同窝记录不能代替可靠的父母身份。
Litter membership does not replace reliable parentage information.

text:
02 · 用数据库理解系谱 / A database view of pedigrees
最小系谱可以存成 animal_id, sire_id, dam_id 三列。
A minimal pedigree can use three columns: animal_id, sire_id, dam_id.
其中 sire 是父亲，dam 是母亲，父母编号指向同一动物表。
Sire means father and dam means mother, with their IDs referencing the same animal table.
下面是假设系谱，0 表示未知父母。
In the hypothetical pedigree below, zero represents an unknown parent.
animal_id,sire_id,dam_id
S,0,0
D,0,0
C1,S,D
C2,S,D
D2,0,0
C3,S,D2

C1 与 C2 是全同胞。
C1 and C2 are full siblings.
C1 与 C3 是父系半同胞。
C1 and C3 are paternal half siblings.




最小系谱中的全同胞和父系半同胞 / Full and paternal half siblings in a small pedigree


图 05-0A　C1 和 C2 的父母都是 S 与 D，因此是全同胞。
Figure 05-0A　C1 and C2 both have S and D as parents, so they are full siblings.
C1 和 C3 共享父亲 S，母亲分别是 D 和 D2，因此是父系半同胞。
C1 and C3 share sire S and have different dams, D and D2, making them paternal half siblings.
未知父亲不是一头被所有相关记录共享的真实公猪。
An unknown sire is not one real boar shared by all records using that code.
系谱是有向无环图，动物不能成为自己的祖先。
A pedigree is a directed acyclic graph, so an animal cannot be its own ancestor.
父母出生时间应早于后代。
Parents must be born before their offspring.
未知祖先通常相对某个基准作处理，不代表生物学上绝无亲缘。
Missing ancestry is treated relative to a base, not as proof of biological unrelatedness.

section: 03 · A 矩阵把关系排成表 / A arranges relationships into a matrix
text:
03 · A 矩阵把关系排成表 / A arranges relationships into a matrix
假设基础祖先彼此无关且不近交，常见加性亲缘关系如下。
Under unrelated, non-inbred founders, common additive relationships are as follows.

亲子：0.5。
Parent–offspring: 0.5.
全同胞：期望为 0.5。
Full siblings: an expected 0.5.
半同胞：0.25。
Half siblings: 0.25.
祖孙：0.25。
Grandparent–grandchild: 0.25.

这些数值衡量相对基准的加性遗传联系，不是 DNA 序列相同的百分比。
These values quantify additive genetic connections relative to a base, not percentages of identical DNA sequence.
将所有两两关系排成矩阵，就得到 A。
Arranging all pairwise relationships gives the A matrix.
按 S、D、C1 的顺序，矩阵如下。
In the order S, D, C1, the matrix is shown below.
𝑨=[100.5010.50.50.51]
\mathbf A=\begin{bmatrix}
1&0&0.5\\
0&1&0.5\\
0.5&0.5&1
\end{bmatrix}

A 可以类比为样本联系图，但其数值必须服从生物学结构。
A resembles a sample-connection graph, but its values must follow biological structure.

section: 04 · 近交不是患病概率 / Inbreeding is not a disease probability
text:
04 · 近交不是患病概率 / Inbreeding is not a disease probability
近交系数 FiF_i 是个体同一常染色体位点的两个等位基因拷贝相对基准同祖同源的概率。
The inbreeding coefficient, FiF_i, is the probability that the two allele copies at an autosomal locus are identical by descent relative to the base.
A 的对角元为 Aii=1+FiA_{ii}=1+F_i。
The diagonal element is Aii=1+FiA_{ii}=1+F_i.
父母关系越近，子代近交风险通常越高，但 F 不是患病概率。
More-related parents generally imply greater offspring inbreeding, but F is not a probability of illness.
Foffspring=Asire,dam2=ϕsire,dam
F_{\text{offspring}}=\frac{A_{\text{sire,dam}}}{2}
=\phi_{\text{sire,dam}}

其中 ϕ\phi 是亲缘共祖系数，英文为 kinship 或 coancestry。
Here ϕ\phi is kinship, also called coancestry.
在没有其他亲缘背景时，全同胞配对子代的 F=0.25F=0.25。
With no additional background relationship, full-sib mating gives offspring F=0.25F=0.25.
相同条件下，半同胞配对子代的 F=0.125F=0.125。
Under the same assumptions, half-sib mating gives offspring F=0.125F=0.125.
引用“亲缘系数”前，要先确认资料指的是 A 元素还是 ϕ\phi。
Before using a “relationship coefficient,” establish whether it denotes an A-matrix element or ϕ\phi.

section: 05 · 家系均值为什么不够 / Why family means are incomplete
text:
05 · 家系均值为什么不够 / Why family means are incomplete
一个家系表现好，可能来自遗传，也可能来自同窝、同栏或相同管理。
A good family average may reflect genetics, a shared litter or pen, or management.
只按家系均值选择，会漏掉家系内部的优秀个体，也可能把共享环境当作遗传。
Selecting solely by family mean can miss outstanding individuals within families and mistake shared environment for inheritance.
动物模型通过系谱联系和环境结构，综合利用家系信息。
Animal models combine pedigree connections with environmental structure to use family information.

section: 02 · 先分清值与方差 / Distinguish values from variances
text:
02 · 先分清值与方差 / Distinguish values from variances
育种值是动物的加性遗传水平，加性遗传方差描述群体内这些水平的分散。
A breeding value is an animal’s additive genetic level, while additive genetic variance describes spread in these levels within a population.
均值和方差可以独立变化，所以平均生长更快的群体不必然有更高遗传力。
Means and variances can change separately, so a faster-growing population does not necessarily have higher heritability.
狭义遗传力 h2h^2 是指定模型、群体和环境下，加性遗传方差占表型方差的比例。
Narrow-sense heritability h2h^2 is the ratio of additive genetic variance to phenotypic variance for a specified model, population, and environment.
h2=σA2/σP2
h^2=\sigma_A^2/\sigma_P^2

text:
03 · 从方差算到遗传力 / Calculate heritability from variances
假设校正固定条件后的日增重模型只有加性作用与独立残差，方差分别为 300、700 (g/day)2(g/day)^2。
Suppose adjusted daily gain contains only additive genetics and independent residuals with variances 300 and 700 (g/day)2(g/day)^2.
σP2=300+700=1000,h2=300/1000=0.30
\sigma_P^2=300+700=1000,\qquad h^2=300/1000=0.30

它不是“某头猪的 800 g/day 中，有 240 g/day 来自基因”，因为比例的分子与分母都是方差。
This does not mean 240 g/day of one pig’s 800 g/day comes from genes, because both numerator and denominator are variances.
若再有永久环境、同窝或其他随机分量，表型方差的分母也必须反映相应模型。
Adding permanent-environmental, litter, or other random components requires their appropriate inclusion in phenotypic variance.

04 · 为什么控制环境会改变比例 / Why environmental control changes the ratio
假设两个管理组之间还存在方差为 1000 的系统差异，且与上述分量无关。
Suppose management groups add systematic variance of 1000, uncorrelated with the components above.
混在一起的原始方差为 2000，用同一加性方差计算的比例变成 300/2000=0.15300/2000=0.15。
The pooled raw variance becomes 2000, giving a ratio of 300/2000=0.15300/2000=0.15 with the same additive variance.
正确建模管理组后得到 0.30，不表示猪的基因突然变好，而是比较条件和方差口径改变。
Obtaining 0.30 after modeling management groups does not mean the pigs’ genes suddenly improved, but that the comparison and variance definition changed.
这只是独立分量的教学分解，实际管理组与遗传来源纠缠时还要处理混杂。
This is a teaching decomposition of independent components, while real entanglement of management and genetic sources requires addressing confounding.

05 · 用于单条记录的简化预测 / A simplified single-record predictor
在均值、方差已知且环境已校正等条件下，育种值的最佳线性预测可写成遗传力乘以表型偏差。
With known mean and variances and adjusted environmental conditions, the best linear predictor of breeding value can be written as heritability times phenotypic deviation.
BV̂=h2(P−μ)=0.3(850−800)=15g/day
\widehat{BV}=h^2(P-\mu)=0.3(850-800)=15\ \mathrm{g/day}

观察偏差 50 并未全部归到遗传，剩余部分反映对环境和不确定性的处理。
The observed deviation of 50 is not attributed entirely to genetics, reflecting the treatment of environment and uncertainty.
完整 BLUP 还利用亲属、固定效应和协方差，不能在任意报表上照搬“原始表现乘 0.3”。
Full BLUP also uses relatives, fixed effects, and covariances, so “raw performance times 0.3” is not a general reporting rule.

06 · 用于选择反应的另一个问题 / A different use in selection response
在简单表型选择、两性选择结构匹配等假设下，下一代均值的期望改变为 R=h2SR=h^2S。
Under assumptions for simple phenotypic selection and a matching sex-selection structure, the expected next-generation mean change is R=h2SR=h^2S.
若候选均值为 800、入选父母平均为 850，则选择差 S=50S=50，期望反应为 R=15R=15 g/day。
If candidates average 800 and selected parents average 850, the selection differential is S=50S=50 and expected response is R=15R=15 g/day.
这里的 RR 是群体跨代反应，而上一节的 15 是一个动物的预测，数字相同不代表统计对象相同。
Here RR is population response across generations, while the previous 15 predicts one animal, so matching numbers do not mean matching statistical targets.
更完整的进展解释见 年度遗传进展。
See annual genetic progress for the fuller response framework.

section: 02 · 有效数字不等于小数位 / Significant digits versus decimal places
text:
02 · 有效数字不等于小数位 / Significant digits versus decimal places
小数位从小数点后开始计数，有效数字从第一个非零数字开始计数并保留反映精度的数字。
Decimal places count positions after the decimal point, while significant digits begin at the first nonzero digit and retain digits expressing precision.
例如 0.008165 有六位小数、四位有效数字，而 81.65 有两位小数、同样四位有效数字。
For example, 0.008165 has six decimal places and four significant digits, whereas 81.65 has two decimal places and also four significant digits.
舍入是按指定精度缩短数字，本教程通常在计算末尾才舍入，避免中间误差累积。
Rounding shortens a number to a specified precision, and this tutorial usually rounds only final results to avoid accumulating intermediate error.

title: 03-3｜均值方差标准差与数值校验详读 / Mean, variance, standard deviation, and numerical checks
section: 03 · 同一数据为什么会有两个方差 / Why the same data can have two variances
text:
03 · 同一数据为什么会有两个方差 / Why the same data can have two variances
设 x=[700,800,800,900]x=[700,800,800,900]，其均值为 800，离差平方和为 20,00020{,}000。
Let x=[700,800,800,900]x=[700,800,800,900], with mean 800 and squared-deviation sum 20,00020{,}000.
若将这些记录视为来自更大总体的样本，并由同一样本估计均值，则通常计算样本方差。
Treating these observations as a sample from a larger population and estimating the mean from that sample gives the usual sample variance.
s2=20,0004−1=6666.666666…,s=81.649658…
s^2=\frac{20{,}000}{4-1}=6666.666666\ldots,
\qquad s=81.649658\ldots

若只想描述这四个数构成的完整总体，则计算总体平均平方偏离。
Describing these four values as the complete population instead gives their population mean squared deviation.
σfour2=20,0004=5000,σfour=70.710678…
\sigma_{\mathrm{four}}^2=\frac{20{,}000}{4}=5000,
\qquad\sigma_{\mathrm{four}}=70.710678\ldots

两者回答不同问题，并不是某个软件算错了，也不能根据哪个数“看起来合理”选择分母。
The two calculations answer different questions rather than indicating a software error, and the denominator must not be chosen by which result looks preferable.
Python 官方文档的 variance 和 stdev 使用样本约定，pvariance 和 pstdev 使用总体约定。
In the official Python documentation, variance and stdev use sample conventions, while pvariance and pstdev use population conventions.
主文第 05 节用四种等概率样本解释 n−1n-1 的无偏修正，本篇代码同时输出两种约定以便对照。
Section 05 of the chapter explains the n−1n-1 correction using four equally likely samples, and the code here prints both conventions for comparison.

title: 03-3｜均值方差标准差与数值校验详读 / Mean, variance, standard deviation, and numerical checks
section: 04 · 用标准库完整复算 / Recompute everything with the standard library
text:
04 · 用标准库完整复算 / Recompute everything with the standard library
下面代码只使用 Python 3 标准库，无需安装第三方包，复制到本地运行即可得到随后列出的输出。
The following code uses only the Python 3 standard library, requires no third-party packages, and produces the output listed below when run locally.
输入是自拟的完整数值记录，真实数据中的缺失、非数值和配对问题应先处理。
The inputs are complete, original teaching records, and real missing values, nonnumeric entries, and pairing issues require prior handling.
import math
import statistics as st

x = [700, 800, 800, 900]
y = [2, 3, 4, 3]
assert len(x) == len(y) == 4, "This worked example uses n=4"

n = len(x)
mx, my = st.mean(x), st.mean(y)
dx = [v - mx for v in x]
dy = [v - my for v in y]
ssx = math.fsum(v * v for v in dx)
ssy = math.fsum(v * v for v in dy)
ssxy = math.fsum(a * b for a, b in zip(dx, dy))
if ssx == 0 or ssy == 0:
    raise ValueError("Correlation requires two varying variables")

sample_var = ssx / (n - 1)
population_var = ssx / n
sd = math.sqrt(sample_var)
se = sd / math.sqrt(n)
covariance = ssxy / (n - 1)
r = ssxy / math.sqrt(ssx * ssy)

slope = ssxy / ssx
intercept = my - slope * mx
predicted = [intercept + slope * v for v in x]
residuals = [v - fitted for v, fitted in zip(y, predicted)]
sse = math.fsum(v * v for v in residuals)
r_squared = 1 - sse / ssy
residual_var = sse / (n - 2)

# For n=4, under the normal-sampling assumptions in Chapter 03.
t_critical = 3.182
margin = t_critical * se
ci = (mx - margin, mx + margin)

# This p-value shortcut is specific to two-sided t inference with df=2.
t_value = r * math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r * r))
p_two_sided_df2 = 1 - abs(t_value) / math.sqrt(t_value**2 + 2)

assert math.isclose(sample_var, st.variance(x))
assert math.isclose(population_var, st.pvariance(x))
assert math.isclose(sd, st.stdev(x))
assert math.isclose(r_squared, r * r)

print(f"n={n}; mean_x={mx:.2f}; mean_y={my:.2f}")
print(f"deviations_x={dx}")
print(f"squared_deviations_x={[v*v for v in dx]}")
print(f"SS_x={ssx:.2f}; SS_y={ssy:.2f}; SS_xy={ssxy:.2f}")
print(f"sample_variance_x={sample_var:.6f}")
print(f"population_variance_of_four={population_var:.6f}")
print(f"sample_SD_x={sd:.6f}; estimated_SE_mean_x={se:.6f}")
print(f"sample_covariance={covariance:.6f}; r={r:.6f}")
print(f"intercept={intercept:.6f}; slope={slope:.6f}")
print(f"predicted_y={predicted}; residuals_y={residuals}")
print(f"SSE={sse:.6f}; residual_variance={residual_var:.6f}")
print(f"R_squared={r_squared:.6f}")
print(f"t_critical={t_critical:.3f}; CI95=[{ci[0]:.2f}, {ci[1]:.2f}]")
print(f"t_statistic={t_value:.6f}; df=2; p_two_sided={p_two_sided_df2:.6f}")
基础 R 版沿用四对记录，用 var()、cov() 和 cor() 计算统计量，再用 lm() 拟合同一条回归线。
The base R version uses the same four pairs, computes statistics with var(), cov(), and cor(), and fits the same regression with lm().
均值区间用 n−1n-1 个自由度并沿用手算的临界值 3.182，相关检验用 n−2n-2 个自由度计算双侧 p 值。
The mean interval uses n−1n-1 degrees of freedom and the hand calculation’s critical value of 3.182, and the correlation test uses n−2n-2 degrees of freedom for its two-sided p-value.
x <- c(700, 800, 800, 900)
y <- c(2, 3, 4, 3)
n <- length(x)
stopifnot(n == 4, length(y) == n, all(is.finite(c(x, y))))

mx <- mean(x)
my <- mean(y)
dx <- x - mx
dy <- y - my
ssx <- sum(dx^2)
ssy <- sum(dy^2)
ssxy <- sum(dx * dy)
stopifnot(ssx > 0, ssy > 0)

sample_var <- var(x)
population_var <- mean(dx^2)
sample_sd <- sd(x)
se <- sample_sd / sqrt(n)
sample_cov <- cov(x, y)
r <- cor(x, y)

fit <- lm(y ~ x)
intercept <- unname(coef(fit)[1])
slope <- unname(coef(fit)[2])
predicted <- fitted(fit)
residuals_y <- residuals(fit)
sse <- sum(residuals_y^2)
r_squared <- 1 - sse / ssy
residual_var <- sse / (n - 2)

# Use the same rounded critical value as the hand calculation.
t_critical <- round(qt(0.975, df = n - 1), 3)
ci <- mx + c(-1, 1) * t_critical * se

df <- n - 2
t_value <- r * sqrt(df / (1 - r^2))
p_two_sided <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_value), df = df)

stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(sample_var, ssx / (n - 1))),
  isTRUE(all.equal(sample_cov, ssxy / (n - 1))),
  isTRUE(all.equal(r, ssxy / sqrt(ssx * ssy))),
  isTRUE(all.equal(r_squared, r^2))
)

# Remove signed zero introduced by the numerical fit before printing.
residuals_for_output <- round(residuals_y, 10) + 0
join <- function(values) paste(values, collapse = ", ")

cat(
  sprintf("n=%d; mean_x=%.2f; mean_y=%.2f", n, mx, my),
  sprintf("deviations_x=[%s]", join(dx)),
  sprintf("squared_deviations_x=[%s]", join(dx^2)),
  sprintf("SS_x=%.2f; SS_y=%.2f; SS_xy=%.2f", ssx, ssy, ssxy),
  sprintf("sample_variance_x=%.6f", sample_var),
  sprintf("population_variance_of_four=%.6f", population_var),
  sprintf("sample_SD_x=%.6f; estimated_SE_mean_x=%.6f", sample_sd, se),
  sprintf("sample_covariance=%.6f; r=%.6f", sample_cov, r),
  sprintf("intercept=%.6f; slope=%.6f", intercept, slope),
  sprintf(
    "predicted_y=[%s]; residuals_y=[%s]",
    join(sprintf("%.1f", predicted)),
    join(sprintf("%.1f", residuals_for_output))
  ),
  sprintf("SSE=%.6f; residual_variance=%.6f", sse, residual_var),
  sprintf("R_squared=%.6f", r_squared),
  sprintf("t_critical=%.3f; CI95=[%.2f, %.2f]", t_critical, ci[1], ci[2]),
  sprintf("t_statistic=%.6f; df=%d; p_two_sided=%.6f", t_value, df, p_two_sided),
  sep = "\n"
)
预期输出如下，单位沿用主文的日增重 g/day 和采食量 kg/day。
Expected output follows, using the chapter’s daily-gain units of g/day and intake units of kg/day.
n=4; mean_x=800.00; mean_y=3.00
deviations_x=[-100, 0, 0, 100]
squared_deviations_x=[10000, 0, 0, 10000]
SS_x=20000.00; SS_y=2.00; SS_xy=100.00
sample_variance_x=6666.666667
population_variance_of_four=5000.000000
sample_SD_x=81.649658; estimated_SE_mean_x=40.824829
sample_covariance=33.333333; r=0.500000
intercept=-1.000000; slope=0.005000
predicted_y=[2.5, 3.0, 3.0, 3.5]; residuals_y=[-0.5, 0.0, 1.0, -0.5]
SSE=1.500000; residual_variance=0.750000
R_squared=0.250000
t_critical=3.182; CI95=[670.10, 929.90]
t_statistic=0.816497; df=2; p_two_sided=0.500000
如果在 R 里保留 qt(0.975, df = 3) 的完整精度，临界值约为 3.182446，95% 区间变为 [670.08, 929.92] g/day。
Keeping full precision from qt(0.975, df = 3) gives a critical value of about 3.182446 and a 95% interval of [670.08, 929.92] g/day.
两组端点的差别来自临界值的舍入，输入数据和模型假设都相同。
The endpoints differ because of rounding the critical value, with the same data and model assumptions.
代码中的 assert 会在两种计算结果不一致时停止，isclose 则允许浮点数最后几位存在微小差异。
The assert statements stop execution if results disagree, while isclose permits tiny differences in the final floating-point digits.
这个检验只能说明公式与代码在该例上一致，不能证明真实猪场数据满足独立性或模型假设。
This check establishes agreement between equations and code for this example, not that real farm data satisfy independence or model assumptions.

title: 03-3｜均值方差标准差与数值校验详读 / Mean, variance, standard deviation, and numerical checks
section: 05 · 数值稳定性：不要用大数相减丢掉小差异 / Numerical stability and cancellation
text:
05 · 数值稳定性：不要用大数相减丢掉小差异 / Numerical stability and cancellation
NIST 单变量统计背景说明强调计算稳定性，这与原页的高精度认证目标相呼应。
NIST’s univariate-statistics background emphasizes computational stability, complementing the source page’s high-precision certification goal.
在精确算术中，下面两种总体方差表达式等价，但在有限精度浮点计算中可能表现不同。
In exact arithmetic, the following two population-variance expressions are equivalent but can behave differently in finite-precision floating-point computation.
1n∑(xi−x‾)2=1n∑xi2−x‾2
\frac{1}{n}\sum(x_i-\bar{x})^2
=\frac{1}{n}\sum x_i^2-\bar{x}^{\,2}

右式可能把两个很接近的大数相减，丢掉用于表示较小方差的有效数字，这称为消减误差。
The right side can subtract two nearly equal large numbers and lose digits needed to represent a smaller variance, an effect called cancellation.
下面的自拟例子给每个数都加上 101210^{12}，理论方差应保持 5000 不变。
The following original example adds 101210^{12} to every value, which should theoretically leave the population variance unchanged at 5000.
import math
import statistics as st

values = [10**12 + v for v in [700, 800, 800, 900]]
values = [float(v) for v in values]
m = st.mean(values)

naive = sum(v * v for v in values) / len(values) - m * m
centered = math.fsum((v - m)**2 for v in values) / len(values)
library = st.pvariance(values)

print(f"naive={naive:.1f}")
print(f"centered={centered:.1f}; library={library:.1f}")
assert math.isclose(centered, 5000.0)
assert math.isclose(library, 5000.0)
原 Python 示例的朴素公式给出 0.0，中心化计算与标准库都给出 5000.0。
In the original Python run, the naive formula gives 0.0, and both centering and the standard library give 5000.0.
在基础 R 中，我用同一组平移后的数据复算，再把 var() 乘 (n−1)/n(n-1)/n，换成总体方差的分母口径。
In base R, I reuse the shifted data and multiply var() by (n−1)/n(n-1)/n to put it on the population-variance denominator.
values <- 10^12 + c(700, 800, 800, 900)
n <- length(values)
m <- mean(values)

naive <- mean(values^2) - m^2
centered <- mean((values - m)^2)

# var() divides by n - 1; rescale it to a denominator of n.
library_value <- var(values) * (n - 1) / n

cat(sprintf("naive=%.1f\n", naive))
cat(sprintf("centered=%.1f; library=%.1f\n", centered, library_value))

stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(centered, 5000)),
  isTRUE(all.equal(library_value, 5000))
)
用基础 R 4.5.3 实跑得到以下输出，朴素公式的结果可能随运行环境变化。
A run in base R 4.5.3 gave the output below, and the naive result can vary by environment.
naive=0.0
centered=5000.0; library=5000.0



平移后的总体方差与浮点消减 / Population variance after a shift and floating-point cancellation


图 03-3A　每条记录加 101210^{12} 后，精确总体方差仍为 5,000(g/day)25{,}000\,(\mathrm{g/day})^2，在本例环境中先平方再相减得到 0.0，先中心化得到 5,000.0。
Figure 03-3A　Adding 101210^{12} to each record leaves the exact population variance at 5,000(g/day)25{,}000\,(\mathrm{g/day})^2, and in the example environment subtracting the squared terms returned 0.0 while centering first returned 5,000.0.
图中两种公式的均值运算都除以 nn，不同浮点实现的大数相减结果可能不同。
The means in both formulas divide by nn, and the subtraction of large terms can produce different results across floating-point implementations.
不同数值实现可能得到不同的错误结果，所以验收条件应是与正确结果一致，而不是必须复现某个错误值。
Different numerical implementations may produce different wrong results, so acceptance should mean agreement with the correct value rather than reproduction of one particular error.
标准库能改善运算过程，但如果输入时已经把重要的小数差异舍掉，也无法凭空恢复原始信息。
The standard library can improve computation but cannot recover original information already lost when inputs were rounded.

title: 03-3｜均值方差标准差与数值校验详读 / Mean, variance, standard deviation, and numerical checks
section: 06 · 一阶自相关不是两个性状的相关 / Lag-one autocorrelation versus two-trait correlation
text:
06 · 一阶自相关不是两个性状的相关 / Lag-one autocorrelation versus two-trait correlation
原页还涉及一阶自相关，它衡量同一个有顺序的序列与其相邻时点之间的关联。
The source also includes lag-one autocorrelation, measuring association between neighboring points in an ordered sequence of one variable.
这里的“阶”表示间隔一个记录位置，并不自动表示间隔一天，实际时间间隔必须由数据定义。
Here “lag one” means one record position apart and does not automatically mean one day, so actual time spacing must be defined from the data.
采用全序列均值与平方和的一种常用样本定义如下，其中分子从第 2 条开始计算相邻乘积。
One common sample definition uses the full-series mean and squared sum as follows, with adjacent products starting at observation 2.
r1=∑t=2n(qt−q‾)(qt−1−q‾)∑t=1n(qt−q‾)2
r_1=\frac{\sum_{t=2}^{n}(q_t-\bar{q})(q_{t-1}-\bar{q})}
{\sum_{t=1}^{n}(q_t-\bar{q})^2}

对自拟序列 q=[1,2,3,4]q=[1,2,3,4]，均值为 2.5，四个离差为 [−1.5,−0.5,0.5,1.5][-1.5,-0.5,0.5,1.5]。
For the original series q=[1,2,3,4]q=[1,2,3,4], the mean is 2.5 and the deviations are [−1.5,−0.5,0.5,1.5][-1.5,-0.5,0.5,1.5].
r1=(−0.5)(−1.5)+(0.5)(−0.5)+(1.5)(0.5)2.25+0.25+0.25+2.25=1.255=0.25
r_1=\frac{(-0.5)(-1.5)+(0.5)(-0.5)+(1.5)(0.5)}
{2.25+0.25+0.25+2.25}
=\frac{1.25}{5}=0.25

若改为直接对 [1,2,3][1,2,3] 和 [2,3,4][2,3,4] 算皮尔逊相关，会得到 1，因为两列分别中心化且使用的端点不同。
Directly calculating Pearson correlation between [1,2,3][1,2,3] and [2,3,4][2,3,4] instead gives 1 because the columns are centered separately and use different endpoints.
因此同样标成“lag-1”时也要核对实际公式、端点处理和均值约定，不能只凭名称比较软件输出。
Thus, even outputs labeled “lag-1” require checking the equation, endpoint handling, and mean convention rather than comparing names alone.
这个四点序列仅用于展示定义差异，不能据此判断真实过程是否平稳或估计可靠的时间依赖。
This four-point series only demonstrates definition differences and cannot establish stationarity or reliable time dependence in a real process.
平稳性在这里指均值、方差及同一间隔的协方差不随时间位置改变，是时间序列分析中需要另外检查的性质。
Stationarity here means that the mean, variance, and covariance at a given lag do not change with time position, a property requiring separate investigation in time-series analysis.

section: 07 · 统计可信与计算正确是两道检查 / Statistical validity and numerical correctness
text:
07 · 统计可信与计算正确是两道检查 / Statistical validity and numerical correctness

数值检查关注公式实现、分母、单位、浮点精度和可重复输出。
Numerical checks concern equation implementation, denominators, units, floating-point precision, and reproducible output.
统计检查关注总体定义、抽样机制、相关记录、缺失过程和模型假设。
Statistical checks concern population definition, sampling, dependent observations, missingness, and model assumptions.

即使计算到 15 位有效数字，也无法弥补只测优秀猪或把同一测量导入两次造成的问题。
Even 15 significant digits cannot compensate for measuring only outstanding pigs or importing one measurement twice.
学习时先能解释每个数从哪里来，再追求自动化，能避免把错误计算快速复制到全群。
Understanding where each number comes from before automating helps prevent rapidly propagating wrong calculations across a herd.

text:
08 · 两套函数的方差不同，先核对口径 / Start with Definitions When Variances Differ
一套函数给出 6666.666667、另一套给出 5000 时，我先找样本方差和总体方差对应的分母 n−1n-1 或 nn。
When one function returns 6666.666667 and another returns 5000, I first check for n−1n-1 or nn as the sample or population variance denominator.
把均值显示到 12 位小数只会改变显示精度，估计真实猪群均值依靠抽样信息、测量质量以及对系统偏差的处理。
Displaying the mean to 12 decimal places changes only display precision, and estimating the true herd mean depends on sampling information, measurement quality, and addressing systematic bias.

text:
01 · 原始网页讲什么 / What the source covers
原始来源是 NIST：均值向量与协方差矩阵，本次核对日期为 2026-10-17。
The original source is NIST: mean vectors and covariance matrices, checked on 2026-10-17.
原文短摘中的“variance-covariance matrix”就是把方差与协方差统一存放的矩阵。
The source term “variance-covariance matrix” means a matrix that stores variances and covariances together.
原页从多列测量数据出发，把各列均值组成向量，再把各对变量的共同偏离组成矩阵。
The page starts with multivariable measurements, collects column means into a vector, and organizes pairwise joint deviations into a matrix.
以下四头猪的数据和全部演算是本教程自拟，用于把原页公式逐项展开。
The following four-pig data and calculations are original teaching examples that unpack the source equations.

title: 03-1｜均值向量与协方差矩阵详读 / Mean vectors and covariance matrices
section: 02 · 行是猪，列是性状 / Rows are pigs, columns are traits
text:
02 · 行是猪，列是性状 / Rows are pigs, columns are traits
矩阵是按行列排列的数字表，4×24\times2 表示四行两列。
A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers, with 4×24\times2 indicating four rows and two columns.
这里第一列是日增重 xx，单位为 g/day，第二列是日采食量 yy，单位为 kg/day。
Here the first column is daily gain xx in g/day, and the second is daily feed intake yy in kg/day.
X=[7002800380049003]
X=\begin{bmatrix}
700&2\\
800&3\\
800&4\\
900&3
\end{bmatrix}

第一行的 700 与 2 必须属于同一头猪，否则后续协方差不再描述真实配对。
The 700 and 2 in the first row must belong to the same pig, or the covariance no longer describes the actual pairings.
转置把行列互换，用上标 TT 表示，例如行向量 [700,2][700,2] 转置后成为列向量。
A transpose, denoted by superscript TT, swaps rows and columns, turning a row such as [700,2][700,2] into a column.
