section: 03 · 均值向量与中心化 / Mean vector and centering
text:
03 · 均值向量与中心化 / Mean vector and centering
向量是一组按固定顺序排列的数，均值向量必须与性状列保持相同顺序。
A vector is an ordered collection of numbers, and the mean vector must retain the trait-column order.
𝒙‾=[x‾y‾]=[8003]
\bar{\boldsymbol{x}}=
\begin{bmatrix}\bar{x}\\\bar{y}\end{bmatrix}
=\begin{bmatrix}800\\3\end{bmatrix}

中心化就是每列减去自己的均值，得到各头猪相对该列中心的偏离。
Centering subtracts each column’s own mean to obtain each pig’s deviation from that column’s center.
D=[−100−100011000]
D=\begin{bmatrix}
-100&-1\\
0&0\\
0&1\\
100&0
\end{bmatrix}

每列中心化后的和为 0，但两列中心化后的尺度并不相同。
Each centered column sums to zero, but the two centered columns do not share the same scale.

section: 04 · 先算三个平方和与乘积和 / Calculate the three sums
text:
04 · 先算三个平方和与乘积和 / Calculate the three sums
第一列与自身相乘再相加，得到日增重离差平方和 SSx=20,000SS_x=20{,}000。
Multiplying the first column by itself and summing gives the daily-gain squared-deviation sum SSx=20,000SS_x=20{,}000.
第二列与自身相乘再相加，得到采食量离差平方和 SSy=2SS_y=2。
Multiplying the second column by itself and summing gives the intake squared-deviation sum SSy=2SS_y=2.
两列按行相乘再相加，得到交叉乘积和 SSxy=100SS_{xy}=100。
Multiplying the two columns within rows and summing gives the cross-product sum SSxy=100SS_{xy}=100.
SSx=(−100)2+02+02+1002=20,000
SS_x=(-100)^2+0^2+0^2+100^2=20{,}000

SSy=(−1)2+02+12+02=2
SS_y=(-1)^2+0^2+1^2+0^2=2

SSxy=(−100)(−1)+0×0+0×1+100×0=100
SS_{xy}=(-100)(-1)+0\times0+0\times1+100\times0=100

矩阵乘法 DTDD^TD 正好一次完成“每一列与每一列相乘再求和”的操作。
Matrix multiplication DTDD^TD performs every column-by-column product sum at once.
DTD=[20,0001001002]
D^TD=\begin{bmatrix}20{,}000&100\\100&2\end{bmatrix}

这里的矩阵乘法不是把相同位置的数字分别相乘，而是用一行与一列逐项相乘后求和。
Matrix multiplication here is not elementwise multiplication but the sum of products between a row and a column.

title: 03-1｜均值向量与协方差矩阵详读 / Mean vectors and covariance matrices
section: 05 · 协方差矩阵的四个位置 / The four positions in a covariance matrix
text:
05 · 协方差矩阵的四个位置 / The four positions in a covariance matrix
所有记录都完整且采用同一批四头猪时，样本协方差矩阵统一除以 n−1=3n-1=3。
With complete records for the same four pigs, the sample covariance matrix divides every entry by n−1=3n-1=3.
S=DTDn−1=[20,000/3100/3100/32/3]≈[6666.666733.333333.33330.6667]
S=\frac{D^TD}{n-1}
=\begin{bmatrix}
20{,}000/3&100/3\\
100/3&2/3
\end{bmatrix}
\approx\begin{bmatrix}
6666.6667&33.3333\\
33.3333&0.6667
\end{bmatrix}


左上角 S11S_{11}是日增重的样本方差，单位为 (g/day)2(g/day)^2。
The upper-left entry S11S_{11} is sample daily-gain variance, with units (g/day)2(g/day)^2.
右下角 S22S_{22}是采食量的样本方差，单位为 (kg/day)2(kg/day)^2。
The lower-right entry S22S_{22} is sample intake variance, with units (kg/day)2(kg/day)^2.
两个非对角位置 S12S_{12} 和 S21S_{21}都是两性状的协方差，单位为 (g/day)(kg/day)(g/day)(kg/day)。
The off-diagonal entries S12S_{12} and S21S_{21} are the same trait covariance, with units (g/day)(kg/day)(g/day)(kg/day).

对角线从左上延伸到右下，对称矩阵表示交换行列后数值不变。
The diagonal runs from upper left to lower right, and a symmetric matrix is unchanged by swapping rows and columns.
因为乘法 uv=vuuv=vu，所以协方差满足 sxy=syxs_{xy}=s_{yx}，矩阵必须对称。
Since multiplication satisfies uv=vuuv=vu, covariance satisfies sxy=syxs_{xy}=s_{yx} and the matrix must be symmetric.



两性状样本协方差矩阵 / Two-trait sample covariance matrix


图 03-1A　行列同时按日增重、日采食量排列，两个对角元素是各性状的样本方差，两个非对角元素都是 100/3(g/day)(kg/day)100/3\,(\mathrm{g/day})(\mathrm{kg/day})。
Figure 03-1A　Both dimensions list daily gain followed by daily feed intake, with sample variances on the diagonal and 100/3(g/day)(kg/day)100/3\,(\mathrm{g/day})(\mathrm{kg/day}) in both off-diagonal cells.
颜色用于识别元素类型，所有元素均使用同一批四头猪并除以 n−1=3n-1=3。
The colors identify entry types, and all entries use the same four pigs and the denominator n−1=3n-1=3.

section: 06 · 相关矩阵把单位消掉 / Correlation matrix removes units
text:
06 · 相关矩阵把单位消掉 / Correlation matrix removes units
标准化分数 zz把中心化后的值再除以对应标准差，表示它偏离均值多少个标准差。
A standardized score zz divides a centered value by its standard deviation, expressing its distance from the mean in standard-deviation units.
zxi=xi−80020,000/3,zyi=yi−32/3
z_{xi}=\frac{x_i-800}{\sqrt{20{,}000/3}},\qquad
z_{yi}=\frac{y_i-3}{\sqrt{2/3}}

标准化后的样本方差都是 1，样本协方差就是原始两性状的相关系数。
The standardized sample variances are both 1, and their sample covariance is the original trait correlation.
r=100/320,000/32/3=0.5,R=[10.50.51]
r=\frac{100/3}{\sqrt{20{,}000/3}\sqrt{2/3}}=0.5,
\qquad R=\begin{bmatrix}1&0.5\\0.5&1\end{bmatrix}

相关矩阵的对角线为 1，因为一个有变化的变量与自身完全相关。
A correlation matrix has diagonal entries of 1 because a varying variable is perfectly correlated with itself.
将日增重从 g/day 改为 kg/day 后，日增重方差除以 100021000^2，交叉协方差除以 1000，相关仍是 0.5。
Converting daily gain from g/day to kg/day divides its variance by 100021000^2 and the cross-covariance by 1000 while leaving correlation at 0.5.

section: 07 · 矩阵不能随便填写 / Matrix entries must be compatible
text:
07 · 矩阵不能随便填写 / Matrix entries must be compatible
半正定表示任意线性组合的方差都不为负，这是合法协方差矩阵必须满足的条件。
Positive semidefinite means every linear combination has nonnegative variance, a requirement for a valid covariance matrix.
对于两个性状，一个直接检查是协方差绝对值不能超过两个标准差的乘积。
For two traits, a direct check is that the covariance magnitude cannot exceed the product of the standard deviations.
|sxy|≤sxsy=(20,000/3)(2/3)=66.6667…
|s_{xy}|\leq s_xs_y=\sqrt{(20{,}000/3)(2/3)}=66.6667\ldots

若保留本例两个方差，却把协方差填成 80，就会算出相关 1.2，证明这些数值不能共同构成合法协方差矩阵。
Keeping these variances but setting covariance to 80 would give correlation 1.2, proving that these entries cannot form a valid covariance matrix.
存在缺失值时，分别用不同猪群计算每一对协方差，拼出的矩阵可能不再半正定。
With missing data, computing each covariance from a different animal subset can produce a matrix that is not positive semidefinite.
应明确缺失处理和样本范围，不能把不同来源的数字拼好后就默认能输入多性状模型。
Specify missing-data handling and sample scope rather than assuming that assembled numbers are valid inputs to a multi-trait model.

section: 08 · 两种容易混淆的关系 / Two different kinds of relationship
text:
08 · 两种容易混淆的关系 / Two different kinds of relationship
这里的 SS 描述性状与性状的关系，行列分别是日增重和采食量。
Here SS describes relationships among traits, with rows and columns representing daily gain and intake.
后文的系谱关系矩阵 AA 描述动物与动物的加性遗传亲缘，行列分别是不同动物。
The later pedigree relationship matrix AA describes additive genetic relationships among animals, with rows and columns representing animals.
同样叫矩阵不代表它们的索引对象、单位或含义相同。
Sharing the name matrix does not make their indexed units, measurement units, or meanings identical.
本例直接计算的是表型记录的样本协方差，分离加性遗传协方差还需要亲缘信息、环境信息和相应模型。
This example directly calculates sample covariance of phenotypic records, while separating additive genetic covariance requires relationship information, environmental information, and an appropriate model.

title: 03-1｜均值向量与协方差矩阵详读 / Mean vectors and covariance matrices
section: 09 · 为什么相关记录影响标准误 / Why dependent records affect standard errors
text:
09 · 为什么相关记录影响标准误 / Why dependent records affect standard errors
对具有相同有限方差 σ2\sigma^2 的 nn 条记录，均值方差的一般公式包含记录间协方差。
For nn observations with the same finite variance σ2\sigma^2, the general variance of their mean includes between-record covariances.
Var⁡(X‾)=1n2[nσ2+2∑i<jCov(Xi,Xj)]
\operatorname{Var}(\bar{X})=
\frac{1}{n^2}\left[n\sigma^2+2\sum_{i<j}\operatorname{Cov}(X_i,X_j)\right]

Var\operatorname{Var} 表示方差运算，Cov\operatorname{Cov} 表示协方差运算，i<ji<j 表示每对不同记录只数一次。
Var\operatorname{Var} denotes variance, Cov\operatorname{Cov} denotes covariance, and i<ji<j counts each distinct pair once.
独立记录的交叉协方差为 0，公式才简化为 σ2/n\sigma^2/n，再开平方得到 σ/n\sigma/\sqrt{n}。
Independent observations have zero cross-covariances, reducing the formula to σ2/n\sigma^2/n, whose square root is σ/n\sigma/\sqrt{n}.
正相关的同窝或重复记录会增加交叉项，因此相同记录条数不保证相同信息量。
Positively correlated littermate or repeated records increase the cross terms, so the same record count does not guarantee the same information.

section: 10 · 换列时，矩阵要怎样跟着换 / How a Matrix Follows a Column Swap
text:
10 · 换列时，矩阵要怎样跟着换 / How a Matrix Follows a Column Swap
把两个性状整体交换时，我会同时换矩阵的行列标签、各自方差以及单位，两个非对角协方差仍为 100/3100/3。
If the two traits are swapped, I swap both matrix labels, their variances, and units, while both off-diagonal covariance entries stay at 100/3100/3.
左上角的 6666.67 要连同日增重的平方单位一起读，换单位会改变方差的数值，因此不同尺度的两个方差大小无法直接说明哪个性状更稳定。
The upper-left value 6666.67 must be read in squared daily-gain units, because changing measurement scales changes variance values and makes direct comparisons of trait stability misleading.
本篇把原页的矩阵框架用于原创例题，半正定检查、亲缘辨析和相关记录解释属于教学补充。
This note applies the source’s matrix framework to an original example, with matrix-validity checks, relationship distinctions, and dependent-record explanations added for teaching.

面对一头母猪的几胎记录，我把母猪号保留下来，再追哪些因素在各胎之间共享、哪些只影响一胎。
With several litters from one sow, I keep the sow ID so I can track which influences are shared across litters and which affect only one.
原阅读的旧地址返回 404，本次实际读取了作者新版重复力模型。

title: 02-4｜重复记录与永久环境 / Repeated records and permanent environment
section: 01 · 来源要点 / Source points
text:
01 · 来源要点 / Source points
原文区分“permanent environmental”与暂时环境，模型把遗传和永久环境设为不同随机效应。
The source distinguishes “permanent environmental” effects from temporary environment and models genetics and permanent environment as separate random effects.
两种效应都按动物编号连接记录，但遗传效应用系谱联系动物，永久环境在简化模型中不随亲缘共享。
Both effects connect records by animal ID, but genetics links animals through pedigree while permanent environment is not shared through relatedness in the simplified model.

title: 02-4｜重复记录与永久环境 / Repeated records and permanent environment
section: 02 · 写清一行代表一胎 / Define a row as a litter
text:
02 · 写清一行代表一胎 / Define a row as a litter
假设数据记录如下，parity 表示胎次，nba 表示产活仔数。
Suppose the data below use parity for litter order and nba for number born alive.
sow_id,parity,nba
S1,1,11
S1,2,13
S1,3,12
S2,1,10
S2,2,11
这里有 5 条观测、2 头母猪，不能称为 5 头独立母猪。
These are five observations from two sows, not five independent sows.
胎次和批次效应应先在模型中考虑，否则初产与经产的差异可能混入个体效应。
Parity and batch effects need modeling, or differences between first and later litters can enter animal effects.

title: 02-4｜重复记录与永久环境 / Repeated records and permanent environment
section: 03 · 将记录拆成三种随机来源 / Separate three random components
text:
03 · 将记录拆成三种随机来源 / Separate three random components
yij=μ+bij+ai+pei+eij
y_{ij}=\mu+b_{ij}+a_i+pe_i+e_{ij}


yijy_{ij} 是母猪 ii 第 jj 次记录，bijb_{ij} 汇总已定义的固定条件。
yijy_{ij} is sow ii’s record jj, and bijb_{ij} represents defined fixed conditions.
aia_i 是可通过亲缘传递信息的加性遗传作用。
aia_i is the additive genetic effect linked through relationships.
peipe_i 是持续影响同一母猪的非遗传作用，不应当作遗传传递给女儿。
peipe_i is a persistent non-genetic influence on the same sow and must not be transmitted to daughters as genetics.
eije_{ij} 是该次记录的剩余偏离，不同次之间在此简化模型中独立。
eije_{ij} is the remaining record-specific deviation, independent across records in this simplified model.

“永久”指跨这些记录持续存在，不表示生物学上永远不变。
“Permanent” means persistent across these records, not biologically immutable forever.



同一母猪多胎记录共享的效应 / Shared effects across litters of the same sow


图 02-4A　在这个简化重复力模型里，同一头母猪三胎共享加性遗传效应 aia_i 和永久环境效应 peipe_i，三胎分别有自己的残差 ei1e_{i1}、ei2e_{i2}、ei3e_{i3}。
Figure 02-4A　In this simplified repeatability model, three litters from one sow share additive genetic effect aia_i and permanent environmental effect peipe_i, and each litter has its own residual ei1e_{i1}, ei2e_{i2}, or ei3e_{i3}.
色带表示效应覆盖哪些记录，残差在本例中假设相互独立。
The bands show which records share an effect, and the example assumes independent residuals.

title: 02-4｜重复记录与永久环境 / Repeated records and permanent environment
section: 04 · 手算重复力 / Calculate repeatability
text:
04 · 手算重复力 / Calculate repeatability
假设三个方差分别为 σA2=1\sigma_A^2=1、σPE2=2\sigma_{PE}^2=2、σe2=7\sigma_e^2=7，且这些分量互不相关。
Assume mutually uncorrelated components with variances σA2=1\sigma_A^2=1, σPE2=2\sigma_{PE}^2=2, and σe2=7\sigma_e^2=7.
单次记录方差为 1+2+7=101+2+7=10，同一动物两次记录共有的协方差为 1+2=31+2=3。
A single record has variance 1+2+7=101+2+7=10, and two records of the same animal share covariance 1+2=31+2=3.
h2=1/10=0.10,t=(1+2)/10=0.30
h^2=1/10=0.10,\qquad t=(1+2)/10=0.30

重复力 tt 高于遗传力 h2h^2，因为它还包含稳定的非遗传影响。
Repeatability tt exceeds heritability h2h^2 because it includes persistent non-genetic influences.

title: 02-4｜重复记录与永久环境 / Repeated records and permanent environment
section: 05 · 三胎平均能提供多少信息 / How informative is a three-litter mean?
text:
05 · 三胎平均能提供多少信息 / How informative is a three-litter mean?
在固定条件已校正的假设下，同一母猪三胎均值的方差为共同部分加上平均后的暂时部分。
Assuming fixed conditions have been adjusted, the variance of one sow’s three-litter mean is the shared component plus the averaged temporary component.
Var⁡(y‾i)=1+2+7/3=16/3≈5.3333
\operatorname{Var}(\bar y_i)=1+2+7/3=16/3\approx5.3333

若错误地把三胎当作独立记录，会算成 10/3≈3.333310/3\approx3.3333，低估均值的不确定性。
Incorrectly treating the three litters as independent gives 10/3≈3.333310/3\approx3.3333, understating uncertainty in the mean.
在等方差、共同相关为 tt 的这种模型下，mm 条记录估计均值的等效独立条数为 m/[1+(m−1)t]m/[1+(m-1)t]。
In this equal-variance, common-correlation model, the effective independent count for estimating a mean from mm records is m/[1+(m−1)t]m/[1+(m-1)t].
取 m=3m=3、t=0.3t=0.3 时等效条数为 3/1.6=1.8753/1.6=1.875，不是 3，也不是“1.875 头真实母猪”。
With m=3m=3 and t=0.3t=0.3, the effective count is 3/1.6=1.8753/1.6=1.875, not 3 or literally 1.875 sows.

title: 02-4｜重复记录与永久环境 / Repeated records and permanent environment
section: 06 · 简化预测仍只提取遗传部分 / Simplified prediction extracts genetics only
text:
06 · 简化预测仍只提取遗传部分 / Simplified prediction extracts genetics only
进一步假设总体均值和方差已知、没有其他亲属信息，则由三胎均值预测 aia_i 的系数为 1/(16/3)=0.18751/(16/3)=0.1875。
Further assuming known population mean and variances and no other relative information, the coefficient predicting aia_i from the three-litter mean is 1/(16/3)=0.18751/(16/3)=0.1875.
若校正后的三胎均值高于总体 2 头，则该简化遗传预测为 0.1875×2=0.3750.1875\times2=0.375 头。
If the adjusted three-litter mean exceeds the population mean by two piglets, this simplified genetic prediction is 0.1875×2=0.3750.1875\times2=0.375 piglets.
不能把重复力 0.3 直接当遗传力乘上偏差，否则会把永久环境也视为可遗传优势。
Multiplying the deviation by repeatability 0.3 as if it were heritability would incorrectly treat permanent environment as transmissible advantage.

text:
07 · 一百份副本与一百条后代记录 / A Hundred Copies and a Hundred Progeny Records
把某头母猪的一条记录复制一百遍，只会增加行数，独立信息仍然来自原来那一次观测。
Copying one sow’s record a hundred times adds rows, and the independent information still comes from the original observation.
一百个女儿的记录提供了不同观测，放进模型时仍要核对父母身份、饲养环境和亲缘结构。
Records from a hundred daughters provide different observations, and the model still needs their parentage, environments, and relationships checked.

text:
01 · 来源要点 / Source points
原文短摘“relative to other animals in the same population”提醒 EBV 有明确比较群体。
The excerpt “relative to other animals in the same population” emphasizes an EBV’s comparison population.
原页列出猪的生长、采食效率、脂肪和繁殖 EBV，并用公猪比较说明后代群体期望差异的折半关系。
The page lists pig growth, feed-efficiency, fat, and reproduction EBVs and illustrates half-scale expected progeny differences between sires.
本篇不复制原动物编号和数值，以下使用另一组自拟公猪。
This note uses different hypothetical boars rather than copying the original animal IDs and values.

title: 02-1｜猪性状、EBV 与后代差异 / Pig traits, EBVs, and progeny differences
section: 02 · 为每个性状补一张定义卡 / Give each trait a definition card
text:
02 · 为每个性状补一张定义卡 / Give each trait a definition card
日增重 ADG是指定时期的增重量除以天数，必须说明起止时间与体重。
Average daily gain (ADG) is weight gained over a specified period divided by days, requiring defined start and end times and weights.
若 50 天内从 30 kg 增至 70 kg，则 ADG 为 (70−30)/50=0.8(70-30)/50=0.8 kg/day，即 800 g/day。
Growing from 30 to 70 kg in 50 days gives ADG (70−30)/50=0.8(70-30)/50=0.8 kg/day, or 800 g/day.
料重比 FCR是同一时期饲料消耗量除以增重量，例如 100 kg 饲料换来 40 kg 增重时 FCR 为 2.5。
Feed conversion ratio (FCR) divides feed consumed by weight gained over the same period, giving 2.5 when 100 kg of feed produces 40 kg of gain.
饲料按干物质还是鲜料统计、死亡和转群如何处理，都会改变 FCR 的可比性。
Feed recorded as dry matter or as-fed, and handling of deaths and transfers, affect FCR comparability.
背膘 BF通常以 mm 记录，但测点、仪器和校正体重必须一致。
Backfat (BF) is commonly recorded in mm, but measurement site, instrument, and adjusted weight must match.
产活仔数 NBA的观测单位通常是一头母猪的一胎，不能把胎记录直接当作仔猪个体性状。
Number born alive (NBA) usually has one sow-litter as its observation unit and must not be treated as a piglet-level trait.
不同系统的胎次、寄养和存活口径必须查清，名称相同不保证定义相同。
Check parity, fostering, and survival definitions across systems because identical names do not guarantee identical traits.

section: 03 · 两头公猪的三项 EBV / Three EBVs for two boars
text:
03 · 两头公猪的三项 EBV / Three EBVs for two boars
假设公猪 A、B 在同一评估中的 ADG EBV 分别为 +40、+10 g/day。
Suppose Boars A and B have ADG EBVs of +40 and +10 g/day in the same evaluation.
再假设 A、B 的 BF EBV 为 −0.8、+0.2 mm，NBA EBV 为 +0.6、0.0 头/胎。
Also suppose their BF EBVs are −0.8 and +0.2 mm and NBA EBVs are +0.6 and 0.0 piglets per litter.
这些数值的单位不同，不能计算 40−0.8+0.640-0.8+0.6 来判断综合价值。
These quantities have different units, so 40−0.8+0.640-0.8+0.6 cannot measure overall merit.
综合价值需要明确生产目标和经济权重，见 综合选择指数。
Overall merit requires a production objective and economic weights, as explained in selection indexes.

title: 02-1｜猪性状、EBV 与后代差异 / Pig traits, EBVs, and progeny differences
section: 04 · 为什么后代差异折半 / Why progeny differences are halved
text:
04 · 为什么后代差异折半 / Why progeny differences are halved
假设两组母猪遗传水平相当，且模型与生产环境具有可比性，则 A 相对 B 的后代群体期望差异如下。
Assuming equivalent mate genetic merit and comparable model and production conditions, expected progeny-group differences for A versus B are as follows.
ΔADG=(40−10)/2=15g/day
\Delta ADG=(40-10)/2=15\ \mathrm{g/day}

ΔBF=(−0.8−0.2)/2=−0.5mm
\Delta BF=(-0.8-0.2)/2=-0.5\ \mathrm{mm}

ΔNBA=(0.6−0.0)/2=0.3piglets/litter
\Delta NBA=(0.6-0.0)/2=0.3\ \mathrm{piglets/litter}

NBA 的 0.3 解释为未来女儿群体产活仔数的平均差异，不表示公猪自身产仔，也不表示每胎出现小数头仔猪。
The NBA difference of 0.3 describes average litter-size differences among future daughters, not boars giving birth or individual litters containing fractional piglets.
如果报表已经提供 EPD，它通常就在后代差异尺度上，不能再除以 2。
If the report provides EPD, it is usually already on the progeny-difference scale and must not be halved again.



三项公猪 EBV 的后代群体差异 / Progeny-group differences for three sire EBVs


图 02-1A　在同一评估、配种母猪遗传水平相当且生产环境可比的教学例子中，公猪 A 相对 B 的后代群体期望差异分别为日增重 +15 g/day、背膘 −0.5 mm、女儿平均产活仔数 +0.3 头/胎。
Figure 02-1A　In this teaching example with a shared evaluation and comparable mate genetic merit and environments, the expected group differences for Sire A relative to Sire B are +15 g/day in gain, −0.5 mm in backfat, and +0.3 piglets per litter in daughters’ mean number born alive.
每项差异都由对应性状的父本 EBV 之差除以 2 得到，比较方向始终为 A 减 B。
Each difference is half the corresponding sire EBV difference, consistently calculated as A minus B.

section: 05 · 比较前的六项检查 / Six checks before comparison
text:
05 · 比较前的六项检查 / Six checks before comparison

同一性状要求定义、阶段和测定方式可比。
Same trait requires comparable definitions, stages, and measurement methods.
同一单位避免把 kg/day 和 g/day 直接比较。
Same units avoids direct comparison between kg/day and g/day.
同一基准说明零点相对于哪个参考群体。
Same base identifies the reference population defining zero.
同一评估版本避免把不同时间点的估计混为同时排名。
Same evaluation version avoids combining estimates from different dates as one ranking.
可比遗传联系要求跨场差异能与管理差异区分。
Comparable genetic links require separating across-farm genetics from management differences.
准确度口径区分 ACC、REL 和百分数显示方式。
Accuracy conventions distinguish ACC, REL, and percentage display scales.

section: 06 · 怎么读公猪的产活仔数 EBV / Reading a Boar’s EBV for Number Born Alive
text:
06 · 怎么读公猪的产活仔数 EBV / Reading a Boar’s EBV for Number Born Alive
公猪的 NBA EBV 为 +0.6 时，我先确认它是亲本加性遗传尺度，然后按目标后代群的比较口径处理。
For a boar with an NBA EBV of +0.6, I first establish that it is on the parental additive scale and then use the comparison convention for the target progeny groups.
在可比配对和环境下，相对零基准的父方预期贡献约为 +0.3 头，单个女儿的每胎结果还受另一亲本、孟德尔抽样和环境影响。
With comparable mates and environments, the expected sire contribution relative to a zero base is about +0.3 piglets, and each daughter’s litter also reflects the other parent, Mendelian sampling, and environment.

我把纯系选育和杂交放到两张表上，一张记录亲本群体如何改良，另一张记录不同亲本组合的表现。
I keep separate records for pure-line selection and crossbreeding, one for changes in the parent populations and another for performance across crosses.

section: 01 · 原文重点 / Source focus
text:
01 · 原文重点 / Source focus
原文短语“heterosis”与“breed complementarity”分别对应杂种优势和品种互补。
The source terms “heterosis” and “breed complementarity” mean hybrid vigor and complementarity among breeds.
文章把核心群持续选择与商品群表现联系起来，并区分杂交带来的优势和可累积的选择进展。
The article connects sustained seedstock selection with commercial performance and distinguishes crossbreeding advantages from cumulative selection progress.
历史收益估计与杂种优势百分比依赖当时情境，不能直接当作今天某猪场的收益承诺。
Historical profit estimates and heterosis percentages depend on their original setting and cannot become profit guarantees for a current farm.

title: 01-2｜遗传改良与杂交体系 / Genetic improvement and crossbreeding systems
section: 02 · 四个词先分开 / Separate four terms
text:
02 · 四个词先分开 / Separate four terms

纯种繁育在定义的品种或品系内产生后代，并不表示个体每个位点都纯合。
Purebred breeding produces offspring within a defined breed or line and does not mean every locus is homozygous.
杂交让不同品种或品系的动物交配，改变后代的遗传组合。
Crossbreeding mates animals from different breeds or lines to change offspring genetic combinations.
品种互补利用父母不同方面的长处，例如母系繁殖能力与终端父系生长、胴体表现。
Breed complementarity combines different strengths, such as maternal reproduction with terminal-sire growth and carcass performance.
杂种优势比较杂交后代与相应亲本品种均值，不能只与较差亲本比较。
Heterosis compares crossbred offspring with the relevant parental-breed average rather than only the poorer parent.

title: 01-2｜遗传改良与杂交体系 / Genetic improvement and crossbreeding systems
section: 03 · 手算杂种优势 / Calculate heterosis
text:
03 · 手算杂种优势 / Calculate heterosis
假设同一测定环境下，两个亲本群体的某项均值为 10 和 12，杂交群体为 11.8。
Suppose two parental populations average 10 and 12 for a trait under comparable conditions, while the crossbred population averages 11.8.
P‾parents=(10+12)/2=11
\bar P_{\mathrm{parents}}=(10+12)/2=11

H=11.8−11=0.8,H%=0.811×100%≈7.27%
H=11.8-11=0.8,\qquad H\%=\frac{0.8}{11}\times100\%\approx7.27\%

虽然 11.8 小于较好亲本的 12，它仍高于双亲均值，所以该例存在正的杂种优势。
Although 11.8 is below the better parent at 12, it exceeds the parental average and therefore shows positive heterosis in this example.
这里假设数值越大越有利，若性状是越低越好的死亡率或达重日龄，还要另外解释改良方向。
This example assumes higher values are favorable, while lower-is-better traits such as mortality or days to target weight require interpreting the improvement direction separately.



杂种优势与双亲均值 / Heterosis and the mid-parent mean


图 01-2A｜教学杂交群体均值 11.8 高于双亲均值 11，却仍低于较好亲本的 12，杂种优势为 0.8 或约 7.27%。
Figure 01-2A | The hypothetical crossbred mean of 11.8 exceeds the mid-parent mean of 11 but remains below the better parent at 12, giving heterosis of 0.8 or about 7.27%.
所有数值使用相同教学单位并假设测定条件可比，不能把图中的优势百分比当作真实猪群预期。
All values share hypothetical units and assume comparable testing conditions, so the displayed heterosis percentage is not an expectation for an actual herd.

title: 01-2｜遗传改良与杂交体系 / Genetic improvement and crossbreeding systems
section: 04 · F1 与终端杂交 / F1 and terminal crossing
text:
04 · F1 与终端杂交 / F1 and terminal crossing
F1是两个指定亲本群体杂交的第一代，必须说明所指的是哪两个群体。
F1 is the first filial generation from two specified parental populations, which must be identified.
一种教学体系是 A、B 产生 AB 母猪，再由 C 系公猪与 AB 母猪产生商品猪。
One teaching system produces AB sows from A and B, then mates C-line boars to AB sows for commercial pigs.



三元终端杂交路径 / Three-breed terminal crossbreeding pathways


图 01-2B｜A 系公猪与 B 系母猪先产生 AB 母猪，再由 C 系公猪与 AB 母猪产生终端商品后代。
Figure 01-2B | Line A sires and Line B dams first produce AB females, which mate with Line C sires to produce terminal commercial offspring.
两处 AB 框是同一来源的重复展示，1/2 C、1/4 A、1/4 B 是期望常染色体品种来源，不是性状贡献比例。
The two AB boxes repeat the same source, and 1/2 C, 1/4 A, and 1/4 B are expected autosomal breed ancestry rather than trait-contribution shares.
终端表示这一路后代用于商品生产，更新母猪通常由另外的繁育路径提供。
Terminal means offspring on this path serve commercial production, with replacement females usually supplied through a separate breeding path.
不能只看商品猪长得快，就倒推纯系的每个加性 EBV 都同样优秀。
Fast-growing commercial pigs do not establish that every additive EBV of the contributing pure lines is equally favorable.

text:
05 · 为什么核心群持续进展很重要 / Why sustained seedstock progress matters
用一个自拟简式表示商品群遗传均值 CtC_t 每代有一半来自当代父系来源 StS_t，另一半来自上一代商品群。
In an original simplified model, commercial genetic mean CtC_t receives half its value from the current sire source StS_t and half from the previous commercial generation.
Ct+1=0.5St+0.5Ct
C_{t+1}=0.5S_t+0.5C_t

若父系来源固定为 20、起点为 0，则商品群依次为 10、15、17.5，逐步接近 20，而非每代永远增加 10。
With a constant sire source of 20 and a starting value of 0, the commercial mean progresses through 10, 15, and 17.5 toward 20 rather than gaining 10 indefinitely each generation.
这个简式忽略母系选择、杂种优势与多路径流动，只用于解释持续供种水平与群体滞后的关系。
This simplification ignores dam selection, heterosis, and multiple genetic pathways and only illustrates source merit and population lag.

text:
06 · 从一次杂交看到持续改良需要什么 / What Sustained Improvement Requires
一次杂交可以表现很好，持续改良亲本群体还要有明确目标、连续记录、可比评估和跨世代的选择。
A cross can perform well, and sustained improvement of the parents’ populations also requires clear objectives, continuous recording, comparable evaluations, and selection across generations.
我会把「这次杂交的表现」和「亲本群体的遗传趋势」分开记录，分别找相应的数据核对。
I would record this cross’s performance separately from the parents’ genetic trend and check each against its own data.

text:
目录 / Contents · 下一章 / Next
一头猪吃得更好，当期增重就可能变快，我想先弄清楚这件事跟育种改良差在哪里。
A pig may grow faster this period because it is fed better, and I want to understand how that differs from genetic improvement.
我会把能直接量到的表型、背后的遗传作用、以及选父母之后下一代会发生什么，分成三个问题。
I separate three questions: what phenotype we can measure, what genetic effects underlie it, and what may change in the next generation after selecting parents.
例如甲猪日增重 900 g/day，乙猪 850 g/day，若甲用了更好的饲料，现有记录还不足以判断甲的估计育种值更高。
For example, pig A gains 900 g/day and pig B 850 g/day, but if A received better feed, these records alone cannot establish that A has the higher estimated breeding value.
我会把这 50 g/day 先记作观察差，再查比较条件和遗传评估，这样后面每次看到报表变化都能追到同样的起点。
I would record the 50 g/day as an observed difference, then check comparison conditions and genetic evaluation so changes in later reports can be traced from the same starting point.

title: 01-0｜育种与遗传基础 / Breeding and inheritance
section: 01 · 育种在改变什么 / What breeding changes
text:
01 · 育种在改变什么 / What breeding changes

饲养管理改善当前动物的环境，例如营养和温度。
Management improves the environment of current animals, including nutrition and temperature.
繁殖让动物产生后代。
Reproduction produces offspring.
育种通过选择和配对，改变后代群体的遗传组成。
Breeding changes the genetic composition of future populations through selection and mating.

新饲料能让这批猪长得更快，但这项改善本身不能证明发生了遗传进步。
A new diet may make current pigs grow faster, but that improvement alone does not demonstrate genetic progress.

section: 02 · 先认四个生物学词 / Four biological terms
text:
02 · 先认四个生物学词 / Four biological terms

DNA是存储遗传信息的分子。
DNA is the molecule that stores inherited information.
染色体是 DNA 的组织载体。
Chromosomes organize and carry DNA.
基因是具有生物学功能的 DNA 区段。
Genes are DNA regions with biological functions.
等位基因是某个位点的不同版本。
Alleles are alternative versions at a locus.

可以把它们粗略类比为存储、文件组织、功能模块和模块版本。
A rough computing analogy is storage, file organization, functional modules, and module versions.
这个类比有限，因为基因并不是功能一一独立的软件函数。
The analogy is limited because genes are not independent software functions with one-to-one outputs.
对常染色体位点，动物通常从父母各获得一个拷贝。
At an autosomal locus, an animal normally receives one copy from each parent.

两个拷贝相同，叫纯合。
Identical copies are homozygous.
两个拷贝不同，叫杂合。
Different copies are heterozygous.

大多数生产性状受到许多位点共同影响，不能用一个“优秀基因”解释全部表现。
Most production traits involve many loci, so one “good gene” cannot explain overall performance.

title: 01-0｜育种与遗传基础 / Breeding and inheritance
section: 03 · 表型是观测结果 / Phenotype is the observed result
text:
03 · 表型是观测结果 / Phenotype is the observed result
表型是观察或测量到的表现，例如日增重 850 g/day。
A phenotype is an observed or measured outcome, such as daily gain of 850 g/day.
基因型是动物的遗传构成。
A genotype is an animal’s genetic constitution.
最简单的概念式是“表现 = 群体均值 + 遗传作用 + 环境作用”。
The simplest conceptual model is “performance = population mean + genetic contribution + environmental contribution.”
P=μ+G+E,G=A+D+I
P=\mu+G+E,\qquad G=A+D+I


PP 是表型，μ\mu 是群体均值。
PP is phenotype, and μ\mu is the population mean.
GG 是总遗传作用，EE 是环境偏离。
GG is the total genetic contribution, and EE is the environmental deviation.
AA 是加性作用，描述等位基因替换的平均效应。
AA denotes additive effects, which describe average allele-substitution effects.
DD 是显性偏离，涉及同一位点两个拷贝的组合。
DD denotes dominance deviations involving combinations of copies at one locus.
II 是上位互作，涉及不同位点之间的组合。
II denotes epistasis, involving interactions across loci.

加性作用适合用于预测跨代传递，而显性与互作组合可能在下一代重排。
Additive effects support prediction across generations, while dominance and interaction combinations may be rearranged in offspring.
这个式子是入门分解，实际模型还可能需要基因型与环境互作。
This introductory decomposition may need genotype-by-environment interaction in practice.



表型、遗传与环境 / Phenotype, genetics, and environment


图 01-0A｜表型由参考均值、遗传作用和环境偏离共同构成，育种值对应这里的加性部分 A。
Figure 01-0A | Phenotype combines the reference mean, genetic contributions, and environmental deviation, with breeding value corresponding to the additive part A here.
框的面积和颜色不表示方差比例，各效应可有正负，实际模型可能还需基因型与环境互作。
Box areas and colors do not represent variance shares, effects can be positive or negative, and actual models may also require genotype-by-environment interaction.

section: 04 · 同胞为什么不一样 / Why siblings differ
text:
04 · 同胞为什么不一样 / Why siblings differ
生成精子和卵子时会发生分离与重组，因此同一对父母的后代得到的遗传组合不同。
Segregation and recombination during gamete formation give offspring of the same parents different genetic combinations.
即使是同胞，经历的环境也可能不同。
Even siblings can experience different environments.
用计算机类比，相同的抽样来源不代表每次得到相同的输出。
In computing terms, the same source distributions do not produce identical sampled outputs every time.

text:
05 · 把全流程连起来 / Connect the workflow
表型记录用于评估，EBV 用于选择，选配产生下一代，下一代记录再进入新一轮。
Phenotype records support evaluation, EBVs inform selection, matings produce the next generation, and new records feed the next cycle.






flowchart LR
    P["表型记录<br/>Phenotype records"] --> E["遗传评估<br/>Genetic evaluation"]
    E --> S["选择父母<br/>Select parents"]
    S --> M["设计选配<br/>Plan matings"]
    M --> N["下一代<br/>Next generation"]
    N --> P






生产管理贯穿这个流程，同时影响记录和实际收益。
Management affects both records and production outcomes throughout this cycle.

饲料变化后，回查哪些记录 / What to Check After a Feed Change
新饲料让平均增重上升时，我会先看记录能否区分管理改善与遗传改变。
When new feed raises mean daily gain, I first check whether the records can distinguish management improvement from genetic change.

我的核对笔记 / My Verification Notes
如果只看到前后两批猪的平均增重，我会先查饲料、测定条件和比较对象，再追问有没有支持遗传变化的评估结果。
If all I see are the average gains of two batches, I first check feed, testing conditions, and the animals being compared, then look for evaluation evidence of genetic change.
记录、评估、选择、选配是一条完整链路，父母选得再准，后续也还要靠新一代记录来检验改良方向。
Recording, evaluation, selection, and mating form one process, and records from the next generation are needed to check the direction of improvement even when parent selection is accurate.

section: 前言 / Preface
text:
前言 / Preface
大家好，我是玩 AI 的杰克。
Hi, I’m Jacky, and I work with AI.
我的老本行是做企业软件和业务自动化，刚接触养殖这个行业时，我把事情想得挺简单。
My background is in enterprise software and automation, and when I first got into the farming industry, I thought it would be fairly straightforward.
当时我想，先把业务流程搞懂，再把数据记清楚，应该就差不多了吧？
I figured that if I understood the workflow and kept good records, I’d be most of the way there.
结果越往里学，越发现要补的课还挺多。
The deeper I got, the more I realized I had to learn.
光是养殖业务，就得弄清楚一条数据是怎么来的、是谁记的、到了哪个环节才用得上。
Just to understand the farming side, I had to learn where a record comes from, who enters it, and when it becomes useful.
到了育种，我先碰到一个看起来很简单的问题，长得最快的猪为什么不一定有最高的估计育种值？
When I got to breeding, I wanted to answer a seemingly simple question about why the fastest-growing pig might have a lower estimated breeding value than another pig.
顺着这个问题往下问，就得弄明白两头猪的记录能不能放在一起比，也得知道模型到底用了哪些信息。
Following that question meant figuring out whether two pigs’ records were comparable and what information the model actually used.
这时候，基础数学和统计学也得捡起来，比如方差在量什么、相关能说明什么、亲缘矩阵里每一行又对应哪头猪。
That sent me back to basic math and statistics to ask what variance measures, what correlation can tell me, and which pig each row of a relationship matrix represents.
计算机这块也有新东西要学，R 对我来说就是一门得补的新语言。
There was more to pick up on the computing side too, and R was a new language for me to learn.
我的办法是拿同一组小数据，先手算一遍，再用熟悉的 Python 和刚学的 R 跑一遍，看看三个结果能不能对上。
My approach is to take one small dataset, work it out by hand, then run it in the Python I know and the R I’m learning to see whether all three results agree.
这份教程是我边学边记攒下来的，想分享给网上也在从头学育种的朋友。
I put this tutorial together from notes I took while learning, and I’d like to share it with people online who are also starting from scratch.
有些地方我自己也还在琢磨，之后学到新的东西，或者发现哪里讲得不对，我会回来补上、改过来。
I’m still working through parts of it, and I’ll keep coming back to add what I learn and correct anything I got wrong.
你要是发现哪儿说得不对，也欢迎提醒我。
If something looks off to you, I’d be glad to hear about it.

我怎么学、怎么核对 / How I Study and Check My Work
我通常先找几条记录，把自己没弄明白的那一步单独拎出来。
I usually start with a handful of records and isolate the step I don’t understand.
比如学样本方差，我就拿四条日增重记录，把每条离均值多远、平方后加起来是多少、最后除以几都写出来。
When learning sample variance, for example, I take four daily-gain records and write out how far each is from the mean, what the squared deviations add up to, and what to divide by.
看育种值表时，我先把性状、单位、遗传基准和准确度放在一起看，再去解读这个数字。
When I read a breeding-value table, I look at the trait, unit, genetic base, and accuracy together before interpreting the number.
到了选配，我就想知道，有了评估结果，做决定之前还要看哪些信息？
When I get to mating, I want to know what else I need to look at before making a decision with the evaluation results.

这一路我在 YouTube 上翻了不少视频，也找了很多文献和讲义。
Along the way, I watched quite a few videos on YouTube and looked up a lot of papers and lecture notes.
其中有一本《数量遗传学》对我帮助很大，碰到遗传力、亲缘关系这些概念时，这本书给了我一个回头查的地方。
One book, Quantitative Genetics, was especially helpful as a reference for concepts such as heritability and relatedness.
我还参加过好几个 BLUP 软件的培训，边学软件怎么用，边补它背后的统计知识。
I also attended several courses on BLUP software and worked on the statistics behind it as I learned how to use the tools.
能读到原文、方便回去查的资料，我尽量放在对应小节和资料来源里。

这一路有很多老师和朋友帮过我，让我在卡住的时候还有地方请教。
A lot of teachers and friends helped me along the way and gave me someone to turn to when I got stuck.
谢谢你们愿意花时间帮我把这些问题一点点弄明白。
Thank you for taking the time to help me make sense of these questions, one at a time.

从一个问题开始 / Start with a Question

方差为什么除以 n−1 / Why variance uses n−1
读 03 第04—06节的五步手算，再看四种抽样结果如何解释无偏修正。

性状是什么 / Understanding traits

三种“关系”如何区分 / Distinguishing different relationships
遗传力与性状相关见 04，动物间亲缘关系见 05。
See 04 for heritability and trait correlations, and 05 for relationships between animals.
这些量描述不同对象，数值相同也不能互换。
These quantities describe different objects and are not interchangeable even when their numerical values match.


表现好为何 EBV 未必高 / Why the best performer may lack the highest EBV
读 06和 07，重点看环境校正、信息量和收缩。
Read 06 and 07, focusing on environmental adjustment, information, and shrinkage.


同胞与基因组 / Siblings and genomics
想理解同胞 EBV 可能相同的原因与基因组的作用，读 05和 08。
For identical sibling EBVs and the role of genomics, read 05 and 08.


有了 EBV 后怎么办 / What to do with EBVs
从第 09 章看评估、选择与选配分别做什么，再到综合选择指数详读核对排序的目标和权重。
Read Chapter 09 for the roles of evaluation, selection, and mating, then check the ranking objective and weights in selection indexes.

01 · 来源要点 / Source points
MU 原文术语“Additive genetic effects”对应加性遗传效应，Purdue 参数页把育种值与可传递优势联系起来。
The MU term “Additive genetic effects” corresponds to additive genetic effects, while the Purdue parameter page connects breeding value with transmissible advantage.
这些来源支持把表型、遗传值和育种值分开，下面用简化例子解释其差别。
These sources support distinguishing phenotype, genetic value, and breeding value, illustrated below with simplified examples.

title: 01-1｜数量遗传学与遗传作用 / Quantitative genetics and genetic effects
section: 02 · 从一个位点开始 / Start with one locus
text:
02 · 从一个位点开始 / Start with one locus
位点是基因组上的一个位置，等位基因是这个位置可出现的不同版本。
A locus is a genomic position, and alleles are alternative versions at that position.
假设某常染色体位点只有 A、a 两个版本，父母都是 Aa，各自产生 A、a 配子的概率各为一半。
Suppose an autosomal locus has alleles A and a, both parents are Aa, and each produces A and a gametes with equal probability.
配子是精子或卵子，在这个简化情形中每个位点只携带一个拷贝。
A gamete is a sperm or egg carrying one copy at each locus in this simplified setting.
Aa×Aa⇒P(AA)=14,P(Aa)=12,P(aa)=14
Aa\times Aa\ \Rightarrow\
P(AA)=\tfrac14,\quad P(Aa)=\tfrac12,\quad P(aa)=\tfrac14

Aa 占一半，是因为父 A 母 a 与父 a 母 A 两条路径都产生 Aa。
Aa has probability one-half because both paternal A with maternal a and paternal a with maternal A produce Aa.
概率描述重复产生许多后代时的比例，不保证一窝四头恰好按 1∶2∶1 分配。
These probabilities describe proportions across many offspring and do not guarantee a 1:2:1 split in a litter of four.



Aa×Aa 遗传棋盘 / Aa×Aa Punnett square


图 01-1A｜父母都是 Aa 时，每个配子组合的概率为 1/4，汇总后 AA、Aa、aa 的概率为 1/4、1/2、1/4。
Figure 01-1A | With two Aa parents, each gamete combination has probability 1/4, giving aggregate AA, Aa, and aa probabilities of 1/4, 1/2, and 1/4.
图中 A、a 仅表示同一常染色体位点的两个版本，没有指定哪个更有利，也未由此规定显隐性表现。
A and a denote two versions at one autosomal locus without specifying which is favorable or assigning dominant and recessive phenotypes.

section: 03 · 加性、显性与互作 / Additivity, dominance, and interaction
text:
03 · 加性、显性与互作 / Additivity, dominance, and interaction
先人为规定 AA、Aa、aa 的某项遗传贡献为 2、1、0 个教学单位，此时杂合子恰好在两个纯合子的中间。
First assign hypothetical genetic contributions of 2, 1, and 0 units to AA, Aa, and aa, placing the heterozygote midway between the homozygotes.
这是一个纯加性示例，每多一个 A 拷贝，贡献就增加 1 个单位。
This is a purely additive example, with each additional A copy adding one unit.
若把 Aa 的贡献改为 1.8，它比纯合子中点 1 高出 0.8，体现这个位点的非加性组合。
Changing the Aa contribution to 1.8 places it 0.8 above the homozygote midpoint of 1, illustrating a nonadditive within-locus combination.
一般群体中的显性偏离还依赖所用加性基准，不能总把这个中点差直接当作动物模型里的 D。
Dominance deviations in a general population also depend on the additive reference, so this midpoint departure is not automatically the model’s D term.
上位互作讨论不同位点组合的影响，区别于同一位点两个拷贝之间的显性。
Epistasis concerns combinations across loci, unlike dominance between two copies at the same locus.

title: 01-1｜数量遗传学与遗传作用 / Quantitative genetics and genetic effects
section: 04 · 从一个位点到数量性状 / From one locus to a quantitative trait
text:
04 · 从一个位点到数量性状 / From one locus to a quantitative trait
数量性状通常由许多位点和环境共同影响，表现为体重、增重等有数值差异的记录。
A quantitative trait commonly reflects many loci and environmental influences, producing numerical variation such as weight or gain.
可以用下面的概念式提醒自己：测量结果还含有环境，并不是基因型的直接读数。
The following conceptual equation reminds us that measurement includes environment rather than directly reading genotype.
Pi=μ+Ai+Di+Ii+Ei
P_i=\mu+A_i+D_i+I_i+E_i

这里 PiP_i 是观测表现，μ\mu 是参考均值，AiA_i 是加性遗传贡献，DiD_i 与 IiI_i 是非加性部分，EiE_i 是环境偏离。
Here PiP_i is observed performance, μ\mu the reference mean, AiA_i the additive contribution, DiD_i and IiI_i nonadditive components, and EiE_i environmental deviation.
若还存在基因型与环境互作，就要扩展这个简式，而不是默认所有影响彼此独立。
Genotype-by-environment interaction requires extending this simplified equation rather than assuming all influences are independent.

title: 01-1｜数量遗传学与遗传作用 / Quantitative genetics and genetic effects
section: 05 · 为什么主要预测加性育种值 / Why predict additive breeding value?
text:
05 · 为什么主要预测加性育种值 / Why predict additive breeding value?
在加性模型中，子代真实育种值可以拆成父母真实育种值的平均与孟德尔抽样偏离。
In an additive model, an offspring’s true breeding value separates into the average parental true values and a Mendelian-sampling deviation.
BVC=12BVS+12BVD+MSC
BV_C=\tfrac12 BV_S+\tfrac12 BV_D+MS_C

假设父母真实 BV 为 +40 与 +20 g/day，则子代条件均值为 +30 g/day，但某个子代仍可高于或低于 30。
If parental true BVs are +40 and +20 g/day, the conditional offspring mean is +30 g/day, while an individual offspring can lie above or below 30.
孟德尔抽样是同一对父母产生不同遗传组合带来的加性偏离，不是技术员抽血取样。
Mendelian sampling is additive deviation caused by different inherited combinations from the same parents, not laboratory sampling of blood.



亲本均值与孟德尔抽样 / Parent average and Mendelian sampling


图 01-1B｜假设父母真实 BV 为 +40 与 +20 g/day，则亲本均值为 +30，三个示例子代通过不同 MS 偏离得到 +20、+30、+40。
Figure 01-1B | Hypothetical parental true BVs of +40 and +20 g/day give a parent average of +30, with three illustrative offspring reaching +20, +30, and +40 through different MS deviations.
图中只画加性遗传值，不含环境，三个子代值不由前面的单个位点计算，也不代表每窝固定分布。
The diagram shows additive genetic values only, excludes environment, and neither derives the offspring values from the earlier single locus nor prescribes a fixed litter distribution.
父母具有的显性与互作组合不保证完整传给每个子代，所以“亲本自身表现”与“作为父母的平均遗传价值”要分开。
Parental dominance and epistatic combinations are not guaranteed intact in every offspring, so own performance must be distinguished from average genetic value as a parent.

section: 06 · 同胞的亲本均值相同，接着看什么 / What Follows a Shared Parent Average
text:
06 · 同胞的亲本均值相同，接着看什么 / What Follows a Shared Parent Average
同父同母的两头猪有相同亲本均值，但孟德尔抽样偏离不同会让它们的真实育种值不同。
Two full siblings have the same parent average, but Mendelian-sampling deviations can give them different true breeding values.
环境也可能不同，我会把它记在表型差异这一栏，跟影响真实育种值的孟德尔抽样分开。
Their environments can also differ, so I record environment under phenotypic differences, separately from the Mendelian sampling that affects true breeding values.
继续阅读 猪性状与 EBV，把遗传概念连接到实际字段。
Continue with pig traits and EBVs to connect genetic concepts with data fields.

同一张猪场表里，日增重、产活仔数和成活看上去都是列，我先看每列怎么测、每行代表谁。
Daily gain, number born alive, and survival all look like columns in a farm table, so I first check how each column was measured and what each row represents.
我把性状定义当数据字典来读，它还须写清哪些动物会表现这个性状、同一个体是否会出现多条记录。

title: 02-0｜性状与类型 / Traits and their types
section: 01 · 一个性状如何定义 / Defining a trait
text:
01 · 一个性状如何定义 / Defining a trait
性状是可描述或测量的生物特征。
A trait is a biological characteristic that can be described or measured.
每项性状都应写清测量对象、单位、时点和方法。
Each trait definition should specify the subject, units, measurement time, and method.
“体重”定义不够，“校正到指定日龄的体重，kg”更适合比较。
“Weight” is incomplete, while “weight adjusted to a specified age, in kg” is more comparable.

02 · 性状与类型 / Traits and their types

title: 02-0｜性状与类型 / Traits and their types
section: 02 · 按业务用途分类 / Classification by purpose
text:
02 · 按业务用途分类 / Classification by purpose

生长 / Growth

平均日增重 ADG是一段时间内的增重除以天数。
Average daily gain (ADG) is weight gained over a period divided by its duration.
达重日龄是达到指定体重时的年龄。
Age at target weight is the age when an animal reaches a specified weight.

在测定条件和健康要求一致时，通常希望日增重提高、达重日龄降低。
Under comparable testing conditions and health requirements, higher ADG and fewer days to target are usually desired.


采食与效率 / Intake and efficiency

平均日采食量 ADFI描述每天吃多少。
Average daily feed intake (ADFI) describes daily feed consumption.
料重比 FCR = 采食量 / 增重，通常越低越好。
Feed conversion ratio (FCR) = feed consumed / weight gained, and lower values are usually preferred.
剩余采食量 RFI是实际采食量减去模型根据维持和生产等需要预测的采食量。
Residual feed intake (RFI) is observed intake minus intake predicted from maintenance and production requirements.

采食少不自动等于效率高，因为动物可能也长得慢。
Low feed intake does not automatically mean high efficiency because the animal may also grow slowly.


繁殖 / Reproduction

TNB是总产仔数。
TNB means total number born.
NBA是产活仔数。
NBA means number born alive.
NW是断奶仔猪数，还会受到寄养、成活与管理影响。
NW means number weaned and also reflects fostering, survival, and management.

初产日龄和分娩间隔也属于繁殖性状。
Age at first farrowing and farrowing interval are also reproductive traits.
TNB、NBA、NW 的统计口径不同，不能混用。
TNB, NBA, and NW use different definitions and are not interchangeable.


胴体、肉质与功能 / Carcass, meat quality, and function
常见例子包括背膘厚 BF、眼肌面积、瘦肉率、肌内脂肪 IMF、肉色、肢蹄、寿命和抗病能力。
Common examples include backfat (BF), loin muscle area, lean percentage, intramuscular fat (IMF), meat color, leg soundness, longevity, and disease resistance.
最优方向依育种目标而定，某些性状需要合理范围而不是无限增加或降低。
The desired direction depends on the breeding objective, and some traits need a target range rather than unlimited change.

title: 02-0｜性状与类型 / Traits and their types
section: 03 · 按数据形态分类 / Classification by data type
text:
03 · 按数据形态分类 / Classification by data type

连续数量性状可以在范围内取许多数值，如体重和背膘。
Continuous quantitative traits take many values within a range, such as weight and backfat.
计数性状取整数，如产仔数。
Count traits take integer values, such as litter size.
二元性状只有两种结果，如是否存活。
Binary traits have two outcomes, such as survival or death.
等级性状有顺序，如肢蹄评分。
Ordinal traits have ordered categories, such as leg scores.
类别性状表示分类，如毛色类别。
Categorical traits describe classes, such as coat-color categories.

把类别编码成 1、2、3，不代表类别之间的间隔相等。
Coding categories as 1, 2, and 3 does not establish equal spacing between them.
质量性状常以离散类别描述，数量性状常受许多基因和环境共同影响。
Qualitative traits are often described by distinct classes, while quantitative traits commonly involve many genes and environmental effects.
离散记录不一定对应单基因遗传，例如存活虽然记为 0/1，遗传基础仍可能很复杂。
Discrete records do not imply single-gene inheritance, since binary survival can still have complex genetic architecture.
阈值模型用潜在的连续易感性跨过阈值，解释观察到的类别结果。
A threshold model explains observed categories through an underlying continuous liability crossing thresholds.

title: 02-0｜性状与类型 / Traits and their types
section: 04 · 按记录方式与作用来源分类 / Recording and sources of effects
text:
04 · 按记录方式与作用来源分类 / Recording and sources of effects

重复记录 / Repeated records
同一母猪的多胎产仔数属于重复记录。
Litter sizes across successive parities of one sow are repeated records.
多胎记录不是多头独立母猪，因为稳定的非遗传影响也可能反复出现。
Several litters are not independent sows because persistent non-genetic influences can recur across records.


限性与伴性 / Sex-limited and sex-linked
限性性状只在某一性别表现，如产仔数。
A sex-limited trait is expressed in one sex, such as litter size.
相关遗传信息可以由两性携带和传递，所以公猪也能有产仔数 EBV。
Both sexes can carry and transmit relevant genetic information, so a boar can have a litter-size EBV.
伴性遗传指相关位点在性染色体上，讨论的是基因位置与传递方式。
Sex-linked inheritance concerns loci on sex chromosomes and their transmission.
限性和伴性是两个不同概念。
Sex-limited expression and sex-linked inheritance are different concepts.


直接与母体遗传 / Direct and maternal genetics
直接遗传效应来自被测动物自身的遗传作用。
Direct genetic effects come from the measured animal’s own genetics.
母体遗传效应来自母亲的遗传组成对后代表现的影响，例如母性能力影响仔猪断奶重。
Maternal genetic effects arise when a mother’s genetics affect offspring performance, such as maternal ability influencing weaning weight.
寄养、子宫条件与母体管理也能产生非遗传母体影响，不能全部归入母体育种值。
Fostering, uterine conditions, and maternal management can create non-genetic maternal effects that do not all belong in maternal breeding value.



仔猪断奶重的直接遗传、母体遗传与非遗传影响 / Direct genetic, maternal genetic, and non-genetic influences on piglet weaning weight


图 02-0A　仔猪自身的基因可直接影响断奶重，母猪的基因可通过母性能力间接影响仔猪断奶重，哺育条件与管理也会影响结果。
Figure 02-0A　A piglet’s genes can affect its weaning weight directly, a sow’s genes can affect it through her maternal ability, and rearing conditions and management can also affect the outcome.
母体遗传路径表示母猪的遗传差异如何通过母性表现影响仔猪，三条箭头仅表示影响来源。
The maternal genetic path shows how a sow’s genetic differences affect piglets through her maternal performance, and the arrows indicate sources of influence.

section: 05 · 分类可以重叠 / Categories can overlap
text:
05 · 分类可以重叠 / Categories can overlap
产活仔数同时是繁殖、计数、限性、重复记录性状。
Number born alive is simultaneously a reproductive, count, sex-limited, repeated-record trait.
这些分类分别描述用途、数值形态、表现性别和记录结构。
These classifications describe purpose, numerical form, sex of expression, and recording structure.



产活仔数同时属于哪四类 / Four classifications for number born alive


图 02-0B　产活仔数（NBA）可同时按用途归为繁殖性状、按取值归为计数性状、按表现归为限性性状，并在同一头母猪的多胎记录中重复测量。
Figure 02-0B　Number born alive (NBA) is a reproductive, count, and sex-limited trait that can be recorded repeatedly across litters of the same sow.
四条线连接的是同一个性状的四种分类角度，观测单位是一胎。
The four lines connect different ways of classifying the same trait, and each observation represents one litter.
缩写和具体口径以实际数据字典为准。
Confirm abbreviations and definitions in the actual data dictionary.

title: 02-0｜性状与类型 / Traits and their types
section: 我的核对笔记 / My Verification Notes
text:
我的核对笔记 / My Verification Notes
例如母猪每胎产活仔数同时是繁殖、计数、限性和重复记录性状，这四个标签分别回答不同问题。
For example, number born alive per sow litter is a reproductive, count, sex-limited, and repeated-record trait, with each label answering a different question.
公猪可以携带并传递相关遗传信息，因此也可以有产活仔数的估计育种值。
A boar can carry and transmit relevant genetic information, so it can also have an estimated breeding value for number born alive.
拿到新数据时，我会先确认一行对应一头猪还是一胎，再核对单位、时点、缺失值以及负责表型表达的动物。
With a new dataset, I first check whether a row represents a pig or a litter, then verify units, timing, missing values, and which animal expresses the phenotype.

02 · 数据编码不等于遗传机制 / Coding is not a genetic mechanism
假设记录某时期是否出现某种不良事件，未出现为 0、出现为 1，且统一观察窗口和事件定义。
Suppose a specified adverse event is recorded as 0 when absent and 1 when present, using a consistent observation window and event definition.
二元描述记录格式，而单基因描述遗传机制，两者不是一回事。
Binary describes the record format, while single-gene describes inheritance, and the two are different.
若腿部评分为轻、中、重，则属于有顺序的类别，但把它们编码为 1、2、3 并不保证间距相等。
Leg scores of mild, moderate, and severe are ordered categories, but coding them 1, 2, and 3 does not establish equal spacing.

section: 03 · 潜在易感性如何生成记录 / How latent liability generates records
text:
03 · 潜在易感性如何生成记录 / How latent liability generates records
设潜在易感性 LL 包含固定条件 μ\mu、加性效应 aa 和残差 ee，但实际只记录它是否高于阈值 cc。
Let latent liability LL contain a fixed component μ\mu, an additive effect aa, and residual ee, while only its position above or below threshold cc is observed.
L=μ+a+e,Y={0,L≤c1,L>c
L=\mu+a+e,\qquad
Y=\begin{cases}0,&L\leq c\\1,&L>c\end{cases}

LL 不是一项已经测量到的血液指标，而是解释类别概率的模型变量。
LL is a model variable explaining category probabilities, not an already measured blood marker.
为了手算，设 ee 为均值 0、标准差 1 的正态变量，且固定 μ=0\mu=0、c=0c=0。
For calculation, assume ee is normal with mean 0 and standard deviation 1, fixing μ=0\mu=0 and c=0c=0.
P(Y=1∣a)=1−Φ(−a)
P(Y=1\mid a)=1-\Phi(-a)

Φ(z)\Phi(z) 表示标准正态变量不超过 zz 的概率，下面代码能直接计算，无需另查表。
Φ(z)\Phi(z) is the probability that a standard normal variable does not exceed zz, calculated directly by the following code without tables.
from statistics import NormalDist

normal = NormalDist()
for a in [-0.5, 0.0, 0.5]:
    risk = 1 - normal.cdf(-a)
    print(f"a={a:+.1f}; event_probability={risk:.4f}")
基础 R 用 pnorm(-a, lower.tail = FALSE) 直接算标准正态分布的右尾概率，对应上面的 1−Φ(−a)1-\Phi(-a)。
In base R, pnorm(-a, lower.tail = FALSE) gives the standard normal upper-tail probability 1−Φ(−a)1-\Phi(-a).
a <- c(-0.5, 0, 0.5)
risk <- pnorm(-a, lower.tail = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("a=%+.1f; event_probability=%.4f\n", a, risk), sep = "")
a=-0.5; event_probability=0.3085
a=+0.0; event_probability=0.5000
a=+0.5; event_probability=0.6915
这些是给定其他模型项和假设参数时的事件概率，不是当前猪群测得的发生率。
These are event probabilities conditional on the other model terms and assumed parameters, not measured incidence in a current herd.



二元记录的阈值与事件概率 / Binary threshold and event probabilities


图 02-3A　在阈值为 0 的教学例子中，潜在易感性 L≤0L\leq0 记作 Y=0Y=0，L>0L>0 记作 Y=1Y=1。
Figure 02-3A　In this teaching example with threshold zero, latent liability L≤0L\leq0 is recorded as Y=0Y=0 and L>0L>0 as Y=1Y=1.
固定 μ=0\mu=0 且 ee 服从标准正态分布时，aa 为 −0.5、0、+0.5 对应的条件事件概率依次约为 0.3085、0.5000、0.6915。
With μ=0\mu=0 and standard-normal ee, the conditional event probabilities at a=−0.5a=-0.5, 00, and +0.5+0.5 are approximately 0.3085, 0.5000, and 0.6915.

section: 04 · 为什么潜在尺度 EBV 不能当百分数 / Why a liability EBV is not a percentage
text:
04 · 为什么潜在尺度 EBV 不能当百分数 / Why a liability EBV is not a percentage
aa 从 0 变为 0.5 时，概率从 0.5 变到约 0.6915，增加约 19.15 个百分点，而不是增加 50 个百分点。
Increasing aa from 0 to 0.5 moves probability from 0.5 to about 0.6915, an increase of about 19.15 percentage points rather than 50.
同样大小的易感性变化，在不同基础风险处可能产生不同概率变化，因此转换关系不是固定直线。
The same liability change can produce different probability changes at different baseline risks, so the conversion is not a fixed straight line.
百分点是两个百分数直接相减的单位，区别于相对增加百分比。
A percentage point is the unit for subtracting two percentages and differs from relative percentage increase.
若还要对未知残差之外的随机项取平均，预测概率需要对应地积分，不能一律把一个 EBV 填入本例公式。
Averaging over additional random terms requires corresponding integration, so an arbitrary EBV cannot always be inserted into this example’s equation.

section: 05 · 三个类别需要两个阈值 / Three categories need two thresholds
text:
05 · 三个类别需要两个阈值 / Three categories need two thresholds
对低、中、高三个有序类别，使用 c1<c2c_1<c_2 两个阈值划分三个区间。
Three ordered categories of low, medium, and high use two thresholds c1<c2c_1<c_2 to define three intervals.
P(Y=1)=Φ(c1−m),P(Y=2)=Φ(c2−m)−Φ(c1−m),P(Y=3)=1−Φ(c2−m)
P(Y=1)=\Phi(c_1-m),\quad
P(Y=2)=\Phi(c_2-m)-\Phi(c_1-m),\quad
P(Y=3)=1-\Phi(c_2-m)

上式仍假设残差标准差为 1，mm 是给定固定与遗传效应后的潜在均值。
These equations still assume residual standard deviation 1, with mm the latent mean conditional on fixed and genetic effects.
取 m=0m=0、c1=0c_1=0、c2=1c_2=1，三个概率约为 0.5000、0.3413、0.1587，相加为 1。
With m=0m=0, c1=0c_1=0, and c2=1c_2=1, the probabilities are approximately 0.5000, 0.3413, and 0.1587 and sum to 1.
如果残差标准差改为 σe\sigma_e，每个正态函数的输入都要除以 σe\sigma_e。
If residual standard deviation becomes σe\sigma_e, each normal-function argument must be divided by σe\sigma_e.

section: 06 · 从潜在尺度走到事件概率 / From the Latent Scale to Event Probability
text:
06 · 从潜在尺度走到事件概率 / From the Latent Scale to Event Probability
看到潜在尺度 EBV 为 +0.2，我会先找该模型的阈值、基础水平、残差尺度和事件方向，再看其他模型项。
When the latent-scale EBV is +0.2, I first look for the model’s thresholds, baseline, residual scale, and event direction, then check the other model terms.
潜在尺度上的 +0.2 是模型单位里的偏移量，事件概率要用这些条件另行换算。
A latent-scale value of +0.2 is a shift in model units, and conversion to an event probability uses those additional conditions.
要描述事件概率增加多少，我会记录换算前后的两个概率，再算差值或相对变化。
To report how much event probability changes, I record the original and revised probabilities, then compute an absolute or relative change.
软件示例中的采样轮数、阈值固定方式和输出均属于原例，不是已经在本地猪群验证的运行方案。
Sampling lengths, threshold constraints, and outputs in the software example belong to that example and are not a locally validated pig-herd workflow.

我想弄清楚方差是怎么来的，就把四条日增重记录写成 700、800、800、900 g/day，先不用软件。
To understand where variance comes from, I start with four daily-gain records of 700, 800, 800, and 900 g/day and work without software first.
用这四个数，我可以先看均值，再看每头偏离多少，最后把自己的手算和 Python 的输出对一遍。
With these four numbers I can find the mean, work out how far each pig deviates, and check the hand calculation against Python.
数据行长得一样，背后却可能是不同的观测单位，所以我也会把统计计算和抽样条件一起记录下来。
Rows can look identical while representing different observation units, so I record sampling conditions together with the calculations.
本章使用自拟的四头猪数据，把主要公式展开到可以手算的程度。
This chapter uses an original four-pig dataset and expands the main equations into calculations you can do by hand.
第一次阅读可先学 01—07 节，再学两个性状的关系，最后学均值的不确定性。
On your first pass, read Sections 01–07, then relationships between two traits, and finally uncertainty in a mean.

title: 03-0｜统计基础：从一行数据到一个结论 / Statistics: from a data row to a conclusion
section: 01 · 总体、样本与一行数据 / Population, sample, and a data row
text:
01 · 总体、样本与一行数据 / Population, sample, and a data row
统计学研究如何收集、整理和分析数据，以及如何在信息不完整时作出有依据的判断。
Statistics studies how to collect, organize, and analyze data and make justified judgments with incomplete information.
描述统计总结已经看到的数据，统计推断尝试从样本了解更大的总体。
Descriptive statistics summarize observed data, while statistical inference uses a sample to learn about a larger population.

总体是你希望了解的全部对象，例如某猪场某批次全部测定猪。
A population contains all units you want to understand, such as all tested pigs in a specified farm batch.
样本是实际取得并用于分析的对象，例如从这批猪中随机抽取的 40 头。
A sample contains the units actually observed and analyzed, such as 40 pigs randomly selected from that batch.
变量是记录的属性，例如日增重、采食量、性别或场区。
A variable is a recorded attribute, such as daily gain, feed intake, sex, or farm site.
观测值是变量在某个对象上的具体取值，例如 A 猪日增重 700 g/day。
An observation value is a variable’s value for a unit, such as Pig A gaining 700 g/day.
观测单位是一条记录所对应的对象或事件，例如一头猪、一次称重或一窝产仔。
An observation unit is the unit or event represented by a record, such as a pig, a weighing, or a litter.
参数描述总体，例如总体均值 μ\mu；统计量由样本算出，例如样本均值 x‾\bar{x}。
A parameter describes a population, such as its mean μ\mu, whereas a statistic is calculated from a sample, such as its mean x‾\bar{x}.

估计量是计算未知参数的规则，估计值是把具体样本代入后得到的数字。
An estimator is a rule for estimating an unknown parameter, and an estimate is the number obtained from a particular sample.
100 头母猪各记录 5 胎得到 500 条记录，但仍然只有 100 头母猪。
Recording five litters from each of 100 sows produces 500 records but still only 100 sows.
独立表示知道一条观测的信息不会改变另一条观测的概率分布，同一母猪的多胎记录通常不满足这一条件。
Independence means information about one observation does not change another observation’s probability distribution, a condition usually violated by repeated litters from one sow.
同分布表示观测来自相同的概率分布，不表示它们的数值必须相同。
Identically distributed means observations share the same probability distribution, not that their values must be identical.
随机抽样让入样机制可解释，但只记录优秀猪会让样本偏离你原本想了解的总体。
Random sampling makes sample inclusion interpretable, whereas recording only outstanding pigs can make the sample unrepresentative of the intended population.

section: 02 · 先认符号 / Read the notation first
text:
02 · 先认符号 / Read the notation first

nn 是样本条数，xix_i 是第 ii 条记录，i=1,…,ni=1,\ldots,n 是记录编号。
nn is the sample size, xix_i is record ii, and i=1,…,ni=1,\ldots,n indexes the records.
∑\sum 表示逐项相加，例如 ∑i=14xi=x1+x2+x3+x4\sum_{i=1}^{4}x_i=x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4。
∑\sum means adding terms, for example ∑i=14xi=x1+x2+x3+x4\sum_{i=1}^{4}x_i=x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4.
x‾\bar{x} 读作“x 的均值”，xi−x‾x_i-\bar{x} 表示第 ii 条记录与均值的差。
x‾\bar{x} is read as “x bar,” and xi−x‾x_i-\bar{x} is the difference between record ii and the mean.
a2a^2 是 a×aa\times a，a\sqrt{a} 是平方根，计算时先处理括号再做平方。
a2a^2 means a×aa\times a, a\sqrt{a} is a square root, and parentheses are evaluated before squaring.
s2s^2 和 ss 通常表示样本方差和样本标准差，σ2\sigma^2 和 σ\sigma 通常表示总体对应量。
s2s^2 and ss usually denote sample variance and sample standard deviation, while σ2\sigma^2 and σ\sigma denote their population counterparts.
ŷ\hat{y} 读作“y 的预测值”，帽子符号提醒你它是估计或预测的结果。
ŷ\hat{y} is read as “y hat,” with the hat indicating an estimate or prediction.

title: 03-0｜统计基础：从一行数据到一个结论 / Statistics: from a data row to a conclusion
section: 03 · 均值、中位数与众数 / Mean, median, and mode
text:
03 · 均值、中位数与众数 / Mean, median, and mode
假设四头猪的日增重为 x=[700,800,800,900]x=[700,800,800,900]，单位统一为 g/day。
Suppose four pigs have daily gains x=[700,800,800,900]x=[700,800,800,900], all measured in g/day.
算术均值把总量平均分给每条记录，用来描述数据中心。
The arithmetic mean divides the total equally among records to describe the center.
x‾=∑xin=700+800+800+9004=32004=800g/day
\bar{x}=\frac{\sum x_i}{n}
=\frac{700+800+800+900}{4}
=\frac{3200}{4}=800\ \mathrm{g/day}

中位数是排序后的中间位置，奇数条取中间一条，偶数条取中间两条的均值。
The median is the center of the sorted values, using the middle value for an odd count and the mean of the two middle values for an even count.
本例中间两条都是 800，所以中位数为 (800+800)/2=800(800+800)/2=800。
Both middle values are 800, so the median is (800+800)/2=800(800+800)/2=800.
众数是出现次数最多的值，本例为 800，数据也可能有多个众数。
The mode is the most frequent value, which is 800 here, and a dataset may have multiple modes.
若最后一条从 900 改为 1700，均值变成 1000，而中位数仍为 800。
If the last value changes from 900 to 1700, the mean becomes 1000 while the median remains 800.
这说明均值容易受极端值影响，中位数对这种改动更稳健。
This shows that the mean is sensitive to extreme values, whereas the median is more robust to this change.
加权均值让不同数值按其代表的数量参与平均，权重之和作为分母。
A weighted mean averages values according to the quantities they represent, using the sum of weights as its denominator.
若 A 组 2 头猪均值为 700，B 组 8 头猪均值为 900，合并均值为 860，而不是两个组均值直接平均所得的 800。
If Group A has two pigs averaging 700 and Group B has eight averaging 900, their combined mean is 860 rather than the unweighted average of group means, 800.
x‾combined=2×700+8×9002+8=860
\bar{x}_{\mathrm{combined}}=\frac{2\times700+8\times900}{2+8}=860

NIST 位置统计量支持本节定义，猪群数值为本教程自拟。
NIST’s measures of location supports these definitions, while the pig examples are original to this tutorial.

title: 03-0｜统计基础：从一行数据到一个结论 / Statistics: from a data row to a conclusion
section: 04 · 样本方差：五步手算 / Sample variance in five steps
text:
04 · 样本方差：五步手算 / Sample variance in five steps
方差用记录偏离均值的平方来描述分散程度，偏离越大时贡献越大。
Variance describes spread using squared deviations from the mean, giving larger deviations more weight.

第一步：先求均值 / Step 1: calculate the mean
沿用四头猪的数据，均值已经算得 x‾=800\bar{x}=800。
Using the same four pigs, we already have x‾=800\bar{x}=800.


第二步：每条记录减去均值 / Step 2: subtract the mean
离差就是观测值减去均值，保留正负号以表示方向。
A deviation is an observed value minus the mean, retaining its sign to show direction.

A 猪：700−800=−100700-800=-100。
Pig A: 700−800=−100700-800=-100.
B 猪：800−800=0800-800=0。
Pig B: 800−800=0800-800=0.
C 猪：800−800=0800-800=0。
Pig C: 800−800=0800-800=0.
D 猪：900−800=100900-800=100。
Pig D: 900−800=100900-800=100.

离差之和是 −100+0+0+100=0-100+0+0+100=0，直接相加会让正负抵消，不能衡量分散。
The deviations sum to −100+0+0+100=0-100+0+0+100=0, so adding them directly cancels their signs and fails to measure spread.


第三步：把每个离差平方 / Step 3: square each deviation
四个平方分别为 (−100)2=10,000(-100)^2=10{,}000、02=00^2=0、02=00^2=0、1002=10,000100^2=10{,}000。
The four squares are (−100)2=10,000(-100)^2=10{,}000, 02=00^2=0, 02=00^2=0, and 1002=10,000100^2=10{,}000.
平方让正负离差都成为非负贡献，单位同时变成 (g/day)2(g/day)^2。
Squaring makes both positive and negative deviations contribute nonnegative amounts and changes the units to (g/day)2(g/day)^2.


第四步：加总得到离差平方和 / Step 4: sum the squared deviations
离差平方和 SS只是平方偏离的总量，此时还不是方差。
The sum of squared deviations (SS) is the total squared departure and is not yet a variance.
SSx=∑i=14(xi−x‾)2=10,000+0+0+10,000=20,000
SS_x=\sum_{i=1}^{4}(x_i-\bar{x})^2
=10{,}000+0+0+10{,}000=20{,}000



第五步：除以 n−1 / Step 5: divide by n−1
用样本均值估计总体均值时，通常用 n−1n-1 修正平方和的平均方式。
When the sample mean estimates the population mean, the usual variance estimator divides the squared deviations by n−1n-1.
s2=SSxn−1=20,0004−1=20,0003≈6,666.67(g/day)2
s^2=\frac{SS_x}{n-1}
=\frac{20{,}000}{4-1}
=\frac{20{,}000}{3}
\approx6{,}666.67\ (\mathrm{g/day})^2

这个数字描述原始日增重记录的分散，不能直接当作加性遗传方差。
This number describes variation in the raw daily-gain records and cannot directly be treated as additive genetic variance.



样本方差逐步计算 / Sample variance calculation


图 03-0A　四头猪的平均日增重为 800 g/day，四个离差的平方加总得到 SSx=20,000SS_x=20{,}000，样本方差为 20,000/(4−1)≈6,666.67(g/day)220{,}000/(4-1)\approx6{,}666.67\,(\mathrm{g/day})^2。
Figure 03-0A　The four pigs have a mean daily gain of 800 g/day and squared deviations summing to SSx=20,000SS_x=20{,}000, which gives sample variance 20,000/(4−1)≈6,666.67(g/day)220{,}000/(4-1)\approx6{,}666.67\,(\mathrm{g/day})^2.


用 Python 和 R 对一次手算 / Check the Hand Calculation in Python and R
我会用 Python 标准库把四个输入和输出一起留底，这样再看到其他程序的结果时，就能用同一组数对照。
I use the Python standard library to keep the four inputs and their outputs together, so I can compare other programs on the same data.
这组数据的均值与标准差以 g/day 计量，样本方差的单位是 (g/day)2(\mathrm{g/day})^2。
In this dataset, the mean and standard deviation are in g/day, and sample variance is in (g/day)2(\mathrm{g/day})^2.
from statistics import mean, variance, stdev

records = [700, 800, 800, 900]
print(f'mean={mean(records):.2f}, variance={variance(records):.2f}, sd={stdev(records):.2f}')
同一组记录在基础 R 里可以用 mean()、var() 和 sd() 复算，三个结果可对照下方的共同输出。
In base R, mean(), var(), and sd() reproduce the three numbers in the shared output below.
这里 var() 用 n−1n-1 作分母，sd() 是这个样本方差的平方根。
Here var() uses n−1n-1 in the denominator, and sd() takes the square root of that sample variance.
records <- c(700, 800, 800, 900)

cat(sprintf(
  "mean=%.2f, variance=%.2f, sd=%.2f\n",
  mean(records), var(records), sd(records)
))
复算输出如下，两个小数位是显示格式。
The reproduced output is shown below, with two decimals used for display.
mean=800.00, variance=6666.67, sd=81.65
同一输入若改用总体方差函数，分母就从 3 变为 4，结果是 5,000。
Using a population-variance function on the same inputs changes the denominator from 3 to 4 and yields 5,000.

section: 05 · 为什么除以 n−1 / Why divide by n−1?
text:
05 · 为什么除以 n−1 / Why divide by n−1?
自由度是满足已有约束后还能独立变化的数量，本例约束是所有离差之和必须为 0。
Degrees of freedom count how many quantities can vary independently after constraints, with deviations here constrained to sum to zero.
四个离差中只要前三个已确定，最后一个就必须等于前三个之和的相反数。
Once the first three of four deviations are fixed, the last must be the negative of their sum.
因此剩下 4−1=34-1=3 个自由度，这不表示删掉一头猪或忽略一条记录。
This leaves 4−1=34-1=3 degrees of freedom and does not mean deleting a pig or ignoring a record.
样本均值根据当前样本调整位置，通常比真实总体均值更贴近这批数据，因此用它算出的平方偏离会偏小。
The sample mean adapts to the current sample and is typically closer to its values than the true population mean, making the resulting squared deviations too small on average.

用四种抽样结果看修正 / See the correction across four samples
另设一个只有数值 0 和 2、两者概率各为一半的教学总体，它的均值为 1、总体方差为 1。
Consider a separate teaching population taking values 0 and 2 with equal probability, with mean 1 and population variance 1.
独立有放回抽取两个值时，下面四种有序样本概率相同。
Two independent draws with replacement produce the following four equally likely ordered samples.

样本 (0,0)(0,0) 的均值为 0，离差平方和为 0。
Sample (0,0)(0,0) has mean 0 and squared-deviation sum 0.
样本 (0,2)(0,2) 的均值为 1，离差平方和为 2。
Sample (0,2)(0,2) has mean 1 and squared-deviation sum 2.
样本 (2,0)(2,0) 的均值为 1，离差平方和为 2。
Sample (2,0)(2,0) has mean 1 and squared-deviation sum 2.
样本 (2,2)(2,2) 的均值为 2，离差平方和为 0。
Sample (2,2)(2,2) has mean 2 and squared-deviation sum 0.

若都除以 n=2n=2，四个方差结果为 0,1,1,00,1,1,0，长期平均为 0.5，小于真实方差 1。
Dividing by n=2n=2 gives variance results 0,1,1,00,1,1,0, whose long-run average is 0.5, below the true variance of 1.
若都除以 n−1=1n-1=1，结果为 0,2,2,00,2,2,0，长期平均恰好等于真实方差 1。
Dividing by n−1=1n-1=1 gives 0,2,2,00,2,2,0, whose long-run average equals the true variance of 1.
无偏表示按同一机制反复抽样时估计值的平均等于真实参数，不表示每次估计都准确。
Unbiased means estimates average to the true parameter under repeated sampling by the same mechanism, not that every estimate is accurate.
对独立同分布且具有有限方差的样本，s2s^2 的这一无偏性质不要求总体服从正态分布。
For independent, identically distributed observations with finite variance, this unbiasedness of s2s^2 does not require a normal population.


什么情况用 n / When is n appropriate?
若四头猪就是你要描述的完整总体，计算该总体的平均平方偏离时用 n=4n=4，结果为 20,000/4=5,00020{,}000/4=5{,}000。
If the four pigs are the entire population being described, their population mean squared deviation uses n=4n=4, giving 20,000/4=5,00020{,}000/4=5{,}000.
若真实总体均值已经由外部准确给定，围绕这个已知均值估计方差也有使用 nn 的情况，所以应先明确估计问题。
If the true population mean is known exactly from outside the sample, estimating variance around that known mean can also use nn, so define the estimation problem first.
只有一个观测时，样本方差的分母为 0，因此无法估计，而不是“方差一定为 0”。
With one observation, the sample-variance denominator is zero, so variance cannot be estimated rather than being necessarily zero.
Python 官方统计文档分别提供 variance 与 pvariance，对应样本方差与总体方差的常见计算约定。
The official Python statistics documentation distinguishes variance from pvariance, reflecting the usual sample and population variance conventions.

section: 06 · 标准差：把单位还原 / Standard deviation: restore the units
text:
06 · 标准差：把单位还原 / Standard deviation: restore the units
标准差 SD是方差的平方根，用原始单位表达分散程度。
Standard deviation (SD) is the square root of variance and expresses spread in the original units.
s=s2=20,000/3≈81.65g/day
s=\sqrt{s^2}=\sqrt{20{,}000/3}\approx81.65\ \mathrm{g/day}

81.65 g/day 是对分散程度的概括，不表示每头猪恰好偏离均值 81.65，也不是 81.65%。
The 81.65 g/day summarizes spread and does not mean every pig differs from the mean by exactly 81.65 or by 81.65%.
所有记录相同时标准差为 0，记录越分散时标准差通常越大。
Standard deviation is zero when all records are identical and generally increases as records spread out.
标准差本身不要求正态分布，但用“均值加减一个标准差”推算固定覆盖比例需要额外分布条件。
Standard deviation itself does not require normality, but assigning a fixed coverage proportion to one standard deviation around a mean requires distributional assumptions.
虽然 s2s^2 在上述抽样条件下无偏，开平方后的 ss 通常不是总体标准差的无偏估计。
Although s2s^2 is unbiased under the stated sampling conditions, its square root ss is generally not unbiased for the population standard deviation.
NIST 离散程度进一步区分方差、标准差及其他分散指标。
NIST’s measures of scale distinguishes variance, standard deviation, and other measures of spread.

section: 07 · 分布、极差与异常值 / Distribution, range, and outliers
text:
07 · 分布、极差与异常值 / Distribution, range, and outliers
分布描述不同取值出现得有多频繁，包括中心、分散和形状。
A distribution describes how frequently different values occur, including its center, spread, and shape.
直方图把数值划入区间并统计各区间频数，区间宽度会影响看到的形状。
A histogram groups values into bins and counts their frequencies, with bin width affecting the visible shape.
正态分布是左右对称的钟形概率分布，不能因为数据有均值和标准差就认定它是正态的。
A normal distribution is a symmetric, bell-shaped probability distribution, and having a mean and standard deviation does not establish normality.
偏态表示分布不对称，向高值延伸较长尾部称为右偏。
Skewness describes distributional asymmetry, with a longer tail toward high values called right skew.
极差等于最大值减最小值，本例为 900−700=200900-700=200 g/day，但它只使用两个端点。
The range is the maximum minus the minimum, here 900−700=200900-700=200 g/day, but uses only the two endpoints.
异常值是相对其他记录显得特别不同的值，它可能来自录入错误，也可能是真实个体差异。
An outlier is unusually different from other records and may reflect an entry error or real individual variation.
先核对单位、身份和测定条件，再决定如何处理异常值，不能仅因它“不好看”就删除。
Check units, identity, and measurement conditions before handling an outlier, rather than deleting it merely because it looks inconvenient.
NIST 分布概念提供位置、分散和形状的基本框架。
NIST’s distribution overview provides the framework of location, spread, and shape.

section: 08 · 协方差：两个性状一起偏离 / Covariance: two traits deviating together
text:
08 · 协方差：两个性状一起偏离 / Covariance: two traits deviating together
给四头猪增加日采食量 yy，每一对数值都必须来自同一头猪。
Add daily feed intake yy for each pig, keeping each pair of values matched to the same animal.

A 猪：x=700x=700 g/day，y=2y=2 kg/day。
Pig A: x=700x=700 g/day and y=2y=2 kg/day.
B 猪：x=800x=800 g/day，y=3y=3 kg/day。
Pig B: x=800x=800 g/day and y=3y=3 kg/day.
C 猪：x=800x=800 g/day，y=4y=4 kg/day。
Pig C: x=800x=800 g/day and y=4y=4 kg/day.
D 猪：x=900x=900 g/day，y=3y=3 kg/day。
Pig D: x=900x=900 g/day and y=3y=3 kg/day.

协方差把同一头猪两个性状的离差相乘，再汇总这些乘积。
Covariance multiplies deviations of two traits within each pig and summarizes those products.
同向离差产生正乘积，反向离差产生负乘积，任一离差为 0 时乘积为 0。
Deviations in the same direction produce a positive product, opposite directions a negative product, and any zero deviation a zero product.
x‾=800,y‾=3
\bar{x}=800,\qquad \bar{y}=3

xi−x‾=[−100,0,0,100],yi−y‾=[−1,0,1,0]
x_i-\bar{x}=[-100,0,0,100],\qquad
y_i-\bar{y}=[-1,0,1,0]

SSxy=(−100)(−1)+0×0+0×1+100×0=100
SS_{xy}=(-100)(-1)+0\times0+0\times1+100\times0=100

sxy=SSxyn−1=1003≈33.33(g/day)(kg/day)
s_{xy}=\frac{SS_{xy}}{n-1}=\frac{100}{3}\approx33.33\ (\mathrm{g/day})(\mathrm{kg/day})

正协方差表示这批记录总体上倾向于同向偏离，但数值大小受到计量单位影响。
Positive covariance indicates an overall tendency toward deviations in the same direction in these records, but its magnitude depends on units.
不能分别排序两列再计算，因为那会破坏猪只之间的原始配对。
Do not sort the columns independently before calculation, because this destroys the original animal pairing.
把多个性状的方差和协方差排成方阵，就得到后文育种模型会使用的协方差矩阵。
Arranging variances and covariances of multiple traits in a square array produces a covariance matrix used in later breeding models.
03-1 详读从本例推导矩阵，并对应解释 NIST 原始页面。
Reading 03-1 builds the matrix from this example and explains the original NIST page.

section: 09 · 相关系数：消除单位再比较 / Correlation: compare without units
text:
09 · 相关系数：消除单位再比较 / Correlation: compare without units
皮尔逊相关系数 rr用两个标准差的乘积缩放协方差，得到无单位的线性关系指标。
Pearson’s correlation coefficient rr divides covariance by the product of two standard deviations to give a unitless measure of linear association.
线性关系表示用一条直线描述两个变量的变化趋势，rr 的取值只能在 −1-1 到 11 之间。
A linear relationship describes how two variables vary along a straight-line trend, and rr must lie between −1-1 and 11.
采食量的离差平方和为 1+0+1+0=21+0+1+0=2，所以 sy2=2/3s_y^2=2/3、sy≈0.8165s_y\approx0.8165 kg/day。
Feed intake has squared-deviation sum 1+0+1+0=21+0+1+0=2, giving sy2=2/3s_y^2=2/3 and sy≈0.8165s_y\approx0.8165 kg/day.
r=sxysxsy=SSxySSxSSy=10020,000×2=0.5
r=\frac{s_{xy}}{s_xs_y}
=\frac{SS_{xy}}{\sqrt{SS_xSS_y}}
=\frac{100}{\sqrt{20{,}000\times2}}=0.5


r>0r>0 表示正向线性关系，r<0r<0 表示反向线性关系。
r>0r>0 indicates a positive linear relationship, and r<0r<0 a negative one.
r=1r=1 或 r=−1r=-1 表示所有点精确落在一条非水平直线上，前提是两个变量都有变化。
r=1r=1 or r=−1r=-1 means all points lie exactly on a nonhorizontal straight line, provided both variables vary.
r=0r=0 表示没有样本线性相关，不表示完全没有关系。
r=0r=0 means no sample linear correlation, not necessarily no relationship.

例如 x=[−2,−1,0,1,2]x=[-2,-1,0,1,2]、y=x2=[4,1,0,1,4]y=x^2=[4,1,0,1,4] 的相关为 0，却存在完全确定的曲线关系。
For example, x=[−2,−1,0,1,2]x=[-2,-1,0,1,2] and y=x2=[4,1,0,1,4]y=x^2=[4,1,0,1,4] have zero correlation despite a fully deterministic curved relationship.
把 g 换成 kg 不会改变本例的相关系数，但会改变协方差数值。
Converting g to kg leaves this example’s correlation unchanged but changes its covariance.
如果某个变量完全不变，其标准差为 0，相关公式无法计算。
If either variable is constant, its standard deviation is zero and correlation is undefined.
相关 0.5 不表示解释了 50% 的原因，也不能把原始表型相关直接称为遗传相关。
A correlation of 0.5 does not mean explaining 50% of the cause, and raw phenotypic correlation cannot directly be called genetic correlation.
03-2 详读进一步解释平方后的 r2r^2 和显著性，对应 NIST 相关系数页面。
Reading 03-2 explains r2r^2 and significance using the NIST correlation page.

section: 10 · 回归、预测与残差 / Regression, prediction, and residuals
text:
10 · 回归、预测与残差 / Regression, prediction, and residuals
回归用一个或多个变量描述结果的条件变化，本节用日增重 xx 拟合日采食量 yy。
Regression describes how an outcome varies conditionally on one or more variables, here fitting daily feed intake yy from daily gain xx.
简单直线写作 ŷ=a+bx\hat{y}=a+bx，其中 截距 aa 是 x=0x=0 时直线的预测值，斜率 bb 是 xx 每增加一个单位时预测值的变化量。
A simple line is ŷ=a+bx\hat{y}=a+bx, where the intercept aa is its prediction at x=0x=0 and the slope bb is the predicted change per unit increase in xx.
普通最小二乘 OLS选择使残差平方和最小的截距和斜率，单变量且含截距时可按下式手算。
Ordinary least squares (OLS) selects the intercept and slope minimizing squared residuals, with the following hand calculation for one predictor and an intercept.
b=SSxySSx=10020,000=0.005,a=y‾−bx‾=3−0.005×800=−1
b=\frac{SS_{xy}}{SS_x}=\frac{100}{20{,}000}=0.005,
\qquad a=\bar{y}-b\bar{x}=3-0.005\times800=-1

ŷ=−1+0.005x
\hat{y}=-1+0.005x

斜率表示日增重每增加 100 g/day，直线预测的采食量增加 0.5 kg/day，这是关联拟合而非因果结论。
The slope means each additional 100 g/day of gain corresponds to 0.5 kg/day more predicted intake, an association rather than a causal conclusion.
残差 eie_i等于观测值减去模型预测值，正值表示实际值高于预测。
A residual eie_i is the observed value minus the fitted value, with a positive value indicating an observation above its prediction.
ŷ=[2.5,3,3,3.5],ei=yi−ŷi=[−0.5,0,1,−0.5]
\hat{y}=[2.5,3,3,3.5],\qquad
e_i=y_i-\hat{y}_i=[-0.5,0,1,-0.5]

SSE=∑ei2=0.25+0+1+0.25=1.5
SSE=\sum e_i^2=0.25+0+1+0.25=1.5

在独立、同方差且直线均值模型正确的通常条件下，误差方差估计为 SSE/(n−p)SSE/(n-p)，这里估计了截距和斜率两个参数，所以 p=2p=2。
Under the usual independent, equal-variance errors and correct linear mean model, error variance is estimated by SSE/(n−p)SSE/(n-p), with p=2p=2 because an intercept and a slope were fitted.
σ̂e2=1.54−2=0.75(kg/day)2
\hat{\sigma}_e^2=\frac{1.5}{4-2}=0.75\ (\mathrm{kg/day})^2

这个残差方差不同于原始采食量的样本方差 2/32/3，因为描述对象和分母都不同。
This residual variance differs from the raw intake sample variance 2/32/3 because both the target and denominator differ.
截距为负不表示猪会负采食，因为 x=0x=0 远超本例 700—900 g/day 的数据范围。
A negative intercept does not imply negative feed intake, because x=0x=0 is far outside the observed range of 700–900 g/day.
外推是把模型用于观测范围之外，计算得到数字不等于这种预测有依据。
Extrapolation applies a model outside its observed range, and obtaining a number does not establish a justified prediction.
混杂是多个影响来源纠缠在一起，例如某公猪的后代全部获得更好的饲料，使父系与饲料作用难以分开。
Confounding occurs when influences are entangled, such as all offspring of one sire receiving better feed, making sire and diet effects hard to separate.
残差可能包含未建模的环境、遗传作用与测量误差，因此不能直接当作育种值。
Residuals can contain unmodeled environment, genetics, and measurement error, so they are not automatically breeding values.
NIST 最小二乘解释平方残差准则及参数数量与残差自由度的关系。
NIST’s least-squares reference explains the squared-residual criterion and the relationship between parameter count and residual degrees of freedom.

section: 11 · 标准误：均值有多不稳定 / Standard error: how variable is the mean?
text:
11 · 标准误：均值有多不稳定 / Standard error: how variable is the mean?
抽样分布是按同样方法反复抽样并计算同一个统计量时，该统计量形成的分布。
A sampling distribution is the distribution of a statistic obtained by repeatedly sampling and calculating it in the same way.
标准误 SE是估计量抽样分布的标准差，反映重复抽样时估计结果有多大波动。
A standard error (SE) is the standard deviation of an estimator’s sampling distribution and reflects how estimates vary across repeated samples.
对独立同分布且方差有限的样本，均值的真实标准误为 σ/n\sigma/\sqrt{n}，通常用 s/ns/\sqrt{n} 估计。
For independent, identically distributed observations with finite variance, the mean’s true standard error is σ/n\sigma/\sqrt{n}, usually estimated by s/ns/\sqrt{n}.
SÊ(x‾)=sn=81.649658…4≈40.82g/day
\widehat{SE}(\bar{x})=\frac{s}{\sqrt{n}}
=\frac{81.649658\ldots}{\sqrt{4}}
\approx40.82\ \mathrm{g/day}

SD 描述猪与猪之间的分散，SE 描述估计出来的均值在重复抽样中的波动。
SD describes spread among pigs, whereas SE describes how the estimated mean varies across repeated samples.
在总体分散程度和抽样条件相同时，样本量从 4 增到 16 会让真实均值标准误减半，但不会让猪之间的真实标准差减半。
With the same population spread and sampling conditions, increasing sample size from 4 to 16 halves the mean’s true standard error without halving the true standard deviation among pigs.
同窝关系和同一动物的重复记录可能产生相关性，不能把记录总条数直接当作独立样本量。
Litter relationships and repeated animal records can create dependence, so the total record count cannot simply be treated as an independent sample size.
