section: 12 · 置信区间：给均值一个区间 / Confidence interval: a range for the mean
text:
12 · 置信区间：给均值一个区间 / Confidence interval: a range for the mean
置信区间是用样本构造的参数区间，其置信水平描述该构造方法在重复抽样中的覆盖比例。
A confidence interval is a sample-based interval for a parameter, with its confidence level describing the procedure’s coverage under repeated sampling.
为了演示计算，额外假设四条记录来自独立同分布的正态总体且总体标准差未知。
For this calculation, additionally assume four independent observations from the same normal population with an unknown population standard deviation.
这些条件是教学假设，不能由四条自拟数据本身证明。
These are teaching assumptions and cannot be established by four invented observations.
总体均值的双侧 95% t 置信区间使用下面的公式。
A two-sided 95% t confidence interval for the population mean uses the following equation.
x‾±t0.975,n−1sn
\bar{x}\pm t_{0.975,n-1}\frac{s}{\sqrt{n}}

t 分布用于这类标准差未知的正态均值推断，样本较小时比标准正态分布保留更厚的尾部。
The t distribution supports this normal-mean inference with unknown standard deviation and has heavier tails than the standard normal for small samples.
双侧 95% 留下两端各 2.5%，所以累计概率取 1−0.025=0.9751-0.025=0.975，自由度为 4−1=34-1=3。
A two-sided 95% interval leaves 2.5% in each tail, so the cumulative probability is 1−0.025=0.9751-0.025=0.975, with 4−1=34-1=3 degrees of freedom.
NIST t 表给出此处临界值约为 3.182，以下统一使用这个舍入值。
The NIST t table gives a critical value of approximately 3.182, and the calculations below consistently use that rounded value.
margin=3.182×40.824829…≈129.90g/day
\mathrm{margin}=3.182\times40.824829\ldots\approx129.90\ \mathrm{g/day}

CI=800±129.90≈[670.10,929.90]g/day
\mathrm{CI}=800\pm129.90\approx[670.10,929.90]\ \mathrm{g/day}

95% 指长期反复按此方法构造的区间约有 95% 覆盖真实总体均值，不是 95% 的猪落在这个区间。
The 95% means approximately 95% of intervals constructed this way cover the true population mean over repeated sampling, not that 95% of pigs lie in this interval.
在这里的频率学派解释中，已算出的区间与固定的真实均值之间只有覆盖或不覆盖，不能把 95% 直接说成真实均值落入本次区间的概率。
In this frequentist interpretation, the calculated interval either covers the fixed true mean or does not, so 95% is not directly a probability that the true mean lies in this particular interval.
NIST 均值置信区间是公式与覆盖解释的核对来源。
NIST’s confidence interval for the mean supports the equation and coverage interpretation.



总体平均日增重的 t 置信区间 / t confidence interval for mean daily gain


图 03-0B　中点是样本均值 800 g/day，线段两端 670.10 和 929.90 g/day 来自正文按 t≈3.182t\approx3.182 计算的双侧 95% t 置信区间。
Figure 03-0B　The center marks the sample mean of 800 g/day, and the endpoints at 670.10 and 929.90 g/day use the chapter’s rounded t≈3.182t\approx3.182 for the two-sided 95% t confidence interval.
这个区间用来估计总体均值，并采用正文的独立正态抽样假设。
The interval estimates the population mean under the independent normal sampling assumptions described in the chapter.

section: 13 · 数据质量与三种误差 / Data quality and three kinds of error
text:
13 · 数据质量与三种误差 / Data quality and three kinds of error

缺失值表示没有可用记录，不能一律填成真实观测值 0。
A missing value means no observation is available and must not automatically be replaced by a genuine observed zero.
重复导入是把同一次测量算了多次，区别于同一动物在不同日期产生的合法重复测量。
Duplicate import counts one measurement multiple times and differs from legitimate repeated measurements of an animal on different dates.
随机误差使结果围绕目标波动，系统偏差使结果持续偏向某个方向。
Random error makes results fluctuate around a target, whereas systematic bias pushes results persistently in one direction.
浮点误差来自计算机有限位数表示数字，区别于抽到哪些动物造成的抽样误差。
Floating-point error comes from finite numerical representation and differs from sampling error caused by which animals are observed.

统一单位、保留淘汰与缺失原因，并核对动物编号和测定批次，通常比盲目增加数据更先影响结果是否可信。
Consistent units, recorded exclusion and missingness reasons, and verified animal IDs and batches often affect credibility before simply adding more data does.
更多数据能减少部分随机误差，但不会自动修正只留优秀猪造成的选择偏差。
More data can reduce some random error without automatically correcting selection bias from retaining only outstanding pigs.
03-3 详读提供可直接运行的标准库代码，并解释 NIST 数值认证原文中的精度概念。
Reading 03-3 provides runnable standard-library code and explains precision in the original NIST certification page.

14 · 一页复盘 / One-page recap

中心位置：日增重均值为 800 g/day，中位数和众数也都是 800 g/day。
Center: daily gain has mean 800 g/day, with median and mode also 800 g/day.
单性状分散：样本方差约为 6666.67 (g/day)2(g/day)^2，样本标准差约为 81.65 g/day。
Single-trait spread: sample variance is approximately 6666.67 (g/day)2(g/day)^2 and sample standard deviation is approximately 81.65 g/day.
均值不确定性：满足独立抽样等条件时，估计的均值标准误约为 40.82 g/day。
Uncertainty in the mean: under conditions including independent sampling, the estimated standard error is approximately 40.82 g/day.
两个性状关系：样本协方差约为 33.33 (g/day)(kg/day)(g/day)(kg/day)，相关系数为 0.5。
Two-trait association: sample covariance is approximately 33.33 (g/day)(kg/day)(g/day)(kg/day) and correlation is 0.5.
模型剩余差异：直线拟合后的残差平方和为 1.5 (kg/day)2(kg/day)^2，不能与原始日增重方差混用。
Remaining model variation: the fitted line has residual squared sum 1.5 (kg/day)2(kg/day)^2, which must not be confused with raw daily-gain variance.

text:
15 · 用四个变化核对统计量 / Four Changes That Check the Statistics
给四条日增重各加 100 g/day，均值从 800 变为 900 g/day，离差保持原样，样本方差仍为 20,000/320{,}000/3。
Adding 100 g/day to each record moves the mean from 800 to 900 g/day, leaves deviations unchanged, and keeps sample variance at 20,000/320{,}000/3.
单位从 g/day 改成 kg/day 时，标准差除以 1000，约为 0.08165 kg/day，方差除以 100021000^2，约为 0.006667 (kg/day)2(\mathrm{kg/day})^2。
Converting g/day to kg/day divides the standard deviation by 1,000 to about 0.08165 kg/day and the variance by 100021000^2 to about 0.006667 (kg/day)2(\mathrm{kg/day})^2.
四条记录来自本例假设的独立正态样本且总体标准差未知，因此均值区间用自由度 3、临界值约 3.182 的 t 分布。
The mean interval uses the t distribution with three degrees of freedom and a critical value near 3.182, because the four observations are assumed to be an independent normal sample with unknown population standard deviation.
1.96 是标准正态分布的双侧 95% 临界值，在此处对应总体标准差已知的正态均值区间。
The value 1.96 is the two-sided 95% standard normal critical value, applicable here to the normal mean interval with known population standard deviation.
若拿到 20 胎记录，我会查它们来自多少头母猪，再区分同一母猪重复记录和动物间亲缘带来的依赖。
With 20 litter records, I would check how many sows produced them, then distinguish dependence due to repeated records from dependence due to relationships among animals.

先逐列减去均值，得到 dx=[−100,0,0,100]d_x=[-100,0,0,100] 与 dy=[−1,0,1,0]d_y=[-1,0,1,0]。

04 · 正负、强弱与零 / Sign, strength, and zero
将 yy 换成 2x+12x+1 会得到 r=1r=1，换成 −2x+1-2x+1 会得到 r=−1r=-1。
Replacing yy with 2x+12x+1 gives r=1r=1, while replacing it with −2x+1-2x+1 gives r=−1r=-1.
绝对值接近 1 表示更贴近一条直线，但“多大算强”取决于性状、用途和数据条件，没有跨情境统一门槛。
Magnitudes closer to 1 indicate a closer straight-line fit, but what counts as strong depends on traits, purpose, and data conditions rather than a universal cutoff.
零相关不能排除曲线关系，例如 u=[−2,−1,0,1,2]u=[-2,-1,0,1,2] 与 v=u2v=u^2。
Zero correlation does not exclude a curved relationship, as shown by u=[−2,−1,0,1,2]u=[-2,-1,0,1,2] and v=u2v=u^2.
这个反例中 u‾=0\bar{u}=0、v‾=2\bar{v}=2，交叉乘积和为 −4+1+0−1+4=0-4+1+0-1+4=0，所以 r=0r=0。
In this example, u‾=0\bar{u}=0 and v‾=2\bar{v}=2, giving cross-product sum −4+1+0−1+4=0-4+1+0-1+4=0 and therefore r=0r=0.



零皮尔逊相关的二次曲线反例 / Quadratic example with zero Pearson correlation


图 03-2A　五个点沿 v=u2v=u^2 分布，左右对称的离差乘积抵消，因此这组点的皮尔逊相关为 r=0r=0。
Figure 03-2A　The five points follow v=u2v=u^2, and the centered cross-products cancel by symmetry, giving Pearson correlation r=0r=0.
两个变量独立且二阶矩存在时协方差为 0，但反过来“协方差为 0 就独立”一般不成立。
Independence implies zero covariance when second moments exist, but zero covariance does not generally imply independence.
任何一列都相同时，其平方偏离和为 0，分母变成 0，因此结果应标为未定义。
If either column is constant, its squared-deviation sum is zero and the denominator vanishes, so the result should be marked undefined.

title: 03-2｜相关系数与回归辨析详读 / Correlation versus regression
section: 05 · 相关与回归为什么不同 / Why correlation and regression differ
text:
05 · 相关与回归为什么不同 / Why correlation and regression differ
相关交换 xx 与 yy 后不变，而回归必须指定哪个变量用于预测哪个结果。
Correlation is unchanged when xx and yy are swapped, whereas regression specifies which variable predicts which outcome.
拟合采食量对日增重的直线时，斜率为 by|x=100/20,000=0.005b_{y|x}=100/20{,}000=0.005。
Fitting intake from gain gives slope by|x=100/20,000=0.005b_{y|x}=100/20{,}000=0.005.
反过来拟合日增重对采食量时，斜率为 bx|y=100/2=50b_{x|y}=100/2=50，并不是 0.0050.005 的倒数 200。
Reversing the regression to fit gain from intake gives bx|y=100/2=50b_{x|y}=100/2=50, not the reciprocal of 0.0050.005, which is 200.
ŷ=−1+0.005x,x̂=650+50y
\hat{y}=-1+0.005x,\qquad
\hat{x}=650+50y

原因是两次拟合分别最小化不同方向的残差，普通最小二乘不会自动把两列都当作无误差的因果量。
The fits minimize residuals in different directions, and ordinary least squares does not automatically treat both columns as error-free causal quantities.



交换预测方向时的两条回归式 / Two regression equations for reversed prediction


图 03-2B　同一组四头猪的数据在交换变量后仍有 r=0.5r=0.5，两次普通最小二乘拟合分别最小化采食量方向与日增重方向的残差平方和。
Figure 03-2B　The same four pigs give r=0.5r=0.5 in either order, while the two ordinary least-squares fits minimize the sum of squared residuals along feed intake and daily gain, respectively.

section: 06 · r 平方到底表示什么 / What does r squared mean?
text:
06 · r 平方到底表示什么 / What does r squared mean?
总平方和 SST是结果 yy 相对自身均值的平方偏离，本例为 2。
The total sum of squares (SST) measures squared deviations of outcome yy from its own mean and equals 2 here.
残差平方和 SSE是 yy 相对拟合值的平方偏离，本例为 1.5。
The residual sum of squares (SSE) measures squared deviations of yy from fitted values and equals 1.5 here.
决定系数 R2R^2在这里衡量加入直线预测后，相对只用均值预测减少了多少比例的平方偏离。
The coefficient of determination R2R^2 here measures the proportional reduction in squared deviation from fitting the line rather than predicting only the mean.
R2=1−SSESST=1−1.52=0.25
R^2=1-\frac{SSE}{SST}=1-\frac{1.5}{2}=0.25

在使用同一批数据、一个解释变量、含截距的普通最小二乘回归中，R2=r2=0.25R^2=r^2=0.25。
For ordinary least squares on the same data with one predictor and an intercept, R2=r2=0.25R^2=r^2=0.25.
这表示本次样本内平方偏离减少了 25%，不表示发现了 25% 的生物学原因或 25% 的遗传力。
This means a 25% reduction in within-sample squared deviation, not discovery of 25% of biological causes or 25% heritability.
换成无截距回归、多变量模型或新样本预测时，不能直接照搬这个等式与解释。
This equality and interpretation cannot simply be carried over to regression without an intercept, multiple predictors, or prediction on new data.

title: 03-2｜相关系数与回归辨析详读 / Correlation versus regression
section: 07 · 显著性和 p 值 / Significance and p-values
text:
07 · 显著性和 p 值 / Significance and p-values
样本相关 rr 是当前数据的统计量，总体相关 ρ\rho 是想了解的未知参数。
Sample correlation rr is a statistic of the current data, whereas population correlation ρ\rho is the unknown parameter of interest.
零假设 H0H_0是检验暂时作为基准的命题，这里设为总体线性相关 ρ=0\rho=0。
A null hypothesis H0H_0 is the proposition used as a test benchmark, here population linear correlation ρ=0\rho=0.
p 值是在零假设及检验条件成立时，得到至少与当前一样极端的检验统计量的概率。
A p-value is the probability of a test statistic at least as extreme as observed, assuming the null hypothesis and test conditions hold.
为演示经典双侧检验，额外假设各猪的数据对独立且来自同一二元正态分布。
To illustrate the classical two-sided test, additionally assume independent pig pairs from the same bivariate normal distribution.
二元正态描述两个变量联合的特定正态分布条件，不能只看两列各自像钟形就认定成立。
Bivariate normality is a specific joint normal condition and is not established merely because each column looks bell-shaped.
t=rn−21−r2=0.520.75≈0.816497,df=n−2=2
t=r\sqrt{\frac{n-2}{1-r^2}}
=0.5\sqrt{\frac{2}{0.75}}
\approx0.816497,\qquad df=n-2=2

这里 df 是自由度缩写，使用自由度为 2 的 t 分布得到双侧 p=0.5p=0.5。
Here df abbreviates degrees of freedom, and a t distribution with two degrees of freedom gives two-sided p=0.5p=0.5.
这个特例可用正数 tt 下的尾概率公式 p=1−t/t2+2p=1-t/\sqrt{t^2+2} 直接验证，无需另查统计表。
This special case can be verified directly for positive tt using p=1−t/t2+2p=1-t/\sqrt{t^2+2} without consulting a statistical table.
NIST 原页使用等价的 F=t2F=t^2 检验，分子自由度为 1、分母自由度为 n−2n-2。
The NIST page uses the equivalent F=t2F=t^2 test with numerator degrees of freedom 1 and denominator degrees of freedom n−2n-2.
统计显著通常指 p 值小于事先选定的显著性水平，后者是在零假设成立时控制错误拒绝概率的检验规则。
Statistical significance usually means a p-value below a prespecified significance level, a test rule controlling the chance of falsely rejecting a true null hypothesis.
显著性水平 0.05 不是当前结论有 5% 概率出错，也不保证效应具有生产价值。
A significance level of 0.05 does not mean the current conclusion has a 5% probability of being wrong or guarantee a practically valuable effect.
若事先采用 0.05 的阈值，本例不能拒绝零相关假设，但这不证明总体相关一定为 0。
With a prespecified threshold of 0.05, this example does not reject zero correlation, but that does not prove the population correlation is zero.
p 值不是“零假设为真的概率”，也不是效应大小，更不是育种价值大小。
A p-value is not the probability that the null hypothesis is true, an effect size, or a measure of breeding merit.
四个自拟点只用于演示算法，不构成任何猪群关系的实证证据。
These four invented points only demonstrate the calculation and provide no empirical evidence about a pig population.

title: 03-2｜相关系数与回归辨析详读 / Correlation versus regression
section: 08 · 回到育种：三个常见误读 / Three common breeding misinterpretations
text:
08 · 回到育种：三个常见误读 / Three common breeding misinterpretations

共同环境被当作遗传关系：同一饲料同时改变采食量和日增重，也能产生表型相关。
Shared environment mistaken for genetics: feed affecting both intake and gain can create phenotypic correlation.
动物亲缘被当作性状相关：同胞亲缘讨论动物之间的关系，本篇相关讨论性状之间的变化。
Animal relatedness mistaken for trait correlation: sibling relatedness concerns animals, while this correlation concerns variation between traits.
筛选后的相关被当作全群相关：只保留高增重猪会改变数据范围，计算结果未必代表筛选前总体。
Selected-sample correlation mistaken for whole-population correlation: retaining only high-gain pigs changes the data range and may change what the result represents.

相关也可能受到极端值、测量误差和群体混合影响，所以应先看原始配对与分组再解释单个系数。
Correlation can also be affected by extremes, measurement error, and mixed groups, so inspect original pairs and groups before interpreting one coefficient.

section: 09 · 用单位和样本量读 r、斜率和 p 值 / Reading r, Slope, and p with Units and Sample Size
text:
09 · 用单位和样本量读 r、斜率和 p 值 / Reading r, Slope, and p with Units and Sample Size
把所有采食量乘以 1000 后，相关仍是 0.5，采食量对日增重的回归斜率由 0.005 变为 5，斜率随响应量单位而变。
Multiplying all intake values by 1,000 leaves correlation at 0.5 and changes the intake-on-gain slope from 0.005 to 5 because the slope follows the response unit.
同一小样本可以同时给出 r=0.5r=0.5 和 p=0.5p=0.5，前者描述样本线性关系，后者还取决于样本量和检验假设。
The same small sample can give both r=0.5r=0.5, a description of sample linear association, and p=0.5p=0.5, which also depends on sample size and test assumptions.

看到遗传力是 0.30，我先问分子、分母是什么，比例说的是哪一个群体和哪一种性状。
When I see heritability of 0.30, I start by asking what is in the numerator and denominator and which population and trait the ratio describes.
重复力里多出来的永久环境、遗传相关里换成了加性遗传量，这些区别只看数值和字段名很难发现。
Repeatability adds permanent environment, and genetic correlation is computed on additive genetic effects, differences a field name and value alone can easily hide.

title: 04-0｜遗传参数与相关性 / Genetic parameters and correlations
section: 01 · 遗传力在回答什么 / What heritability describes
text:
01 · 遗传力在回答什么 / What heritability describes
狭义遗传力 h2h^2 是指定群体与环境中，加性遗传方差占表型方差的比例。
Narrow-sense heritability, h2h^2, is the proportion of phenotypic variance attributable to additive genetic variance in a specified population and environment.
h2=σA2σP2
h^2=\frac{\sigma_A^2}{\sigma_P^2}

它不是某头动物“有多少百分比由基因决定”。
It is not the percentage of one animal’s performance determined by genes.
假设校正系统环境后，日增重表型方差为 10,000，加性遗传方差为 3,000。
Suppose adjusted daily-gain phenotypic variance is 10,000 and additive genetic variance is 3,000.
两者单位均为 (g/day)2(g/day)^2，因此 h2=0.30h^2=0.30。
Both use units of (g/day)2(g/day)^2, giving h2=0.30h^2=0.30.
这个结果不表示优秀猪有 30% 概率生出优秀后代。
This result does not mean a good pig has a 30% chance of producing good offspring.
广义遗传力 H2=σG2/σP2H^2=\sigma_G^2/\sigma_P^2 还包括非加性遗传变异，不能与 h2h^2 互换。
Broad-sense heritability, H2=σG2/σP2H^2=\sigma_G^2/\sigma_P^2, includes non-additive genetic variation and is not interchangeable with h2h^2.
育种值主要关注加性部分，因为显性与互作组合可能在后代中重排。
Breeding values focus on additive effects because dominance and interaction combinations may be rearranged in offspring.



狭义遗传力的方差比 / Variance ratio for narrow-sense heritability


图 04-0A　在这个日增重教学例子中，用加性遗传方差 3,0003{,}000 除以校正后的表型方差 10,00010{,}000，得到狭义遗传力 h2=0.30h^2=0.30。
Figure 04-0A　In this daily-gain example, dividing the additive genetic variance of 3,0003{,}000 by the adjusted phenotypic variance of 10,00010{,}000 gives narrow-sense heritability h2=0.30h^2=0.30.
这个比例描述特定群体和环境中的变异，分子和分母的 (g/day)2(\mathrm{g/day})^2 单位在相除时抵消。
This ratio describes variation in a specified population and environment, and the units of (g/day)2(\mathrm{g/day})^2 cancel in the division.

title: 04-0｜遗传参数与相关性 / Genetic parameters and correlations
section: 02 · 高低分别意味着什么 / What high and low values mean
text:
02 · 高低分别意味着什么 / What high and low values mean

其他条件相同时，遗传力越高，自身表现通常提供越多育种值信息。
Other things equal, higher heritability makes own performance more informative about breeding value.
遗传力较低时，通常更需要亲属、重复记录或基因组信息。
Lower heritability generally increases the need for relatives, repeated records, or genomic information.
低遗传力不表示不能改良。
Low heritability does not make improvement impossible.
高遗传力也不表示管理不重要。
High heritability does not make management irrelevant.

猪的繁殖性状常比生长和部分胴体性状遗传力低，但历史教材数值不能直接作为当前猪群参数。
Pig reproductive traits often have lower heritabilities than growth and some carcass traits, but historical values should not automatically become parameters for a current herd.
群体、环境、测量方法和模型都会影响参数估计。
Population, environment, measurement methods, and model specification affect parameter estimates.

title: 04-0｜遗传参数与相关性 / Genetic parameters and correlations
section: 03 · 重复力看同一动物的稳定性 / Repeatability concerns within-animal consistency
text:
03 · 重复力看同一动物的稳定性 / Repeatability concerns within-animal consistency
简单重复力模型把记录拆成加性遗传、永久环境与暂时残差。
A simple repeatability model separates additive genetics, permanent environment, and temporary residual effects.
重复力 tt 描述同一动物不同次记录的相关程度。
Repeatability, tt, describes the correlation between an animal’s repeated records.
t=σA2+σPE2σA2+σPE2+σe2
t=\frac{\sigma_A^2+\sigma_{PE}^2}
{\sigma_A^2+\sigma_{PE}^2+\sigma_e^2}

其中 PEPE 表示永久环境，即持续影响同一动物多次表现的非遗传因素。
Here PEPE means permanent environment, or non-genetic influences persisting across an animal’s records.
假设加性、永久环境和残差方差依次为 1、2、7，则 h2=0.10h^2=0.10、t=0.30t=0.30。
If additive, permanent-environmental, and residual variances are 1, 2, and 7, then h2=0.10h^2=0.10 and t=0.30t=0.30.
在这个简化模型中，t≥h2t\ge h^2。
In this simplified model, t≥h2t\ge h^2.
若不同胎次被定义为不同性状，就需要更一般的模型。
Treating different parities as different traits requires a more general model.
稳定的非遗传影响也会提高重复力，所以一直表现好不等于全是遗传优势。
Persistent non-genetic influences can increase repeatability, so consistently good performance is not entirely genetic.



遗传力和重复力的分子 / Numerators of heritability and repeatability


图 04-0B　在这个简化模型中，三项方差加起来是 10U210\,U^2，其中 UU 表示性状的计量单位。
Figure 04-0B　In this simplified model, the three variances sum to 10U210\,U^2, where UU is the unit of the trait.
狭义遗传力的分子只计入加性遗传方差，而同一个体的重复记录还共享永久环境效应，因此重复力把这项方差也计入分子。
The numerator of narrow-sense heritability includes only additive genetic variance, while repeated records from the same animal also share permanent environmental effects, so repeatability includes that variance in its numerator.

title: 04-0｜遗传参数与相关性 / Genetic parameters and correlations
section: 04 · 三种相关别混用 / Distinguish three correlations
text:
04 · 三种相关别混用 / Distinguish three correlations

表型相关看两项实际表现是否一起变化。
Phenotypic correlation concerns co-variation in observed performances.
遗传相关看两个性状的加性遗传作用是否一起变化。
Genetic correlation concerns co-variation in the additive genetic effects of two traits.
残差相关看模型扣除已解释部分后，剩余部分是否一起变化。
Residual correlation concerns co-variation in components remaining after modeled effects.

表型上相关，不保证遗传上同方向相关。
A phenotypic association does not establish a genetic association in the same direction.
rA=Cov⁡(A1,A2)σA1σA2
r_A=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(A_1,A_2)}{\sigma_{A_1}\sigma_{A_2}}

假设两个性状的加性遗传标准差为 10 和 2，遗传协方差为 −10，则 rA=−0.5r_A=-0.5。
If additive genetic standard deviations are 10 and 2 with genetic covariance −10, then rA=−0.5r_A=-0.5.
选择使性状 1 增大时，可能连带使性状 2 减小。
Selection increasing trait 1 may also decrease trait 2.
这种变化是否有利，取决于两个性状各自的目标方向。
Whether that change is favorable depends on the desired direction for each trait.
正相关不天然有利，负相关也不天然不利。
Positive correlation is not inherently favorable, nor negative correlation inherently unfavorable.

title: 04-0｜遗传参数与相关性 / Genetic parameters and correlations
section: 05 · 换环境，排名可能改变 / Rankings may change with the environment
text:
05 · 换环境，排名可能改变 / Rankings may change with the environment
基因型与环境互作指遗传类型在不同环境中表现出不同的优势，甚至发生排名改变。
Genotype-by-environment interaction means genetic types have different advantages across environments, potentially changing rankings.
计算机类比是分布变化：测定站中的排序未必能原样迁移到另一生产环境。
A computing analogy is distribution shift, since test-station rankings may not transfer unchanged to another production environment.
本章所有数值参数均为教学假设。
All numerical parameters in this chapter are hypothetical teaching values.

section: 我的核对笔记 / My Verification Notes
text:
我的核对笔记 / My Verification Notes
在加性遗传、永久环境和暂时残差方差为 1、2、7 的例子中，总方差为 10，遗传力和重复力分别是 1/10=0.101/10=0.10 与 3/10=0.303/10=0.30。
With additive genetic, permanent-environmental, and temporary-residual variances of 1, 2, and 7, the total is 10, giving heritability 1/10=0.101/10=0.10 and repeatability 3/10=0.303/10=0.30.
我把这两个比例记在模型和群体说明旁边，因为它们描述群体中的变异和同一个体记录间的联系，不能拆解单头猪的表现。
I record both ratios alongside the model and population because they describe population variation and links between repeated records, and do not partition one pig’s performance.
假设日增重与背膘的遗传相关是 +0.4+0.4，单选高增重可能使背膘随之增加，而希望降背膘时就需要把两个目标一起纳入决策。
If daily gain and backfat have a genetic correlation of +0.4+0.4, selecting on gain alone may also increase backfat, so a goal of reducing backfat needs both traits in the decision.

我先把表型、加性遗传和环境分量各自放在一栏，再用一个小例子检查为什么相关的方向可能不同。
I give observed phenotypes, additive genetic effects, and environmental components their own columns, then use a small example to see why their correlations can point in different directions.
原阅读是 UNE 相关与互作课程提纲，直接读取未成功，检索缓存只提供部分课程主题。

本篇实际用已读的 Purdue 遗传相关说明和 MU 互作术语支持解释，不声称复述未读 UNE 全文。
This explanation is supported by the readable Purdue genetic-correlation discussion and MU interaction definition, without claiming a full UNE summary.

Sources were checked on 2026-10-18, source points are summarized, and teaching data and calculations are original.

section: 01 · 来源要点 / Source points
text:
01 · 来源要点 / Source points
Purdue 将遗传相关与共同环境造成的相关区分，MU 用环境间优势变化解释基因型与环境互作。
Purdue distinguishes genetic correlation from shared environmental association, while MU describes genotype-by-environment interaction through changing advantages across environments.
下面的协方差拆分与环境对比是原创教学例子，不是来源中的猪群估计。
The covariance decomposition and environmental comparisons below are original teaching examples rather than herd estimates from the sources.

title: 04-2｜遗传相关与环境互作 / Genetic correlation and environmental interaction
section: 02 · 三种相关到底相关谁 / What is correlated in each case?
text:
02 · 三种相关到底相关谁 / What is correlated in each case?
对两个性状，先假设校正后的表型为 P1=A1+E1P_1=A_1+E_1、P2=A2+E2P_2=A_2+E_2，且遗传与环境分量之间互不相关。
For two traits, assume adjusted phenotypes P1=A1+E1P_1=A_1+E_1 and P2=A2+E2P_2=A_2+E_2, with genetic and environmental components uncorrelated.

表型相关 rPr_P计算两项记录共同变化的程度。
Phenotypic correlation rPr_P measures joint variation in the observed traits.
加性遗传相关 rAr_A计算两个真实加性遗传作用的共同变化。
Additive genetic correlation rAr_A measures joint variation in the two true additive effects.
环境相关 rEr_E计算这里两个环境分量的共同变化，在此简化模型中由残差代表。
Environmental correlation rEr_E measures joint variation in the two environmental components, represented here by residuals.

真实模型若还有永久环境或母体等分量，环境相关与某个特定残差相关不能默认等同。
With additional permanent-environmental or maternal components, environmental correlation cannot automatically be equated with one residual correlation.

title: 04-2｜遗传相关与环境互作 / Genetic correlation and environmental interaction
section: 03 · 同一组方差推导三种相关 / Derive three correlations
text:
03 · 同一组方差推导三种相关 / Derive three correlations
设两个性状加性遗传方差为 100、4，遗传协方差为 −10。
Let the additive genetic variances be 100 and 4 and genetic covariance be −10.
rA=−101004=−0.5
r_A=\frac{-10}{\sqrt{100}\sqrt{4}}=-0.5

再设环境方差为 100、4，环境协方差为 +15。
Let environmental variances be 100 and 4 and environmental covariance be +15.
rE=151004=0.75
r_E=\frac{15}{\sqrt{100}\sqrt{4}}=0.75

两个表型方差分别为 200、8，表型协方差为 −10+15=5-10+15=5。
The phenotype variances become 200 and 8, with covariance −10+15=5-10+15=5.
rP=52008=0.125
r_P=\frac{5}{\sqrt{200}\sqrt{8}}=0.125

因此表型正相关 0.125 与遗传负相关 −0.5 可以同时成立，不能从前者直接读出后者。
Thus positive phenotypic correlation 0.125 and negative genetic correlation −0.5 can coexist, and one cannot directly reveal the other.
这三个系数没有单位，但其协方差与方差的单位必须匹配，不能先把不同量随意标准化再相加。
The correlations are unitless, but their covariances and variances require compatible units and cannot be arbitrarily standardized before addition.



加性遗传、环境与表型相关 / Additive genetic, environmental, and phenotypic correlations


图 04-2A　在遗传与环境分量互不相关的教学模型中，表型协方差等于遗传协方差与环境协方差之和，即 −10+15=5-10+15=5。
Figure 04-2A　In this teaching model with uncorrelated genetic and environmental components, the phenotypic covariance is the sum of the genetic and environmental covariances, −10+15=5-10+15=5.
分别用对应的两个标准差归一化后，得到遗传相关 −0.5-0.5、环境相关 0.750.75 和表型相关 0.1250.125，三个系数均无单位。
Dividing each covariance by the product of its corresponding standard deviations gives the genetic correlation −0.5-0.5, environmental correlation 0.750.75, and phenotypic correlation 0.1250.125, all unitless.
若两个性状的计量单位为 U1U_1 和 U2U_2，协方差单位为 U1U2U_1U_2，各性状方差的单位分别为 U12U_1^2 和 U22U_2^2。
If the two traits are measured in U1U_1 and U2U_2, their covariance is in U1U2U_1U_2 and their variances are in U12U_1^2 and U22U_2^2, respectively.

section: 04 · 正负不是好坏标签 / Sign is not desirability
text:
04 · 正负不是好坏标签 / Sign is not desirability
如果一个目标是增加日增重、另一个目标是降低 FCR，那么负遗传相关可能有利于同时改良。
If the goals are higher daily gain and lower FCR, a negative genetic correlation can favor joint improvement.
若两个性状都希望增加，负遗传相关则可能造成取舍，仍需考虑经济权重和可利用变异。
If both traits should increase, a negative genetic correlation can create a trade-off, subject to economic weights and available variation.
相关不是每头动物必须遵守的精确等式，所以可能找到两项都优于平均水平的个体。
Correlation is not an exact equation obeyed by every animal, so individuals can be above average for both traits.

section: 05 · 环境互作何时改变排名 / When environmental interaction changes rankings
text:
05 · 环境互作何时改变排名 / When environmental interaction changes rankings
假设遗传类型 A、B 在环境 1 的期望增重为 900、850，在环境 2 为 700、800 g/day。
Suppose genetic types A and B have expected gains of 900 and 850 in Environment 1 and 700 and 800 g/day in Environment 2.
环境 1 中 A 优于 B 50，环境 2 中 A 低于 B 100，构成期望排名交叉的教学例子。
A exceeds B by 50 in Environment 1 but trails by 100 in Environment 2, illustrating crossover in expected rankings.
基因型与环境互作 G×E还包括优势幅度变化，即使没有排名交叉也可能存在。
Genotype-by-environment interaction (G×E) also includes changes in advantage magnitude and can exist without rank reversal.
观察到两批猪排名不同还可能来自抽样误差或管理混杂，需要足够重复和模型才能判断真实互作。
Different observed batch rankings may instead reflect sampling error or management confounding, so replication and modeling are needed to establish interaction.
把同一性状在两个环境中的表现视为两个性状，可以估计跨环境遗传相关，但不能用两个批次的均值代替。
Modeling the same trait in two environments as two traits allows cross-environment genetic correlation estimation, but two batch means cannot replace that analysis.



两种环境中的日增重排名交叉 / Daily-gain rank crossover between environments


图 04-2B　环境 1 中，遗传类型 A 的期望日增重比 B 高 50 g/day，到了环境 2，A 比 B 低 100 g/day。
Figure 04-2B　In Environment 1, expected daily gain is 50 g/day higher for genetic type A than for B, and in Environment 2 it is 100 g/day lower for A than for B.
横轴表示两个离散环境，读图时直接比较各环境刻度上的两种类型。
The horizontal axis shows two discrete environments, so compare the two genetic types directly at each environment tick.

section: 06 · 两列 EBV 的相关该怎么解释 / Interpreting Correlation Between Two EBV Columns
text:
06 · 两列 EBV 的相关该怎么解释 / Interpreting Correlation Between Two EBV Columns
直接算两列 EBV 的相关时，我会把它记为这批预测值之间的相关，它会受准确度、共同信息、筛选和预测误差影响。
When I correlate two EBV columns directly, I label the result as a correlation of these predictions, which can be influenced by accuracy, shared information, selection, and prediction errors.
要估计总体遗传相关，则需要用合适的模型估计两个性状的加性遗传协方差及相应方差。
Estimating population genetic correlation requires a suitable model for the additive genetic covariance and corresponding variances of the two traits.

title: 05-1｜家系、同胞与系谱术语 / Families, siblings, and pedigree terms
section: 02 · 先看最小系谱 / Read a minimal pedigree
text:
02 · 先看最小系谱 / Read a minimal pedigree
下表记录动物、父亲、母亲，0 仅表示父母未知，不是一头真实的公共祖先。
The table records animal, sire, and dam, with zero indicating unknown parentage rather than one real shared ancestor.
animal,sire,dam
S1,0,0
S2,0,0
D1,0,0
D2,0,0
A,S1,D1
B,S1,D1
C,S1,D2
D,S2,D1

A 与 B 同父同母，所以是全同胞。
A and B share both parents and are full siblings.
A 与 C 同父异母，所以是父系半同胞。
A and C share a sire but have different dams and are paternal half siblings.
A 与 D 同母异父，所以是母系半同胞。
A and D share a dam but have different sires and are maternal half siblings.

在常染色体加性模型中，两种半同胞关系在相同基础假设下具有相同的期望加性亲缘，但母体环境来源可能不同。
In an autosomal additive model, both half-sibling types have the same expected additive relationship under matching base assumptions, while maternal environmental sources can differ.

title: 05-1｜家系、同胞与系谱术语 / Families, siblings, and pedigree terms
section: 03 · 同胞与同窝为什么不同 / Why siblings and littermates differ
text:
03 · 同胞与同窝为什么不同 / Why siblings and littermates differ
同窝要求同一次分娩，因此还需要 litter_id 或母猪加分娩日期等事件信息。
Littermates require one farrowing event, needing a litter_id or information such as sow and farrowing date.
同一对父母在不同胎次产生的后代可以是全同胞，但不是同窝。
Offspring of the same two parents from different farrowings can be full siblings without being littermates.
同栏是共同饲养环境的标签，既可能包含亲属，也可能包含无近亲关系的猪。
Penmates share a management environment and may be related or lack close relationships.
寄养还会使出生母猪与哺乳母猪不同，因此生物学母亲与养育母亲最好分别记录。
Fostering can separate birth and nursing dams, so biological and rearing mothers should ideally be recorded separately.

section: 04 · 四种字段回答四种问题 / Four fields answer four questions
text:
04 · 四种字段回答四种问题 / Four fields answer four questions

sire_id, genetic_dam_id 回答遗传父母是谁。
sire_id, genetic_dam_id identify genetic parents.
birth_litter_id 回答出生属于哪个分娩事件。
birth_litter_id identifies the birth farrowing event.
foster_dam_id 回答由哪头母猪哺育。
foster_dam_id identifies the nursing dam.
pen_id 加日期区间回答何时在哪一栏饲养。
pen_id plus dates identifies when and where an animal was housed.

这些字段不能互相替代，否则模型可能把共同环境误归入遗传。
These fields are not interchangeable, or the model may attribute shared environment to genetics.

section: 05 · 家系平均为何不足 / Why a family average is insufficient
text:
05 · 家系平均为何不足 / Why a family average is insufficient
假设 A 家系平均 900、B 家系平均 850 g/day，但 A 家系全部在更好的测定环境。
Suppose Family A averages 900 and Family B 850 g/day, but every A animal has a better testing environment.
若环境优势估计为 80，则按这个教学校正，A 的比较值为 900−80=820900-80=820，原始家系排名可能反转。
If the environmental advantage is estimated as 80, this teaching adjustment gives A 900−80=820900-80=820, potentially reversing the raw family ranking.
80 必须来自有依据的估计，不能因为想改变结果而临时指定。
The 80 must come from justified estimation and must not be assigned merely to change the result.
动物模型还会利用不同动物间的亲缘和信息量，而不只对家系均值做简单扣减。
An animal model also uses animal relationships and information amounts rather than merely subtracting an adjustment from family means.

text:
06 · 系谱作为数据库如何检查 / Validate pedigree as a database
动物编号应唯一，父母必须能在系谱或明确的未知规则中解析，且不允许自身成为祖先。
Animal IDs must be unique, parents must resolve within the pedigree or an explicit unknown-parent rule, and an animal cannot be its own ancestor.
父母与后代日期矛盾、循环关系和导入重复必须先核对，不能依赖评估软件替你解释真实身份。
Conflicting parent–offspring dates, cycles, and duplicate imports require checking before expecting evaluation software to determine real identities.

The source term “animal model” refers to a mixed model with individual additive genetic effects linked by a relationship matrix.

The author distinguishes observation, parameter, and pedigree files and notes that solutions contain both fixed and random effects.

title: 05-3｜动物模型与系谱信息 / Animal models and pedigree information
section: 02 · 一条记录与三头动物 / One record and three animals
text:
02 · 一条记录与三头动物 / One record and three animals
设父母 S、D 无关且不近交，C 为子代，只有 C 测得日增重 850 g/day。
Let unrelated, non-inbred parents S and D have offspring C, with only C measured at 850 g/day.
额外假设总体均值已知为 800，遗传与残差方差分别为 300、700 (g/day)2(g/day)^2，并无其他待估效应。
Additionally assume a known population mean of 800, genetic and residual variances 300 and 700 (g/day)2(g/day)^2, and no other effects to estimate.
A=[100.5010.50.50.51],Z=[001]
A=\begin{bmatrix}1&0&0.5\\0&1&0.5\\0.5&0.5&1\end{bmatrix},
\qquad Z=\begin{bmatrix}0&0&1\end{bmatrix}

Z 是记录到动物的映射，唯一一行只指向 C，但 A 包含三个动物的关系。
Z maps records to animals, with its single row pointing only to C, while A contains relationships among all three animals.

text:
03 · 用协方差传递信息 / Information travels through covariance
动物加性遗传协方差为 300A300A，所以 S 与 C、D 与 C 的遗传协方差各为 150。
Additive genetic covariance is 300A300A, giving genetic covariance 150 between S and C and between D and C.
C 的观测偏差为 850−800=50850-800=50，观测方差为 300+700=1000300+700=1000。
C’s observed deviation is 850−800=50850-800=50, and observation variance is 300+700=1000300+700=1000.
âS=1501000×50=7.5,âD=7.5,âC=3001000×50=15
\widehat a_S=\frac{150}{1000}\times50=7.5,
\quad\widehat a_D=7.5,
\quad\widehat a_C=\frac{300}{1000}\times50=15

S、D 的预测来自子代信息与亲缘结构，不需要凭空生成它们的自身日增重。
S and D are predicted through offspring information and relationships without inventing their own gain measurements.
这三项预测来自同一条观测，不能再当成三条独立证据相加。
The three predictions derive from one observation and must not be added as three independent pieces of evidence.

text:
04 · 误差方差也随关系变化 / Error variances also depend on relationships
在这个已知均值的特例中，预测误差方差等于原遗传方差减去观测减少的不确定性。
In this known-mean case, prediction error variance is the original genetic variance minus uncertainty removed by the observation.
PEVC=300−3002/1000=210
PEV_C=300-300^2/1000=210

PEVS=PEVD=300−1502/1000=277.5
PEV_S=PEV_D=300-150^2/1000=277.5

因此 C 的可靠性为 1−210/300=0.301-210/300=0.30，而父母各为 1−277.5/300=0.0751-277.5/300=0.075。
Thus C has reliability 1−210/300=0.301-210/300=0.30, while each parent has 1−277.5/300=0.0751-277.5/300=0.075.
没有自身记录不等于没有信息，但通过较远关系获得的证据通常弱于直接观测。
No own record does not mean no information, but information through relationships is usually weaker than direct observation.

05 · 加入未知固定效应后 / When fixed effects must be estimated
现实中常写为 y=Xb+Za+ey=Xb+Za+e，其中 bb 可能包含批次、性别、胎次和日龄等项。
Real models often use y=Xb+Za+ey=Xb+Za+e, with bb including batch, sex, parity, or age terms.

An unknown mean must be handled together with genetic effects, so the fractions above are not a complete production pipeline.
具体方程演算见 混合模型方程逐步推导。
See mixed model equations step by step for the full calculation.

trait 指性状，effect 指效应项，level 指该效应的水平或动物编号，solution 是对应解。
trait identifies a trait, effect a model term, level its category or animal ID, and solution its estimate or prediction.

Preserve original-to-renumbered ID mappings rather than treating level 10 of any effect as the tenth pig in an arbitrary table.

title: 06-2｜准确度与估计风险 / Accuracy and estimation risk
section: 02 · ACC 与 REL 不是同一个数字 / ACC and REL are different quantities
text:
02 · ACC 与 REL 不是同一个数字 / ACC and REL are different quantities
理论准确度 ACC是预测值与真实育种值的相关，可靠性 REL通常定义为准确度平方。
Theoretical accuracy ACC is the correlation between prediction and true breeding value, while reliability REL is usually its square.
REL=ACC2,ACC=REL
REL=ACC^2,\qquad ACC=\sqrt{REL}

ACC 为 0.8 时 REL 为 0.64，若改用百分数显示就是 80% 与 64%。
ACC 0.8 gives REL 0.64, displayed as 80% and 64% on percentage scales.
80% 不是“有 80% 概率这个 EBV 完全正确”，也不是每个后代都能兑现 80% 优势。
The 80% is not an 80% probability of an exactly correct EBV or a guarantee that every offspring realizes 80% of the advantage.

title: 06-2｜准确度与估计风险 / Accuracy and estimation risk
section: 03 · 用 PEV 看单位上的不确定性 / Express uncertainty in trait units
text:
03 · 用 PEV 看单位上的不确定性 / Express uncertainty in trait units
PEV是模型下预测误差的方差，开平方得到相应的预测误差标准差。
PEV is model-based prediction error variance, whose square root gives prediction error standard deviation.
假设某不近交动物的遗传方差为 400 (g/day)2(g/day)^2、PEV 为 144 (g/day)2(g/day)^2。
Suppose a non-inbred animal has genetic variance 400 (g/day)2(g/day)^2 and PEV 144 (g/day)2(g/day)^2.
REL=1−144/400=0.64,ACC=0.8,SEP=144=12g/day
REL=1-144/400=0.64,\qquad ACC=0.8,\qquad SEP=\sqrt{144}=12\ \mathrm{g/day}

这里 SEP 表示预测误差标准差，不是第 03 章用 s/ns/\sqrt n 估计的独立样本均值标准误。
Here SEP denotes prediction error standard deviation, not the independent-sample mean standard error estimated by s/ns/\sqrt n in Chapter 03.
在固定条件和方差已知的正态条件预测示例中，若 EBV 为 +30，可用 30±1.96×1230\pm1.96\times12 表示约 95% 的条件预测区间。
In a normal conditional-prediction example with known fixed conditions and variances, an EBV of +30 has an approximate 95% conditional prediction interval 30±1.96×1230\pm1.96\times12.
[30−23.52,30+23.52]=[6.48,53.52]g/day
[30-23.52,30+23.52]=[6.48,53.52]\ \mathrm{g/day}

这是指定概率模型下对潜在 BV 的预测区间，不能与所有频率学派参数置信区间混用，也不能忽略方差估计和模型错误。
This is a prediction interval for latent BV under a specified probability model, not interchangeable with every frequentist parameter interval or immune to variance-estimation and model error.

section: 04 · 为什么不能把 ACC 再乘到 EBV 上 / Why not multiply EBV by ACC again?
text:
04 · 为什么不能把 ACC 再乘到 EBV 上 / Why not multiply EBV by ACC again?
假设公猪 A 的 EBV 为 +40、ACC 为 0.6，B 的 EBV 为 +30、ACC 为 0.9。
Suppose Boar A has EBV +40 and ACC 0.6, while B has EBV +30 and ACC 0.9.
EBV 是模型当前对遗传水平的预测，A 的预测更高，而 B 的估计更有把握。
EBV is the current prediction of genetic merit, so A has the higher predicted level while B is more certain.
若再相乘，会算出 A 为 24、B 为 27，但这个新排序不是原评估的最佳线性预测。
Multiplying again gives A 24 and B 27, but this new ranking is not the original evaluation’s best linear prediction.
信息量不足带来的收缩通常已经进入 EBV，风险偏好应作为决策问题另外表达。
Shrinkage from limited information is usually already incorporated in EBV, while risk preference should be expressed separately as a decision issue.

section: 05 · 信息多不等于全都独立有效 / More records are not always independent information
text:
05 · 信息多不等于全都独立有效 / More records are not always independent information
自身记录、父母信息、后代记录和相关性状可以提高信息量，但效果依赖遗传力、同期群与模型结构。
Own, parental, progeny, and correlated-trait records can add information, with their value depending on heritability, contemporary groups, and model structure.
把同一测量复制十次不会产生十次独立证据，同一家系的大量记录也可能高度共享信息。
Copying one measurement ten times adds no tenfold independent evidence, and many records in one family can share substantial information.
对多头公猪的平均预测误差，方差不仅含各自的 PEV，还含公猪之间的预测误差协方差。
Prediction error variance of a boar-team mean includes both individual PEVs and between-boar prediction error covariances.
Var⁡(ε‾)=1k2[∑iPEVi+2∑i<jCov(εi,εj)]
\operatorname{Var}(\bar\varepsilon)=\frac{1}{k^2}
\left[\sum_i PEV_i+2\sum_{i<j}\operatorname{Cov}(\varepsilon_i,\varepsilon_j)\right]

因此“用多头公猪”可以分散部分风险，但不能把近亲公猪简单当作完全独立的投资组合。
Using multiple boars can spread some risk but does not make closely related boars a fully independent portfolio.

06 · 把遗传价值与估计把握度分两列看 / Read Merit and Certainty in Separate Columns
我用可比基准下的 EBV 和育种目标判断遗传价值，再用 ACC 看这个估计有多少信息支持。
I judge genetic merit using comparable EBVs and the breeding objective, then use ACC to see how well the estimate is supported.
两头动物可以是一头 EBV 更高、另一头 ACC 更高，选谁要结合目标和愿意承担的不确定性。
One animal can have the higher EBV and the other the higher ACC, so the choice depends on the objective and the uncertainty one is willing to accept.

先算一次，再只换子代记录重算，能看出结果从哪一步改变，也能看出亲缘信息是怎么进来的。

title: 07-0｜从手算到 BLUP / From hand calculations to BLUP
section: 01 · 先算一个最简单的预测 / Start with a simple predictor
text:
01 · 先算一个最简单的预测 / Start with a simple predictor
下面的简化模型只用一条自身记录，并假设均值与方差参数已知。
The simplified model below uses one own record and assumes known mean and variance parameters.
动物需来自适用群体，性状还需校正系统环境影响。
The animal must belong to the relevant population, with systematic environmental effects accounted for.
在这些条件下，可用“遗传力 × 表型偏差”预测育种值。
Under these conditions, predict breeding value as “heritability × phenotypic deviation.”
BV̂i=h2(Pi−μ)
\widehat{BV}_i=h^2(P_i-\mu)

假设均值为 800、个体为 850 g/day、h2=0.30h^2=0.30，则预测为 +15 g/day。
With mean 800, own record 850 g/day, and h2=0.30h^2=0.30, the prediction is +15 g/day.
沿用单记录模型，若个体记录换成 860 g/day、均值仍为 800 g/day、遗传力仍为 0.30，表型偏差就是 +60 g/day。
In the same single-record model, changing the record to 860 g/day with a mean of 800 g/day and heritability of 0.30 gives a phenotypic deviation of +60 g/day.
这里估计育种值为 0.30(860−800)=+180.30(860-800)=+18 g/day，这个代入只用来核对公式如何随输入变化。
This gives an estimated breeding value of 0.30(860−800)=+180.30(860-800)=+18 g/day and shows how that equation responds to an input change.
观察优势是 +50，但模型只将其中一部分预测为遗传优势。
The observed advantage is +50, but only part is predicted to be genetic.
把偏差向基准拉回叫收缩。
This movement of a deviation toward the base is called shrinkage.
一般情况下，h2h^2 不能作为通用系数乘到所有原始记录上。
In general, h2h^2 is not a universal multiplier for raw records.

title: 07-0｜从手算到 BLUP / From hand calculations to BLUP
section: 02 · 为什么要用 BLUP / Why use BLUP?
text:
02 · 为什么要用 BLUP / Why use BLUP?
实际数据包含不同场区、批次、性别、日龄、亲属与重复测量。
Real data include different farms, batches, sexes, ages, relatives, and repeated measurements.
BLUP是最佳线性无偏预测。
BLUP means best linear unbiased prediction.
它在指定模型与协方差假设下，联合估计固定效应并预测随机效应。
Under specified model and covariance assumptions, it jointly estimates fixed effects and predicts random effects.
“最佳”限于其理论条件，不能保证错误数据或模型仍给出正确结果。
“Best” applies within its theoretical conditions and does not protect against incorrect data or models.

title: 07-0｜从手算到 BLUP / From hand calculations to BLUP
section: 03 · 把动物模型读成数据流 / Read the animal model as a data flow
text:
03 · 把动物模型读成数据流 / Read the animal model as a data flow
𝒚=𝑿𝒃+𝒁𝒂+𝒆,Var⁡(𝒂)=𝑲σA2,Var⁡(𝒆)=𝑰σe2
\mathbf y=\mathbf X\mathbf b+\mathbf Z\mathbf a+\mathbf e,\qquad
\operatorname{Var}(\mathbf a)=\mathbf K\sigma_A^2,\quad
\operatorname{Var}(\mathbf e)=\mathbf I\sigma_e^2


yy 是表型向量，即所有观测记录。
yy is the phenotype vector containing the observed records.
bb 是固定效应，例如批次、性别分类效应及日龄回归系数。
bb holds fixed effects, such as batch and sex classifications or an age-regression coefficient.
aa 是动物的加性遗传随机效应，其预测值就是 EBV。
aa holds additive genetic random effects, whose predictions are EBVs.
ee 是残差。
ee holds residuals.
KK 是动物关系矩阵，系谱模型中 K=AK=A。
KK is the animal relationship matrix, with K=AK=A in a pedigree model.
粗体 II 是单位矩阵，不是第 01 章的上位互作。
Bold II is the identity matrix, not the epistasis term in Chapter 01.


X、Z 像映射表 / X and Z resemble mapping tables
X把每条记录映射到对应的固定效应。
X maps each record to its fixed effects.
Z把每条记录映射到被测动物。
Z maps each record to the measured animal.
可以把它们类比为数据库关联后的指示列。
Think of them as indicator columns after database joins.
一头动物有多条记录时，Z 的多行可以指向同一个动物。
Several rows of Z can refer to one animal when it has repeated records.
没有自身记录的祖先仍可通过亲缘关系获得预测。
Ancestors without own records can still receive predictions through relationships.


固定与随机 / Fixed and random effects
“固定”不表示数值永远不变，“随机”也不表示随意填数。
“Fixed” does not mean permanently constant, and “random” does not mean arbitrary.
固定效应估计指定水平的差异。
Fixed effects estimate differences among specified levels.
随机效应按群体分布和协方差结构建模，信息不足时发生收缩。
Random effects use population distributions and covariance structures, producing shrinkage when information is limited.
同窝、永久环境或母体作用可能需要扩展模型，不能都塞进遗传效应。
Litter, permanent-environmental, and maternal effects may require model extensions rather than being absorbed into genetics.

section: 04 · 方差参数控制信息权重 / Variance parameters control weighting
text:
04 · 方差参数控制信息权重 / Variance parameters control weighting
只有加性与独立残差时，h2=σA2/(σA2+σe2)h^2=\sigma_A^2/(\sigma_A^2+\sigma_e^2)。
With only additive genetics and independent residuals, h2=σA2/(σA2+σe2)h^2=\sigma_A^2/(\sigma_A^2+\sigma_e^2).
残差相对越大，单条记录提供的遗传证据越弱。
Relatively larger residual variance weakens the genetic evidence in one record.

REML是限制最大似然，可用于估计方差组分。
REML is restricted maximum likelihood and can estimate variance components.
BLUP利用这些组分预测育种值。
BLUP uses those components to predict breeding values.

一个软件流程可以执行两项任务，但它们不是同一个统计问题。
One software pipeline may perform both tasks, but they are different statistical problems.

section: 05 · 跟着算一次微型 BLUP / Work through a tiny BLUP
text:
05 · 跟着算一次微型 BLUP / Work through a tiny BLUP

第一步：列清假设 / Step 1: State the assumptions
以下完全是假设教学模型。
The following is a wholly hypothetical teaching model.

S、D 是彼此无关且不近交的父母，C 是它们的子代。
S and D are unrelated, non-inbred parents of C.
只有 C 有一条日增重记录，为 850 g/day。
Only C has a daily-gain record, which is 850 g/day.
总体均值已知为 800 g/day。
The population mean is known to be 800 g/day.
加性遗传方差为 σA2=300\sigma_A^2=300，残差方差为 σe2=700\sigma_e^2=700。
Additive genetic variance is σA2=300\sigma_A^2=300, and residual variance is σe2=700\sigma_e^2=700.
两项方差单位均为 (g/day)2(g/day)^2。
Both variances have units of (g/day)2(g/day)^2.
模型没有额外环境效应，也不需要估计未知均值。
The model has no additional environmental effects and does not estimate an unknown mean.



第二步：建立关系和映射 / Step 2: Define relationships and mapping
动物顺序为 S、D、C，Z 仅指向有记录的 C。
The animal order is S, D, C, and Z refers only to the recorded animal C.
𝑨=[100.5010.50.50.51],𝒁=[001]
\mathbf A=\begin{bmatrix}1&0&0.5\\0&1&0.5\\0.5&0.5&1\end{bmatrix},
\qquad \mathbf Z=\begin{bmatrix}0&0&1\end{bmatrix}



第三步：代入计算 / Step 3: Calculate the predictions
均值已知时，BLUP 可写成“遗传与观测的协方差 × 观测方差的逆 × 观测偏差”。
With a known mean, BLUP is “genetic–observation covariance × inverse observation variance × observed deviation.”
这里只有一条观测，不需要复杂矩阵求逆。
There is only one observation, so no complicated matrix inversion is needed.
𝒂̂=𝑨𝒁′σA2(𝒁𝑨𝒁′σA2+σe2)−1(850−800)=[0.50.51]300100050=[7.57.515]g/day
\widehat{\mathbf a}
=\mathbf A\mathbf Z'\sigma_A^2
\left(\mathbf Z\mathbf A\mathbf Z'\sigma_A^2+\sigma_e^2\right)^{-1}(850-800)
=\begin{bmatrix}0.5\\0.5\\1\end{bmatrix}\frac{300}{1000}\,50
=\begin{bmatrix}7.5\\7.5\\15\end{bmatrix}\;g/day


C 的 EBV 是 +15 g/day。
C’s EBV is +15 g/day.
S、D 虽没有自身记录，也各获得 +7.5 g/day 的预测。
S and D each receive +7.5 g/day despite having no own records.

三个预测使用同一条记录，不能再当作三条独立证据重复相加。
All three predictions use the same record and must not be added again as independent evidence.



一条日增重记录得到三个育种值预测 / Three breeding-value predictions from one daily gain record


图 07-0A　在已知总体均值和方差的教学模型中，子代 C 的一条日增重记录给出 C 的估计育种值 +15 g/day，父母 S 和 D 各为 +7.5 g/day。
Figure 07-0A　Under the teaching model with known mean and variances, C’s one daily gain record gives an EBV of +15 g/day for C and +7.5 g/day each for its parents S and D.
三个预测共享这一条记录，图中的亲缘系数具体指 A 矩阵中对应动物与 C 的元素。
All three predictions share this one record, and the relationship coefficients shown are the A-matrix entries for each animal paired with C.


第四步：计算本例的不确定性 / Step 4: Calculate uncertainty in this example
C 的预测误差方差为 PEV=300−3002/1000=210PEV=300-300^2/1000=210。
C’s prediction error variance is PEV=300−3002/1000=210PEV=300-300^2/1000=210.
其可靠性为 REL=1−210/300=0.30REL=1-210/300=0.30。
Its reliability is REL=1−210/300=0.30REL=1-210/300=0.30.
其准确度为 ACC=0.30≈0.548ACC=\sqrt{0.30}\approx0.548。
Its accuracy is ACC=0.30≈0.548ACC=\sqrt{0.30}\approx0.548.
这是均值与方差已知的特例，不能作为生产准确度的通用捷径。
This known-mean, known-variance case is not a general shortcut for production accuracy.


第五步：只改一条输入再复算 / Step 5: Change One Input and Recalculate
我保留同一系谱、均值和方差，只把 C 的一条记录从 850 改成 900 g/day，这样就能检查预测是怎样随观测偏差改变的。
I keep the pedigree, mean, and variances fixed and change C’s one record from 850 to 900 g/day, so I can check how the predictions follow the observed deviation.
总体均值仍是 800 g/day，遗传方差和残差方差仍为 300 和 700 (g/day)2(\mathrm{g/day})^2，S、D 互不相关且不近交。
The population mean is still 800 g/day, genetic and residual variances are still 300 and 700 (g/day)2(\mathrm{g/day})^2, and S and D are unrelated and non-inbred.
偏差变为 +100 g/day 后，S、D、C 的预测依次是 +15、+15、+30 g/day。
With the deviation now +100 g/day, the predictions for S, D, and C are +15, +15, and +30 g/day.
模型与信息结构保持相同，所以本例中 C 的预测误差方差、可靠性和准确度仍是原来的值。
The model and information structure are unchanged, so C’s prediction error variance, reliability, and accuracy keep their original values in this example.
这段标准库代码在内存中复算两次条件已知的教学模型。
This standard-library code reproduces both runs of the known-parameter teaching model in memory.
from math import sqrt

def tiny_blup(child_record):
    # Known mean 800; additive variance 300; residual variance 700.
    # S and D are unrelated, non-inbred parents of C; only C is recorded.
    deviation = child_record - 800
    shrinkage = 300 / (300 + 700)
    return tuple(k * shrinkage * deviation for k in (0.5, 0.5, 1.0))

print('EBV(S,D,C) at 850:', tiny_blup(850))
print('EBV(S,D,C) at 900:', tiny_blup(900))
pev = 300 - 300**2 / (300 + 700)
rel = 1 - pev / 300
print(f'PEV(C)={pev:.2f}, REL(C)={rel:.2f}, ACC(C)={sqrt(rel):.3f}')
基础 R 版沿用一条子代记录和同一组已知参数，输出顺序仍为父亲 S、母亲 D 和子代 C。
The base R version uses the same offspring observation and known parameters, with outputs ordered as sire S, dam D, and offspring C.
population_mean <- 800
additive_var <- 300
residual_var <- 700
observation_var <- additive_var + residual_var

tiny_blup <- function(child_record) {
  # Only C is recorded; S and D are unrelated and non-inbred.
  deviation <- child_record - population_mean
  shrinkage <- additive_var / observation_var
  c(S = 0.5, D = 0.5, C = 1) * shrinkage * deviation
}

for (record in c(850, 900)) {
  values <- paste(sprintf("%.1f", tiny_blup(record)), collapse = ", ")
  cat(sprintf("EBV(S,D,C) at %d: (%s)\n", record, values))
}

pev <- additive_var - additive_var^2 / observation_var
rel <- 1 - pev / additive_var
acc <- sqrt(rel)

cat(sprintf("PEV(C)=%.2f, REL(C)=%.2f, ACC(C)=%.3f\n", pev, rel, acc))
两次输入和不确定性指标的复算输出如下。
The reproduced output shows both inputs and the uncertainty measures.
EBV(S,D,C) at 850: (7.5, 7.5, 15.0)
EBV(S,D,C) at 900: (15.0, 15.0, 30.0)
PEV(C)=210.00, REL(C)=0.30, ACC(C)=0.548
实际评估还要核对环境效应、信息结构与方差参数。
An actual evaluation also requires checks of environmental effects, information structure, and variance parameters.

text:
06 · 进阶：混合模型方程 / Further detail: mixed model equations
固定效应需从数据估计时，在独立同方差残差假设下可使用下面的标准方程。
When fixed effects need estimation, the standard equations below apply under independent, equal-residual-variance assumptions.
[X′XX′ZZ′XZ′Z+λK−1][b̂â]=[X′yZ′y],λ=σe2σA2
\begin{bmatrix}
X'X&X'Z\\
Z'X&Z'Z+\lambda K^{-1}
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}\hat b\\\hat a\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}X'y\\Z'y\end{bmatrix},\qquad
\lambda=\frac{\sigma_e^2}{\sigma_A^2}


撇号表示转置。
A prime denotes transpose.
λ\lambda 是残差方差与遗传方差之比。
λ\lambda is the residual-to-genetic variance ratio.
λK−1\lambda K^{-1} 可理解为带亲缘结构的约束，类似正则化。
λK−1\lambda K^{-1} resembles a relationship-structured constraint, similar to regularization.

这个约束来自遗传协方差模型，不能为了排名好看而任意调整。
The constraint comes from the genetic covariance model and should not be altered to manufacture attractive rankings.
实际程序通常解线性方程组，而不显式形成整个大矩阵的逆。
Programs generally solve linear systems instead of explicitly inverting a whole large matrix.
只有一条记录且均值未知时，不能像前面的特例那样区分总体均值与个体优势。
With only one record and an unknown mean, population level and individual advantage cannot be separated as in the earlier special case.

单性状与多性状 / Single-trait and multi-trait models
单性状模型一次分析一个性状。
A single-trait model analyzes one trait.
多性状模型联合分析多个性状，并利用遗传协方差与残差协方差。
A multi-trait model jointly analyzes several traits using genetic and residual covariances.
例如，体重与背膘可以共同提供信息。
For example, weight and backfat can contribute information jointly.
两个 EBV 列表算完再求相关，不能代替多性状模型。
Correlating two completed EBV lists does not replace a multi-trait model.
对两个性状，遗传协方差矩阵的对角线是方差，非对角线是协方差。
For two traits, a genetic covariance matrix has variances on the diagonal and their covariance off the diagonal.
ΣA=[σA12σA1,A2σA1,A2σA22]
\Sigma_A=\begin{bmatrix}
\sigma_{A_1}^2&\sigma_{A_1,A_2}\\
\sigma_{A_1,A_2}&\sigma_{A_2}^2
\end{bmatrix}

这里的性状间联系，要与 A、G、H 描述的动物间联系分开理解。
Distinguish these between-trait connections from the between-animal relationships described by A, G, and H.

07 · 正式评估按什么顺序做 / Steps in a formal evaluation

1｜明确性状与目标。
1 | Define traits and objectives.
2｜核对身份、单位、缺失与系谱。

3｜定义同期群与其他效应。
3 | Define contemporary groups and other effects.
4｜估计或验证方差组分。
4 | Estimate or validate variance components.
5｜构建关系与模型。
5 | Construct relationships and the model.
6｜求解方程。
6 | Solve the equations.
7｜输出 EBV 和可获得的准确度。
7 | Report EBVs and available accuracies.
8｜检查基准、偏差、验证结果与趋势。
8 | Check bases, bias, validation results, and trends.

成功输出一个数字，不能替代这些检查。
Producing a number does not replace these checks.
本章微型例题为自拟，不来自生产评估。
The tiny example is original teaching material, not a production evaluation.

section: 02 · 两个统计任务 / Two statistical tasks
text:
02 · 两个统计任务 / Two statistical tasks
BLUP 任务在协方差结构给定时预测随机效应，方差组分任务根据数据估计这些结构中的未知参数。
The BLUP task predicts random effects given covariance structures, while variance-component estimation estimates their unknown parameters from data.
例如模型 y=Xb+Za+ey=Xb+Za+e 可以需要 σA2\sigma_A^2 和 σe2\sigma_e^2，多性状时还需要协方差。
For example, y=Xb+Za+ey=Xb+Za+e can require σA2\sigma_A^2 and σe2\sigma_e^2, plus covariances in a multi-trait model.
初始方差只是迭代的起点，输入过某个值不表示数据支持该值。
Starting variances are only iteration inputs, and supplying a value does not establish support for it in the data.

section: 03 · 似然的直觉 / Intuition for likelihood
text:
03 · 似然的直觉 / Intuition for likelihood
似然把观察数据固定，比较不同参数假设下这些数据出现的相对支持程度。
Likelihood holds the observed data fixed and compares their relative support under different parameter assumptions.
最大似然 ML选择使似然最大的参数，不能直接解释为参数本身的概率。
Maximum likelihood (ML) selects parameters maximizing likelihood, which is not directly a probability of the parameters themselves.
限制或残差最大似然 REML基于消除固定效应影响的数据组合构造似然，以处理估计固定效应带来的信息损失。
Restricted or residual maximum likelihood (REML) constructs likelihood from data combinations eliminating fixed effects to account for information used in estimating them.

section: 04 · 用第03章数据理解自由度 / Understand degrees of freedom using Chapter 03
text:
04 · 用第03章数据理解自由度 / Understand degrees of freedom using Chapter 03
暂时只考虑独立正态记录、一个未知均值和一个未知方差，不涉及遗传分解。
Temporarily consider only independent normal records with one unknown mean and one unknown variance, without genetic decomposition.
对 x=[700,800,800,900]x=[700,800,800,900]，n=4n=4、均值为 800、离差平方和 SS=20,000SS=20{,}000。
For x=[700,800,800,900]x=[700,800,800,900], n=4n=4, the mean is 800, and the squared-deviation sum is SS=20,000SS=20{,}000.
这个简单问题中，ML 方差为 SS/n=5000SS/n=5000，REML 方差为 SS/(n−1)=6666.67SS/(n-1)=6666.67。
In this simple problem, ML variance is SS/n=5000SS/n=5000 and REML variance is SS/(n−1)=6666.67SS/(n-1)=6666.67.
用 vv 表示待估方差，忽略与 vv 无关的常数时，REML 对数似然可写如下。
Writing the unknown variance as vv and omitting constants independent of vv, the REML log-likelihood is as follows.
ℓR(v)=−n−12log⁡(v)−SS2v+constant
\ell_R(v)=-\frac{n-1}{2}\log(v)-\frac{SS}{2v}+\mathrm{constant}

log\log 是自然对数，保留似然大小顺序，方便把乘法化为加法。
log\log is the natural logarithm, preserving likelihood ordering while turning multiplication into addition.
这个例子说明自由度修正，但一般动物模型的 REML 不是把所有表型方差简单除以 n−1n-1 就完成。
This illustrates a degrees-of-freedom correction, but REML in a general animal model is not merely dividing overall phenotype variation by n−1n-1.

section: 05 · 为什么亲缘与记录结构不可缺 / Why relationships and record structure matter
text:
05 · 为什么亲缘与记录结构不可缺 / Why relationships and record structure matter
动物模型通过亲属之间的相似及环境设计，区分加性遗传方差与其他方差来源。
An animal model uses relatives’ resemblance and environmental design to distinguish additive genetic variance from other components.
若每个家系完全对应唯一场区，可能难以把家系与场区影响分开，增加迭代次数不能自动修复这种混杂。
If every family belongs to one unique site, family and site effects can be hard to separate, and extra iterations do not automatically repair this confounding.
同窝和永久环境遗漏时，某些共同偏离可能错误进入遗传方差，因此模型设计影响遗传力解释。
Omitting litter or permanent environment can misattribute shared deviations to genetic variance, affecting heritability interpretation.

title: 07-3｜REML 与方差组分 / REML and variance components
section: 06 · 怎样解释迭代与收敛 / Interpret iteration and convergence
text:
06 · 怎样解释迭代与收敛 / Interpret iteration and convergence
迭代是按规则从当前参数更新下一组参数，收敛表示达到指定的数值停止条件。
Iteration updates parameters according to a rule, and convergence means a specified numerical stopping condition has been met.
收敛不证明模型正确，也不保证预测未来表现准确，应同时检查边界估计、标准误和验证结果。
Convergence does not establish a correct model or accurate future prediction, so boundary estimates, standard errors, and validation also need inspection.
边界估计例如某方差接近 0，可能反映信号弱、设计不足或模型问题，不能统一解释成不存在遗传作用。
A boundary estimate, such as a near-zero variance, can reflect weak signal, insufficient design, or model problems rather than universally proving no genetic effect.

07 · 估计后如何连接 BLUP / Connect estimates to BLUP
若一个自拟模型得到 σA2=300\sigma_A^2=300、σe2=700\sigma_e^2=700，则 h2=0.3h^2=0.3、λ=700/300≈2.3333\lambda=700/300\approx2.3333。
If a hypothetical model gives σA2=300\sigma_A^2=300 and σe2=700\sigma_e^2=700, then h2=0.3h^2=0.3 and λ=700/300≈2.3333\lambda=700/300\approx2.3333.
这些组分进入 BLUP 的信息权重，但参数估计本身仍有不确定性，不能把输入后的准确度当成已知真值。
These components enter BLUP weighting, but their estimates remain uncertain and resulting accuracies are not known truths.
这里的数值仅用于连接概念，本次没有对真实猪群运行 REML 或 BLUPF90。
These numbers connect concepts only, and no real-herd REML or BLUPF90 run was performed.

text:
08 · 怎样从日志确认估过方差组分 / Verify Variance Estimation from Run Logs
日志有 EBV 时，我会另外查任务设置、迭代记录及最终方差输出，以确认本次是否执行过方差估计。
If a log shows EBVs, I also check task settings, iterations, and final variance output to determine whether this run estimated variances.
估计方差与按给定方差预测育种值是不同任务，日志里同一组参数可能只是输入时的设定值。
Estimating variances and predicting breeding values from supplied variances are different tasks, and parameters in a log may simply have been provided as inputs.

section: 01 · SNP 不是好坏评分 / SNP codes are not merit scores
text:
01 · SNP 不是好坏评分 / SNP codes are not merit scores
SNP是单核苷酸多态性，即某个 DNA 位置在群体中存在不同碱基版本。
A SNP, or single nucleotide polymorphism, is a DNA position with alternative nucleotide versions in a population.
常见二等位标记用 0、1、2 表示某个等位基因的拷贝数。
Biallelic marker genotypes are often coded 0, 1, or 2 for allele-copy counts.
0、1、2 不代表差、中、好，标记也不一定是因果突变。
These codes do not mean poor, medium, and good, and the marker need not be a causal mutation.

title: 08-0｜基因组与三类 BLUP / Genomics and three BLUP approaches
section: 02 · 三类 BLUP 的区别 / Comparing the three approaches
text:
02 · 三类 BLUP 的区别 / Comparing the three approaches

PBLUP：使用系谱 / PBLUP: pedigree information
PBLUP 使用 A，把父母身份与平均亲缘联系用于评估。
PBLUP uses A, incorporating parentage and expected relationships into evaluation.
如果全同胞没有自身或可区分的后代信息，且模型信息完全对称，它们可能得到相同 EBV。
Full siblings may receive identical EBVs when they lack own or distinguishing progeny information and their model information is symmetric.
相同 EBV 不代表它们的真实遗传能力完全相同。
Identical EBVs do not imply identical true genetic merit.


GBLUP：使用基因组 / GBLUP: genomic information
GBLUP 使用 G，通过标记描述相对参考群体的实际遗传联系。
GBLUP uses G, describing realized genetic relationships relative to a reference population through markers.
它能帮助区分全同胞继承组合的差异。
It can help distinguish inherited differences among full siblings.
G 依赖标记、等位基因频率与标定，不是简单的 DNA 相同百分比。
G depends on markers, allele frequencies, and scaling, rather than being a simple percentage of matching DNA.


ssGBLUP：统一评估 / ssGBLUP: integrated evaluation
ssGBLUP是单步基因组 BLUP，联合使用系谱、表型与部分动物的基因型。
ssGBLUP, or single-step genomic BLUP, integrates pedigrees, phenotypes, and genotypes available for some animals.
组合关系矩阵常记为 H。
The combined relationship matrix is commonly called H.
简单平均两个独立系统的 EBV，不能称为单步法。
Averaging EBVs from two independent systems is not single-step evaluation.



PBLUP、GBLUP 与 ssGBLUP 使用的关系矩阵 / Relationship matrices used by PBLUP, GBLUP, and ssGBLUP


图 08-0A　三种方法的关系矩阵依次是系谱矩阵 A、基因组矩阵 G 和联合关系矩阵 H，评估同时需要表型与模型。
Figure 08-0A　The three methods use pedigree matrix A, genomic matrix G, and combined relationship matrix H, respectively, and evaluation also uses phenotypes and a model.

section: 03 · H 如何组合信息 / How H combines information
text:
03 · H 如何组合信息 / How H combines information
A22A_{22} 是已分型动物在 A 中的子矩阵。
A22A_{22} is the submatrix of A for genotyped animals.
按相同动物顺序，示意公式把基因组关系信息嵌回整个群体。
With consistent animal ordering, the schematic formula embeds genomic relationships into the whole population.
H−1=A−1+[000G−1−A22−1]
H^{-1}=A^{-1}+\begin{bmatrix}
0&0\\0&G^{-1}-A_{22}^{-1}
\end{bmatrix}

实践中需要兼容的尺度、调和与稳定化处理，不能随意拼接 A 和 G。
Practical use requires compatible scaling, tuning, and stabilization rather than arbitrary splicing of A and G.

section: 04 · 芯片不能替代表型 / Genotypes do not replace phenotypes
text:
04 · 芯片不能替代表型 / Genotypes do not replace phenotypes
基因组预测需要参考群体提供“基因型—表现”的联系。
Genomic prediction needs reference data connecting genotypes to performance.
目标群体与参考群体的距离、分型错误、样本身份、标记缺失和模型都会影响结果。
Relatedness to the reference population, genotype errors, sample identity, marker missingness, and model choice affect results.
仅有芯片文件，不能保证任何品种和性状都能准确预测。
A genotype file alone does not guarantee accurate prediction for every breed and trait.

section: 05 · 收敛不等于预测准确 / Convergence does not establish predictive accuracy
text:
05 · 收敛不等于预测准确 / Convergence does not establish predictive accuracy
方程收敛说明数值求解达到设定标准。
Convergence establishes that numerical solving met a specified criterion.
预测能力还需要独立验证。
Predictive ability still needs independent validation.
按历史时间验证时，只能使用预测时点可获得的表型、系谱和分型信息。
Historical time-based validation must use phenotypes, pedigrees, and genotypes available at the prediction date.
随机拆分亲属可能适合某些目标，但不能自动代表对未来或陌生群体的预测能力。
Randomly splitting relatives may suit some objectives but does not automatically represent prediction for future or unfamiliar populations.
本章介绍通用方法，不代表某个本地程序已实现全部能力。
This chapter describes general methods, not verified capabilities of a particular local program.

section: 02 · 先定义 0、1、2 / Define 0, 1, and 2
text:
02 · 先定义 0、1、2 / Define 0, 1, and 2
设每个数表示该 SNP 上等位基因 B 的拷贝数，则 0=AA、1=AB、2=BB，缺失另行标记。
Let each number count B alleles at a SNP, so 0=AA, 1=AB, and 2=BB, with missingness coded separately.
0 不是差基因、2 不是好基因，编码方向与性状效应是不同问题。
Zero is not a bad genotype and two is not a good genotype, because coding direction differs from trait effect.
缺失不能随便填 0，否则会把未检测成功伪装成 AA。
Missing values must not be arbitrarily filled with zero, which would misrepresent failed detection as AA.

section: 03 · 手算检出率 / Calculate call rates
text:
03 · 手算检出率 / Calculate call rates
假设有下面 3 头猪、4 个标记的教学数据，NA 表示缺失。
Suppose the teaching data below contain three pigs and four markers, with NA indicating missingness.
animal,M1,M2,M3,M4
P1,0,1,NA,2
P2,1,1,2,0
P3,2,0,1,NA
动物检出率是该动物成功检测的标记数除以计划标记数，所以 P1、P2、P3 分别为 0.75、1、0.75。
An animal call rate divides successfully called markers by planned markers, giving P1, P2, and P3 rates 0.75, 1, and 0.75.
标记检出率是该位点成功检测的动物数除以待检测动物数，所以 M3、M4 都为 2/32/3。
A marker call rate divides animals successfully called at that marker by animals tested, giving 2/32/3 for both M3 and M4.
例如选择阈值 0.8 时，P1、P3 与 M3、M4 会分别触及相应维度的阈值，但该数字仅为教学假设。
A hypothetical threshold of 0.8 flags P1, P3, M3, and M4 in their respective dimensions, but this threshold is illustrative only.
过滤动物会改变剩余位点统计，过滤位点也会改变动物统计，因此应记录步骤顺序、分母与最终保留集合。
Filtering animals changes marker statistics and filtering markers changes animal statistics, so record order, denominators, and final retained sets.

section: 04 · 手算等位基因频率与 MAF / Calculate allele frequency and MAF
text:
04 · 手算等位基因频率与 MAF / Calculate allele frequency and MAF
等位基因频率 pBp_B是 B 拷贝数除以成功检测个体提供的全部拷贝数。
Allele frequency pBp_B divides B-copy count by all allele copies from successfully called animals.
M3 的有效编码为 2、1，共有 3 个 B 拷贝和 4 个总拷贝。
The called M3 genotypes are 2 and 1, giving three B copies among four total copies.
pB=(2+1)/(2×2)=0.75,MAF=min⁡(pB,1−pB)=0.25
p_B=(2+1)/(2\times2)=0.75,\qquad
MAF=\min(p_B,1-p_B)=0.25

MAF是次要等位基因频率，不是次要基因型所占动物比例。
MAF is minor allele frequency, not the fraction of animals with the less common genotype.
若一个标记在保留群体中完全没有变异，称为单态，通常不能提供该群体内的关系差异信息。
A marker with no variation in the retained population is monomorphic and generally supplies no within-population relationship contrast.

section: 05 · 孟德尔一致性与样本身份 / Mendelian consistency and identity
text:
05 · 孟德尔一致性与样本身份 / Mendelian consistency and identity
在同一编码方向下，某已知亲本为 AA 时，正常孟德尔遗传下不能产生 BB 子代。
Under consistent coding, a known AA parent cannot produce a BB offspring through ordinary Mendelian inheritance.
出现大量这类矛盾时，要核对亲子身份、样本错配、等位基因方向和检测错误，而不是直接认定系谱真实或芯片真实。
Numerous such conflicts require checking parentage, sample swaps, allele orientation, and assay errors rather than automatically trusting either pedigree or chip.
极高相似度可能提示重复样本，但需要结合动物身份与真实生物学关系判断。
Extremely high similarity can suggest duplicate samples but requires interpretation with identities and biological relationships.
交叉编号表把样本编号、原始猪号、软件重编号和矩阵行号连接起来，是防止身份错位的关键。
A cross-reference table connects sample ID, original animal ID, software ID, and matrix row, helping prevent identity mismatches.

section: 06 · HWE 检查怎样理解 / Interpret HWE checks
text:
06 · HWE 检查怎样理解 / Interpret HWE checks
哈代–温伯格平衡 HWE是在特定随机交配等条件下，基因型频率与等位基因频率对应的一种基准。
Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium (HWE) is a baseline relating genotype and allele frequencies under conditions including random mating.
在二等位的基准下，AA、AB、BB 期望频率分别为 (1−pB)2(1-p_B)^2、2pB(1−pB)2p_B(1-p_B)、pB2p_B^2。
For a biallelic baseline, expected AA, AB, and BB frequencies are (1−pB)2(1-p_B)^2, 2pB(1−pB)2p_B(1-p_B), and pB2p_B^2.
偏离可能来自检测问题，也可能来自选择、群体混合或近交，不能在选育群体中把每个偏离都直接当作错误。
Deviations can reflect assay problems, selection, population mixture, or inbreeding, so not every deviation in a selected population is an error.

07 · 清洗后重新核对矩阵和编号 / Reconcile IDs and Matrices After Cleaning
删除一头低检出率动物后，我会核对矩阵实际保留的行列和顺序，也会查软件是否保留或填零。
After excluding an animal with a low call rate, I check the matrix’s retained rows, columns, and order, as well as whether the software retains or zero-fills entries.

A new ID file must match the rebuilt matrix, or if the existing matrix is reused, IDs must be mapped explicitly according to the software’s behavior and cleaning results.

Once a model produces breeding values, picking the top-ranked animal still depends on the objective and who can be compared.

title: 09-0｜选择、选配与遗传进展 / Selection, mating, and genetic progress
section: 01 · 三个步骤分开理解 / Three distinct steps
text:
01 · 三个步骤分开理解 / Three distinct steps

评估估计每头动物的遗传价值。
Evaluation estimates each animal’s genetic merit.
选择决定保留谁作为父母。
Selection chooses which animals become parents.
选配决定谁和谁配，以及各使用多少次。
Mating determines pairs and parental contributions.

如果高 EBV 动物集中在一个家系，只按排名大量使用会增加群体亲缘和后续近交。
If high-EBV animals cluster in one family, using them heavily on rank alone increases population relationships and future inbreeding.

title: 09-0｜选择、选配与遗传进展 / Selection, mating, and genetic progress
section: 02 · 先定目标，再挑指标 / Define objectives before choosing criteria
text:
02 · 先定目标，再挑指标 / Define objectives before choosing criteria
育种目标是最终希望改进的综合结果。
The breeding objective is the overall outcome to improve.
选择依据是实际可用的记录、EBV 或标记。
Selection criteria are the available records, EBVs, or markers.
例如目标可以是整个生产系统的效益与稳健性，日增重只是依据之一。
For example, the objective may include system-wide efficiency and robustness, with daily gain as just one criterion.
终端父系与母系的育种目标通常不同。
Terminal-sire and maternal-line objectives commonly differ.

section: 03 · 综合指数不是简单相加 / An index needs meaningful weights
text:
03 · 综合指数不是简单相加 / An index needs meaningful weights
把日增重的 g/day 与背膘的 mm 直接相加，没有统一的解释。
Adding daily gain in g/day directly to backfat in mm has no consistent interpretation.
简化综合育种目标可写为 Ĥ=∑jvjBV̂j\widehat H=\sum_j v_j\widehat{BV}_j。
A simplified aggregate breeding objective is Ĥ=∑jvjBV̂j\widehat H=\sum_j v_j\widehat{BV}_j.
其中 vjv_j 是每个性状单位对应的经济价值，或经过明确设计的权重。
Here vjv_j is economic value per trait unit or another explicitly designed weight.
它不同于用原始记录构建最优选择指数时的统计系数。
It differs from statistical coefficients in an optimal selection index built from raw information.

一个假设例子 / A hypothetical example
假设指数为 I=0.02EBVADG−1.0EBVBFI=0.02\,EBV_{ADG}-1.0\,EBV_{BF}。
Suppose the index is I=0.02EBVADG−1.0EBVBFI=0.02\,EBV_{ADG}-1.0\,EBV_{BF}.

甲的两个 EBV 为 +40、+1，指数为 −0.2。
Animal A has EBVs +40 and +1, giving an index of −0.2.
乙的两个 EBV 为 +20、−1，指数为 1.4。
Animal B has EBVs +20 and −1, giving an index of 1.4.

乙的综合得分更高，尽管它的日增重 EBV 较低。
B has the higher overall score despite its lower daily-gain EBV.
数值和权重都是教学假设，改变目标或权重就可能改变排名。
These values and weights are teaching assumptions, and changing the objective or weights can change rankings.

title: 09-0｜选择、选配与遗传进展 / Selection, mating, and genetic progress
section: 04 · 同期群让比较更公平 / Contemporary groups support fair comparisons
text:
04 · 同期群让比较更公平 / Contemporary groups support fair comparisons
同期群把表现机会相近的动物放在一起比较，常涉及场、时间、性别和管理。
Contemporary groups compare animals with similar performance opportunities, often considering farm, time, sex, and management.

分组太粗，容易混入环境差异。
Broad groups can mix environmental differences.
分组太细，会缺少可比较的动物。
Overly fine groups can leave too few animals to compare.

具体规则依性状和系统设计而定，不能直接照搬其他物种的规则。
Specific rules depend on traits and evaluation design, so rules from another species should not be copied blindly.
遗传联系通过共同父系或其他亲属，在不同组之间建立桥梁。
Genetic connectedness bridges groups through shared sires or other relatives.
若每场只有一个完全不同且无亲缘的父系，就难以分开场区优势与父系优势。
If each farm has one entirely different, unrelated sire family, farm and sire advantages are difficult to distinguish.
共享父系并合理分布后代，有助于跨组比较。
Shared sires and appropriately distributed offspring support across-group comparisons.

title: 09-0｜选择、选配与遗传进展 / Selection, mating, and genetic progress
section: 05 · 遗传进展为什么按年看 / Why measure progress per year?
text:
05 · 遗传进展为什么按年看 / Why measure progress per year?
简化的每年遗传进展关系为 ΔGyear≈irA,ÂσA/L\Delta G_{year}\approx i\,r_{A,\hat A}\,\sigma_A/L。
A simplified annual-response relationship is ΔGyear≈irA,ÂσA/L\Delta G_{year}\approx i\,r_{A,\hat A}\,\sigma_A/L.

ii 是选择强度。
ii is selection intensity.
rr 是选择准确度，不是两个性状的遗传相关。
rr is selection accuracy, not a genetic correlation between two traits.
σA\sigma_A 是加性遗传标准差。
σA\sigma_A is the additive genetic standard deviation.
LL 是世代间隔，即替代后代出生时父母的平均年龄。
LL is the generation interval, the average parental age at birth of replacement offspring.

世代间隔不是妊娠长度。
Generation interval is not gestation length.
等待更多后代资料可能提高准确度，却也可能拉长世代间隔。
Waiting for more progeny data may improve accuracy while increasing the generation interval.
只用少数顶尖父母能增强选择，却可能损失多样性。
Using very few elite parents increases selection intensity but can reduce diversity.
因此要综合权衡准确度、时间和遗传多样性。
Accuracy, time, and genetic diversity therefore need to be balanced.

section: 06 · 杂种优势与遗传趋势 / Heterosis and genetic trends
text:
06 · 杂种优势与遗传趋势 / Heterosis and genetic trends
杂种优势是特定杂交群体相对亲本群体平均水平的优势。
Heterosis is the advantage of a particular crossbred population relative to the parental-population average.
它不能当作某头动物的加性 EBV。
It is not an individual’s additive EBV.
遗传趋势通常看同一可比基准下，不同出生年份的平均 EBV。
A genetic trend often tracks mean EBV by birth year on a comparable base.
生产均值上升可能包含管理改善，而改变基准或模型也可能改变表观趋势。
Production gains can include management improvements, while changed bases or models can alter apparent trends.

section: 我的核对笔记 / My Verification Notes
text:
我的核对笔记 / My Verification Notes
用指数排序前，我会先确认两个 EBV 的单位、方向和评估基准可比，再检查权重对应的选择目标。
Before ranking by an index, I check the units, directions, and evaluation bases of the EBVs and verify which selection objective the weights represent.
前面的甲得 −0.2、乙得 1.4，只在例子给定的基准和权重下成立，换基准或目标就要重新核对。
The scores of −0.2 for A and 1.4 for B apply under the example’s base and weights, so changing the base or objective calls for a new check.
选择还要看哪些动物有资格进入名单，选配要继续看亲缘和用种次数，长期比较则要把世代间隔放进同一年度尺度。
Selection also asks which animals are eligible, mating considers relationships and parent usage, and long-term comparisons put generation intervals on the same annual scale.

01 · 原文短摘与要点 / Short excerpt and source summary

短摘译意：每头配种母牛的净利润。
Short excerpt: “net profit per cow mated”.

这句话位于 PDF 第 1 页的 Interpreting Selection Indexes 部分。
This wording appears under Interpreting Selection Indexes on PDF page 1.
原文将指数解释为特定生产与市场情景下的利润遗传价值预测。
The guide interprets an index as predicted genetic merit for profitability in a specified production and market scenario.
它不是当期现金利润，也不是单独一个生长或胴体指标。
It is not current cash profit or a single growth or carcass measurement.
指南的后代比较示例对两个父本的指数差取一半，并考虑适用的后代生产链。
Its progeny comparison halves the sire-index difference and considers the relevant offspring production chain.

BreedObject 官方说明强调，指数的目标生产系统必须与你的用途相匹配。
The official BreedObject explanation emphasizes matching the index’s production system to its intended use.
终端用途与自留母畜用途的关注点可能不同。
Terminal use and retention of replacement females can emphasize different outcomes.
同样的高指数也可能来自不同性状组合，因此还需要查看个体 EBV。
Similar high indexes can arise from different trait combinations, so individual EBVs still matter.
动物选择指南还要求结合指数以外的重要信息。
The animal-selection guide also considers important information outside the index.
这些肉牛指南解释的是决策结构，不能直接提供种猪场的经济权重。
These cattle guides explain decision structure rather than supplying economic weights for a pig herd.

section: 03 · 教学推导：把单位写出来 / Teaching derivation: make the units explicit
text:
03 · 教学推导：把单位写出来 / Teaching derivation: make the units explicit
下面另建一个假设的两性状指数，所有数字都不是原 PDF 的案例。
The following hypothetical two-trait index uses original teaching numbers rather than the PDF’s example.
假设 ADG 的权重为每 g/day 对应 0.04 分，背膘权重为每 mm 对应 −1.5 分。
Suppose ADG receives 0.04 points per g/day and backfat receives −1.5 points per mm.
J=0.04EBVADG−1.5EBVBF
J=0.04\,EBV_{ADG}-1.5\,EBV_{BF}


甲的 EBV 为 +35 g/day 与 +0.4 mm，得 0.8 分。
A has EBVs +35 g/day and +0.4 mm, giving 0.8 points.
乙的 EBV 为 +20 g/day 与 −0.4 mm，得 1.4 分。
B has EBVs +20 g/day and −0.4 mm, giving 1.4 points.

乙的增重优势较小，却在这组权重下有更高综合分。
B has less growth advantage but a higher combined score under these weights.
若只把增重权重改成 0.10，甲得 2.9 分、乙得 2.6 分，排序反转。
Changing only the growth weight to 0.10 gives A 2.9 and B 2.6 points, reversing the ranking.
排序变化来自目标改变，不意味着原来的 EBV 算错。
The ranking changes because the objective changed, not because the original EBVs were incorrect.

什么条件下才能谈利润 / When can a score be interpreted as profit?
必须先定义货币单位、计价对象、生产周期与成本收益模型。
First define the currency, accounting unit, production horizon, and cost–return model.
本例没有这些定义，所以指数分不能改名为“元”。
This example lacks those definitions, so its points cannot be renamed monetary units.

text:
04 · 解释“一半”时要确认尺度 / Check the scale before applying one-half
假设另一个教学指数明确采用整体育种值尺度，两头父本分别为 +90 和 +50 个模型货币单位。
Suppose another teaching index explicitly uses a full breeding-value scale, with sire values +90 and +50 model currency units.
在配偶和评估口径可比等假设下，父本造成的后代组期望差异为 (90−50)/2=20(90-50)/2=20。
With comparable mates and evaluation definitions, the expected progeny-group difference attributable to the sires is (90−50)/2=20(90-50)/2=20.
本例进一步假设指数的计价对象是每次配母畜，并使用虚构的模型货币单位。
This example further assumes a per-mating accounting unit and fictional model currency units.
若每头父本在模型内对应 120 次同等暴露，总期望差额为 120×20=2,400120\times20=2{,}400。
If each sire represents 120 equivalent modeled exposures, the expected total difference is 120×20=2,400120\times20=2{,}400.
这不是当前现金收入，也不能在指数已是 EPD 或其他尺度时再机械除以 2。
This is not current cash income, and an EPD-scale or differently defined index must not be halved mechanically.

05 · 像配置文件一样审查指数 / Review an index like a configuration

记录 objective_version，明确哪一版目标。
Record objective_version to identify the objective definition.
记录每个 trait_unit 与 weight_unit，避免单位相加错误。
Record each trait_unit and weight_unit to prevent incompatible additions.
保留 evaluation_base 与 evaluation_date，避免跨基准拼分。
Keep evaluation_base and evaluation_date to avoid mixing incompatible scores.
将必须过关的条件放入 eligibility_rules，不要隐含在总分中。
Store non-negotiable requirements in eligibility_rules rather than hiding them in the total score.

这些字段是本教程的实现建议，不是 BreedObject 的官方接口或文件格式。
These fields are original implementation suggestions, not official BreedObject interfaces or file formats.

01 · 原文短摘与要点 / Short excerpt and source summary

短摘译意：共同父系连接同期群。
Short excerpt: “common sires link contemporary groups”.

这句话摘自原文 Creating Genetic Linkage 部分。
This wording is from Creating Genetic Linkage.
原文强调两件事：组内保持可比，组间建立遗传联系。
The source emphasizes within-group comparability and genetic links between groups.
共同父系可连接场内、跨场和跨年份的记录。
Shared sires can connect records within herds, across herds, and across years.
文中“至少两个父系”的要求，针对其系统中后代记录对父本 EBV 的贡献。
Its requirement for at least two sires concerns progeny-record contributions to sire EBVs in that system.
这不是所有物种和模型通用的充分条件。
It is not a universal sufficient condition for every species and model.

section: 02 · 教学反例：完全重合的两种解释 / Teaching counterexample: indistinguishable explanations
text:
02 · 教学反例：完全重合的两种解释 / Teaching counterexample: indistinguishable explanations
假设 A 场只养 U 的后代，B 场只养 V 的后代。
Suppose farm A contains only U’s offspring and farm B only V’s offspring.
两场的日增重均值分别为 900 与 800 g/day。
Their mean daily gains are 900 and 800 g/day.
差异可能来自父系、场区或两者共同作用，单凭这两个均值不能分解。
The difference may reflect sire, farm, or both, and those two means alone cannot separate them.
用简化模型表达，场效应与父系效应完全重合。
In a simplified model, farm and sire effects are perfectly confounded.
y‾A=μ+gA+sU,y‾B=μ+gB+sV
\bar y_A=\mu+g_A+s_U,\qquad
\bar y_B=\mu+g_B+s_V

给 gAg_A 加 20、同时给 sUs_U 减 20，A 场的预测均值不变。
Adding 20 to gAg_A and subtracting 20 from sUs_U leaves farm A’s predicted mean unchanged.
这就是多种参数解释可以产生同样观测的例子。
This illustrates different parameter explanations producing the same observations.
系谱或基因组信息能提供额外结构，但不能自动替代合理的数据设计。
Pedigree or genomic information adds structure without automatically replacing sound data design.

section: 03 · 加一个共同父系 / Add a shared sire
text:
03 · 加一个共同父系 / Add a shared sire
以下全部为假设后代组均值，并假设配偶组成与测定条件已合理平衡。
All values below are hypothetical progeny-group means, assuming reasonably balanced mates and testing conditions.

A 场中，U 的后代为 900，共同父系 R 的后代为 850。
In farm A, U’s offspring average 900, and shared sire R’s offspring average 850.
B 场中，V 的后代为 820，R 的后代为 800。
In farm B, V’s offspring average 820, and R’s offspring average 800.

同场比较得到 U−R = 50、V−R = 20，单位均为 g/day。
Within-farm comparisons give U−R = 50 and V−R = 20, both in g/day.
在这个加性环境简化例子中，两项相减得到相对差异 30 g/day。
In this simplified additive-environment example, subtracting the contrasts gives a relative difference of 30 g/day.
(900−850)−(820−800)=30
(900-850)-(820-800)=30

这里比较的是后代组对比，不是已计算完成的公猪 EBV。
This is a progeny-group contrast, not a completed sire EBV.
实际还需要亲缘、母本、样本量、方差与收缩等处理。
Actual evaluation also requires relationships, dams, sample sizes, variances, and shrinkage.
共同 R 提供桥梁，但一个共同父系不自动保证高准确度。
Shared R provides a bridge, but one shared sire does not automatically guarantee high accuracy.



共同父系连接两个场的后代组对比 / Shared-sire progeny-group contrasts across two farms


图 09-4A　两场都以共同父系 R 的后代均值作同场参照，得到 U−R = 50 g/day、V−R = 20 g/day。
Figure 09-4A　Both farms use the mean of shared sire R’s progeny as the within-farm reference, giving U−R = 50 g/day and V−R = 20 g/day.
在配偶和测定条件合理平衡的加性教学模型中，两项同场对比的差是 30 g/day，比较对象是后代组。
In the additive teaching model with reasonably balanced mates and testing conditions, the difference of 30 g/day is a comparison of progeny groups.
