title: 09-4｜遗传联系：让不同组之间有一座桥 / Connectedness: a bridge between groups
section: 04 · 补充原理：图能说明什么 / Supporting principle: what a graph shows
text:
04 · 补充原理：图能说明什么 / Supporting principle: what a graph shows
Purdue 跨场评估资料的 Connectedness 部分解释，亲缘信息可连接不同组的评估。
The Connectedness section of Purdue’s across-herd evaluation resource explains linking group evaluations through relationships.
可以把组当节点，把共同父系或其他有效亲缘信息当连接。
Think of groups as nodes and shared sires or other informative relationships as connections.






flowchart LR
    A["A场同期群<br/>Farm A group"] --- R["共同父系R<br/>Shared sire R"]
    R --- B["B场同期群<br/>Farm B group"]






图中连通只表示存在路径，不等于统计联系足够强或预测已经可靠。
Graph connectivity establishes a path, not sufficient statistical connectedness or reliable prediction.

一个自拟数据检查清单 / An original data-review checklist

查看每组涉及多少父系，以及后代是否只来自一个家系。
Review how many sires occur in each group and whether records come from only one family.
查看共同父系是否分布在真实可比的时间窗口。
Review whether shared sires occur in genuinely comparable time windows.
查看记录是否集中在少数父系，或缺少关键中间年份。
Review concentration in a few sires and missing intermediate years.
同时保留每条边的后代数量，而不只记录有或没有联系。
Retain progeny counts for each connection rather than only its presence or absence.

这个清单用于发现问题，不是正式统计联系指标或统一最低样本量标准。
This checklist detects problems rather than defining a formal connectedness statistic or universal minimum sample size.

title: 09-4｜遗传联系：让不同组之间有一座桥 / Connectedness: a bridge between groups
section: 05 · 记录多，也要确认真的提交了 / More records must actually reach evaluation
text:
05 · 记录多，也要确认真的提交了 / More records must actually reach evaluation
BREEDPLAN 记录完整性说明区分记录覆盖情况与单个动物 EBV 的准确度。
BREEDPLAN’s completeness explanation distinguishes recording coverage from an individual animal’s EBV accuracy.
它还帮助核对已采集的信息是否进入评估系统。
It also helps check whether collected information reached the evaluation system.
本教程建议分别核对应测动物、已测动物、已上传记录和实际纳入评估记录。
This tutorial recommends reconciling eligible animals, measured animals, uploaded records, and records actually included in evaluation.
这些数量不同，不应把某一个计数当作整个链条已完成。
These counts differ, and one count does not establish completion of the whole chain.

section: 06 · 跨场比较先查有没有可用的联系 / Check Connectedness Before Comparing Farms
text:
06 · 跨场比较先查有没有可用的联系 / Check Connectedness Before Comparing Farms
两场各有一万条记录时，我也会先找有没有共同父系或其他可用的遗传联系。
Even if both farms have ten thousand records, I first look for a shared sire or another usable genetic link.
如果数据结构把场区和遗传差异混在一起，继续增加同样结构的记录也无法从中把两者分开。
If the design confounds farm and genetic differences, collecting more records with the same structure still cannot separate them.

section: 01 · 基础概念 / Foundations
text:
01 · 基础概念 / Foundations

性状 Trait是描述或测量的生物特征，例如日增重。
A trait is a biological characteristic that can be described or measured, such as daily gain.
表型 Phenotype是实际观测结果，例如 850 g/day。
A phenotype is an observed outcome, such as 850 g/day.
基因型 Genotype是动物的遗传构成。
A genotype is an animal’s genetic constitution.
加性作用 Additive effects描述平均等位基因替换效应。
Additive effects describe average allele-substitution effects.
显性 Dominance涉及同一位点的拷贝组合。
Dominance concerns combinations of copies at one locus.
上位互作 Epistasis涉及不同位点的互作。
Epistasis concerns interactions across loci.

section: 02 · 育种值与不确定性 / Breeding values and uncertainty
text:
02 · 育种值与不确定性 / Breeding values and uncertainty

BV是相对参考群体的加性遗传价值。
BV is additive genetic merit relative to a reference population.
EBV是对育种值的预测。
EBV is an estimated breeding value.
GEBV是利用基因组信息得到的育种值预测。
GEBV is a genomic estimated breeding value.
EPD是预期后代差异，常见尺度为 EBV 的一半。
EPD is expected progeny difference, commonly on half the EBV scale.
PA是亲本均值，即父母育种值的平均。
PA is parent average, the mean of parental breeding values.
MS是孟德尔抽样，即子代真实育种值相对真实亲本均值的遗传偏离。
MS is Mendelian sampling, an offspring’s true genetic deviation from the true parent average.
ACC是准确度，描述预测与真实育种值的相关程度。
ACC is accuracy, describing correlation between predicted and true breeding values.
REL是可靠性，常用定义为 REL=ACC2REL=ACC^2。
REL is reliability, commonly defined as REL=ACC2REL=ACC^2.
PEV是预测误差方差，衡量预测误差的变异。
PEV is prediction error variance, measuring variation in prediction error.

section: 03 · 参数与家系 / Parameters and families
text:
03 · 参数与家系 / Parameters and families

遗传力 Heritability描述群体表型变异中的加性遗传比例。
Heritability describes the additive genetic share of population phenotypic variation.
重复力 Repeatability描述同一动物重复记录的一致程度。
Repeatability describes consistency across an animal’s repeated records.
遗传相关 Genetic correlation描述两个性状加性遗传作用的共同变化。
Genetic correlation describes co-variation in additive effects for two traits.
家系 Family是按指定亲缘关系组成的动物群。
A family groups animals by a specified relationship.
系谱 Pedigree是动物祖先与父母的记录。
A pedigree records ancestry and parentage.
Sire是父亲，Dam是母亲。
Sire means father, and dam means mother.
Progeny是后代。
Progeny means offspring.
Full siblings是同父同母的全同胞。
Full siblings share both parents.
Half siblings是只共享一位父母的半同胞。
Half siblings share one parent.
Relationship是动物之间的遗传联系。
Relationship describes genetic connections between animals.
Inbreeding涉及同祖同源的等位基因拷贝在个体内相遇。
Inbreeding concerns identical-by-descent allele copies meeting within an individual.

title: 附录 A｜中英术语速查 / Appendix A | Bilingual Glossary
section: 04 · 模型与矩阵 / Models and matrices
text:
04 · 模型与矩阵 / Models and matrices

A、G、H在本教程分别是系谱、基因组、组合关系矩阵。
A, G, H denote pedigree, genomic, and combined relationship matrices in this tutorial.
某些统计教材用 G 表示全部随机效应的协方差矩阵，需要按上下文辨认。
Some statistical texts use G for the full random-effect covariance matrix, so read the context.
BLUP是最佳线性无偏预测。
BLUP means best linear unbiased prediction.
REML是限制最大似然，可用于估计方差组分。
REML means restricted maximum likelihood and can estimate variance components.
MME是混合模型方程。
MME means mixed model equations.
固定效应 Fixed effect估计指定水平的差异。
A fixed effect estimates differences among specified levels.
随机效应 Random effect按分布与协方差结构建模。
A random effect is modeled through a distribution and covariance structure.
协变量 Covariate是进入模型的解释变量，例如日龄。
A covariate is an explanatory variable entering a model, such as age.
CG是同期群，用于组织表现机会相近的动物进行比较。
CG means contemporary group, used to compare animals with similar performance opportunities.
PE是永久环境，持续影响同一动物的多次记录。
PE means permanent environment, persisting across an animal’s records.
Parity是胎次，表示第几次分娩。
Parity identifies the farrowing number.

title: 附录 A｜中英术语速查 / Appendix A | Bilingual Glossary
section: 05 · 性状与记录缩写 / Traits and recording abbreviations
text:
05 · 性状与记录缩写 / Traits and recording abbreviations

直接遗传 Direct genetic指被测动物自身的遗传作用。
Direct genetic refers to the measured animal’s own genetic effects.
母体遗传 Maternal genetic指母亲的遗传组成影响后代表现。
Maternal genetic refers to the mother’s genetics affecting offspring performance.
限性 Sex-limited指性状只在某一性别表现。
Sex-limited means a trait is expressed in one sex.
伴性 Sex-linked指相关位点在性染色体上。
Sex-linked refers to loci on sex chromosomes.
ADG是平均日增重。
ADG means average daily gain.
ADFI是平均日采食量。
ADFI means average daily feed intake.
FCR是料重比，即采食量除以增重。
FCR is feed conversion ratio, or feed consumed divided by weight gained.
RFI是剩余采食量，即实际采食量与指定模型预测值的偏差。
RFI is residual feed intake, the deviation of actual intake from a specified model’s prediction.
TNB是总产仔数。
TNB means total number born.
NBA是产活仔数。
NBA means number born alive.
NW是断奶仔猪数。
NW means number weaned.
BF是背膘厚。
BF means backfat.
IMF是肌内脂肪。
IMF means intramuscular fat.

实际系统的缩写与口径必须另外确认。
Verify abbreviations and definitions in the actual data system.

section: 06 · 育种决策 / Breeding decisions
text:
06 · 育种决策 / Breeding decisions

选择强度 Selection intensity描述选择的严格程度。
Selection intensity describes the stringency of selection.
世代间隔 Generation interval是替代后代出生时父母的平均年龄。
Generation interval is the average parental age at birth of replacement offspring.
杂种优势 Heterosis是杂交群体相对亲本群体平均的优势。
Heterosis is crossbred superiority relative to the parental-population average.
